Chapter 206 - Master Dog will get Angry

After receiving help from Jiang Chen’s Revival Pill, Tian Yishan’s injuries had recovered a lot. At least, he was much stronger than before. Of course, it would still take him some time to fully recover.
Two men and a dog flew up into the skies. Under Tian Yishan’s guidance, the flew towards Inferno City.

“Inferno City is located in the center of Inferno Hell, we won’t bump into too many powerful demons or devils if we fly in this direction. Unless we’re unlucky and bump into some demon beasts that lives in huge groups, the real danger of Inferno Hell is in the deepest parts of Inferno Hell, which is located on the other side of Inferno City.”
Tian Yishan said. Jiang Chen and Big Yellow immediately looked at each other, it seemed like they had pretty bad luck, as they had bumped into a huge group of demon beasts right after arriving.
“Since there aren’t many powerful demon beasts along the way, let’s speed up and rush to Inferno City.”
Jiang Chen said.

“Alright. Yang Shuo is a mean and cruel guy, he knows many insane torture techniques. The longer junior disciple Guan is with them, the more he will suffer from torture, and his life might end at any time.”

Tian Yishan seemed worried. He and Guan Yiyun were both from the Black Sect, and after spending some time together, they had built up a good relationship. Tian Yishan was a man who cherished friendship, that’s why he worried so much about Guan Yiyun’s safety after he had been captured by their enemies.
“Are there many groups in Inferno City?”
Jiang Chen asked.

“Yes, there are all sorts of groups in there. Many people group together in an alliance. Besides, Inferno City is a huge place, and with our strength, we were only able to find a place to stay around its perimeter. There is no way for us to stay inside the city. I heard there is a Combat Soul warrior residing within the city. There are often days where trading is going on in the city, and it’s only during these days that Inferno City will be in peace. It’s a rule set by the Combat Soul warrior, so nobody dares attack and rob during these trading days.”
Tian Yishan said.
“Combat Soul warrior.”

Jiang Chen felt surprised, he didn’t expect the Inferno Hell had such a huge attraction that even a Combat Soul warrior was here, the more Tian Yishan explained, the greater interest he had to this Inferno City.
Jiang Chen was here, the chaotic Inferno Hell would definitely become even more chaotic. Jiang Chen’s arrival was the same as a devil incarnate descending from the skies.

“Since the doorway to Inferno Hell only opens up once a year, it’ll make more and more people come to Inferno City. Besides, there are many people who doesn’t want to leave Inferno Hell when the doorway opens, and they’re mostly the vicious men who were exiled to this place. Without powerful strength, they would be killed immediately upon leaving this place. New people come here every day, and people die every day as well.”
Tian Yishan said.

Jiang Chen understood the situation. Although people from the Qi Province feared Inferno Hell, there were still millions of people across all 28 provinces in the Eastern Continent. Countless people were exiled to this place, and numerous people came here to improve their cultivation. Compared to the other powerful provinces, the Qi Province was the weakest, doesn’t matter if you judge from population, or strength.

Those powerful sects in the other biggest provinces would send their disciple to Inferno Hell to seek more strength while experiencing life and death situation. If you were able to leave Inferno Hell alive, you would definitely become a powerful man. But if you were killed, it was just your destiny.
“When is the next time the doorway opens?”
Jiang Chen asked. He didn’t want to stay here for too long. Yan Chenyu and Han Yan were still waiting for him to return, and he would leave this place immediately upon reaching his goal.
“Another three months.”
Tian Yishan said.
Jiang Chen nodded his months, three months was considered a short amount of time. He was here for the Earth Devil, but he had yet to receive any news about this demon.
When thinking about the Earth Devil, Jiang Chen couldn’t help but ask, “Brother Tian, do you know if there are any Earth Devils in Inferno Hell?”
“Earth Devil?”

Tian Yishan was startled, but he immediately though about something, and his expression changed, “There is a mighty monster king living in the deepest part of Inferno Hell, and it calls itself the Earth Devil. I heard that this being is a legendary existence, and even the fiercest devil has to obey its commands. It’s very frightening, but I’ve never seen it before. Of course, with my strength, it would be able to kill me with nothing but a breath if I bumped into it.”

“That’s it, that must be the Earth Devil. The Earth Devil is an Earth element devil, and it possesses the purest devil source. Considering the fact that it’s a royal descendant of the royal devil, its bloodline is extremely noble. That’s why no matter how fierce a devil is, it’ll have to obey its command. Brother Tian, do you know what cultivation realm this Earth Devil has reached?”
Jiang Chen seemed excited. Finally, he had received new about the Earth Devil.
“This creature you’re looking for is the king of Inferno Hell, and it’s at the Combat Soul realm. Jiang Chen, don’t tell me you’re looking for this devil? I hope you can give up this idea.”
Tian Yishan warned.
“What? Combat Soul realm?!”

Jiang Chen and Big Yellow shouted out in shock at the same time, and both their faces darkened. They never expected this Earth Devil to be so powerful. There was no way for them to defeat an Earth Devil at the Combat Soul realm. Dealing with an Earth Devil was completely different than dealing with Firethorn Savage; when faced with an extremely powerful creature, no crafty plots of strategies would work. No matter how strong a Heavenly Core warrior was, there was no way for him to deal with a Combat Soul opponent. This was a fact that no one doubted.
“Buddy, what should we do now? I think our plan has been ruined.”
Big Yellow said.

“No matter what, this is considered good news for us. As long as there is an Earth Devil here, it is good news. As for how we’re going to kill it... we’ll need to come up with a plan along the way. Don’t forget, we were in the same situation when we decided to kill Firethorn Savage.”
Jiang Chen said with a smile on his face.
“That’s because we set up a trap using the Green Sanctuary Sect. Who are we going to frame this time? Besides, I don’t think there is anyone here who are actually stronger than this Earth Devil.”
Big Yellow rolled his eyes.

“Let’s proceed to Inferno City and rescue Guan Yiyun. We’ll talk about the Earth Devil after that. Since we’ve come to Inferno Hell, we’ll have to utilize the environment to push our cultivation to new boundaries. Big Yellow, you’ll have to work harder as well, it’s very difficult to survive in this place when you’re just a Heavenly Core beast.”

Jiang Chen said. It wasn’t until he came to Inferno Hell that he realized how small the Qi Province was. In the Qi Province, a Divine Core warrior was a man who sat on a high throne, and a peak Divine Core warrior was like an immortal existence. But in all other big provinces, although Divine Core did have a somewhat prestigious status, their numbers were far greater than the Qi Province.
“Heavens! Brother Jiang, don’t tell me your purpose for coming here was the Earth Devil?”

Tian Yishan was stunned. This was simply an impossible mission, the Earth Devil was simply too powerful. A Combat Soul Earth Devil, even the Combat Soul warrior in Inferno City wouldn’t be its match at all.
“That’s right, I need the Earth Devil’s demon soul to save a friend. Let’s not talk about this right now, we need to get to Inferno City as quickly as possible.”
Jiang Chen said.

Along the way, the trio bumped into some demons and devils, but none of them could withstand more than a single blow from Jiang Chen, and all of them were killed on the spot. Tian Yishan was really surprised by Jiang Chen’s strength, he had never seen a Heavenly Core warrior that could be so powerful. If he hadn’t witnessed it by himself, he never would have believed it, even if he was beaten to death.

Jiang Chen had also gone through all three storage rings that he had taken from the three men had previously killed. There were pills, demons souls, devils souls, and even some crystal cores stored within. All these things were great for Jiang Chen.
“Looks like we need to rob more people in future.”
Jiang Chen said with a smile on his face.

Inferno City was located right in the center of Inferno Hell. It was a huge city which covered more than a few hundred miles in circumference. It looked like a historical city with dolled colors, scars and marks everywhere. It was the remains of time, which proved that Inferno City had been around for a long period of time. At least, it had been here since the discovery of Inferno Hell.
“Jiang Chen, cultivators are forbidden from flying in the city. Let’s descend here.”
Tian Yishan said as they floated outside the city.
“Alright.”
Jiang Chen nodded his head. The trio landed on the ground and walked towards Inferno City’s main gate.

Inferno City’s main gate was actually a huge breach on the city wall, and it didn’t fit the standards of a city gate. Big Yellow looked through the main gate, then his expression became a focused one, and his ears stood up.
“Big Yellow, what did you discover?”
Jiang Chen hurriedly asked through his Divine Sense. There was only reason why this dog behaved like this, and that was when he sensed some treasure.
“There are hidden treasures in this city, I can sense it.”
Big Yellow’s tail begun wagging.
“What is it?”
Jiang Chen asked.

“I don’t know, but I’m sure there are some treasures here! I was thinking about why those demons and devils don’t attack Inferno City, there must be some reason behind it, and perhaps it’s related to this hidden treasure.”
Big Yellow said.
“Looks like there really is a treasure here.”
Jiang Chen’s eyes lit up.
“Don’t get too excited so early, the treasure is hidden right in the center of Inferno City. With out current strength and abilities, there’s no way we can go there.”
Big Yellow dampened Jiang Chen’s enthusiasm.
“Stop right there.”
Right at this moment, four middle-aged men leapt out from hiding, blocking Jiang Chen’s path.
“You two, hand over all your belongings now! If not, don’t blame us for attacking you!”
A man with a ferocious scar on his face threatened them.

Looking at this, Jiang Chen burst out into laughter. Pretty good luck for them to bump into some robbers right as they arrive in the city. These four men had pretty strong cultivation bases, all of them were Early Divine Core warriors. However, trying to rob Jiang Chen with those mere cultivation bases, it was a funny joke.

“Brother Jiang, welcome to the chaotic Inferno City. There are people who group together and hide outside the main gate, and when they see someone with weaker cultivation bases than themselves, or the ones who come here for the first time, they will strike and rob them. These men are really smart, the know about all the alliances, and their strengths, in details. They know who can be offended and who can’t be offended like the back of their palm.”
Tian Yishan said.
“Interesting, it seems they consider me a newcomer. Since they want to rob us, we won’t have to be polite with them.”

Jiang Chen shrugged his shoulder, then he looked at Big Yellow. Big Yellow instantly understood what he wanted, so he took a step forwards and said, “You four! Hand over all your belongings to us! If not, this master dog will get angry!”

sentences.text: Earthly Demon Beast > Earth Devil
Chapter 206 - Master Dog will get Angry
After receiving help from Jiang Chen’s Revival Pill, Tian Yishan’s injuries had recovered a lot.
At least, he was much stronger than before.
Of course, it would still take him some time to fully recover.
Two men and a dog flew up into the skies.
Under Tian Yishan’s guidance, the flew towards Inferno City.
“Inferno City is located in the center of Inferno Hell, we won’t bump into too many powerful demons or devils if we fly in this direction.

Unless we’re unlucky and bump into some demon beasts that lives in huge groups, the real danger of Inferno Hell is in the deepest parts of Inferno Hell, which is located on the other side of Inferno City.”
Tian Yishan said.
Jiang Chen and Big Yellow immediately looked at each other, it seemed like they had pretty bad luck, as they had bumped into a huge group of demon beasts right after arriving.
“Since there aren’t many powerful demon beasts along the way, let’s speed up and rush to Inferno City.”
Jiang Chen said.
“Alright.
Yang Shuo is a mean and cruel guy, he knows many insane torture techniques.
The longer junior disciple Guan is with them, the more he will suffer from torture, and his life might end at any time.”
Tian Yishan seemed worried.
He and Guan Yiyun were both from the Black Sect, and after spending some time together, they had built up a good relationship.
Tian Yishan was a man who cherished friendship, that’s why he worried so much about Guan Yiyun’s safety after he had been captured by their enemies.
“Are there many groups in Inferno City?”
Jiang Chen asked.
“Yes, there are all sorts of groups in there.
Many people group together in an alliance.
Besides, Inferno City is a huge place, and with our strength, we were only able to find a place to stay around its perimeter.
There is no way for us to stay inside the city.
I heard there is a Combat Soul warrior residing within the city.
There are often days where trading is going on in the city, and it’s only during these days that Inferno City will be in peace.
It’s a rule set by the Combat Soul warrior, so nobody dares attack and rob during these trading days.”
Tian Yishan said.
“Combat Soul warrior.”

Jiang Chen felt surprised, he didn’t expect the Inferno Hell had such a huge attraction that even a Combat Soul warrior was here, the more Tian Yishan explained, the greater interest he had to this Inferno City.
Jiang Chen was here, the chaotic Inferno Hell would definitely become even more chaotic.
Jiang Chen’s arrival was the same as a devil incarnate descending from the skies.
“Since the doorway to Inferno Hell only opens up once a year, it’ll make more and more people come to Inferno City.
Besides, there are many people who doesn’t want to leave Inferno Hell when the doorway opens, and they’re mostly the vicious men who were exiled to this place.
Without powerful strength, they would be killed immediately upon leaving this place.
New people come here every day, and people die every day as well.”
Tian Yishan said.
Jiang Chen understood the situation.
Although people from the Qi Province feared Inferno Hell, there were still millions of people across all 28 provinces in the Eastern Continent.
Countless people were exiled to this place, and numerous people came here to improve their cultivation.
Compared to the other powerful provinces, the Qi Province was the weakest, doesn’t matter if you judge from population, or strength.
Those powerful sects in the other biggest provinces would send their disciple to Inferno Hell to seek more strength while experiencing life and death situation.
If you were able to leave Inferno Hell alive, you would definitely become a powerful man.
But if you were killed, it was just your destiny.
“When is the next time the doorway opens?”
Jiang Chen asked.
He didn’t want to stay here for too long.
Yan Chenyu and Han Yan were still waiting for him to return, and he would leave this place immediately upon reaching his goal.
“Another three months.”
Tian Yishan said.
Jiang Chen nodded his months, three months was considered a short amount of time.
He was here for the Earth Devil, but he had yet to receive any news about this demon.
When thinking about the Earth Devil, Jiang Chen couldn’t help but ask, “Brother Tian, do you know if there are any Earth Devils in Inferno Hell?”
“Earth Devil?”

Tian Yishan was startled, but he immediately though about something, and his expression changed, “There is a mighty monster king living in the deepest part of Inferno Hell, and it calls itself the Earth Devil.
I heard that this being is a legendary existence, and even the fiercest devil has to obey its commands.
It’s very frightening, but I’ve never seen it before.
Of course, with my strength, it would be able to kill me with nothing but a breath if I bumped into it.”
“That’s it, that must be the Earth Devil.
The Earth Devil is an Earth element devil, and it possesses the purest devil source.
Considering the fact that it’s a royal descendant of the royal devil, its bloodline is extremely noble.
That’s why no matter how fierce a devil is, it’ll have to obey its command.
Brother Tian, do you know what cultivation realm this Earth Devil has reached?”
Jiang Chen seemed excited.
Finally, he had received new about the Earth Devil.
“This creature you’re looking for is the king of Inferno Hell, and it’s at the Combat Soul realm.
Jiang Chen, don’t tell me you’re looking for this devil?
I hope you can give up this idea.”
Tian Yishan warned.
“What?
Combat Soul realm?!”
Jiang Chen and Big Yellow shouted out in shock at the same time, and both their faces darkened.
They never expected this Earth Devil to be so powerful.
There was no way for them to defeat an Earth Devil at the Combat Soul realm.
Dealing with an Earth Devil was completely different than dealing with Firethorn Savage; when faced with an extremely powerful creature, no crafty plots of strategies would work.
No matter how strong a Heavenly Core warrior was, there was no way for him to deal with a Combat Soul opponent.
This was a fact that no one doubted.
“Buddy, what should we do now?
I think our plan has been ruined.”
Big Yellow said.
“No matter what, this is considered good news for us.
As long as there is an Earth Devil here, it is good news.
As for how we’re going to kill it... we’ll need to come up with a plan along the way.
Don’t forget, we were in the same situation when we decided to kill Firethorn Savage.”
Jiang Chen said with a smile on his face.
“That’s because we set up a trap using the Green Sanctuary Sect.
Who are we going to frame this time?
Besides, I don’t think there is anyone here who are actually stronger than this Earth Devil.”
Big Yellow rolled his eyes.
“Let’s proceed to Inferno City and rescue Guan Yiyun.
We’ll talk about the Earth Devil after that.
Since we’ve come to Inferno Hell, we’ll have to utilize the environment to push our cultivation to new boundaries.
Big Yellow, you’ll have to work harder as well, it’s very difficult to survive in this place when you’re just a Heavenly Core beast.”
Jiang Chen said.
It wasn’t until he came to Inferno Hell that he realized how small the Qi Province was.
In the Qi Province, a Divine Core warrior was a man who sat on a high throne, and a peak Divine Core warrior was like an immortal existence.
But in all other big provinces, although Divine Core did have a somewhat prestigious status, their numbers were far greater than the Qi Province.
“Heavens!
Brother Jiang, don’t tell me your purpose for coming here was the Earth Devil?”
Tian Yishan was stunned.
This was simply an impossible mission, the Earth Devil was simply too powerful.
A Combat Soul Earth Devil, even the Combat Soul warrior in Inferno City wouldn’t be its match at all.
“That’s right, I need the Earth Devil’s demon soul to save a friend.
Let’s not talk about this right now, we need to get to Inferno City as quickly as possible.”
Jiang Chen said.
Along the way, the trio bumped into some demons and devils, but none of them could withstand more than a single blow from Jiang Chen, and all of them were killed on the spot.
Tian Yishan was really surprised by Jiang Chen’s strength, he had never seen a Heavenly Core warrior that could be so powerful.
If he hadn’t witnessed it by himself, he never would have believed it, even if he was beaten to death.
Jiang Chen had also gone through all three storage rings that he had taken from the three men had previously killed.
There were pills, demons souls, devils souls, and even some crystal cores stored within.
All these things were great for Jiang Chen.
“Looks like we need to rob more people in future.”
Jiang Chen said with a smile on his face.
Inferno City was located right in the center of Inferno Hell.
It was a huge city which covered more than a few hundred miles in circumference.
It looked like a historical city with dolled colors, scars and marks everywhere.
It was the remains of time, which proved that Inferno City had been around for a long period of time.
At least, it had been here since the discovery of Inferno Hell.
“Jiang Chen, cultivators are forbidden from flying in the city.
Let’s descend here.”
Tian Yishan said as they floated outside the city.
“Alright.”
Jiang Chen nodded his head.
The trio landed on the ground and walked towards Inferno City’s main gate.
Inferno City’s main gate was actually a huge breach on the city wall, and it didn’t fit the standards of a city gate.
Big Yellow looked through the main gate, then his expression became a focused one, and his ears stood up.
“Big Yellow, what did you discover?”
Jiang Chen hurriedly asked through his Divine Sense.
There was only reason why this dog behaved like this, and that was when he sensed some treasure.
“There are hidden treasures in this city, I can sense it.”
Big Yellow’s tail begun wagging.
“What is it?”
Jiang Chen asked.
“I don’t know, but I’m sure there are some treasures here!
I was thinking about why those demons and devils don’t attack Inferno City, there must be some reason behind it, and perhaps it’s related to this hidden treasure.”
Big Yellow said.
“Looks like there really is a treasure here.”
Jiang Chen’s eyes lit up.
“Don’t get too excited so early, the treasure is hidden right in the center of Inferno City.
With out current strength and abilities, there’s no way we can go there.”
Big Yellow dampened Jiang Chen’s enthusiasm.
“Stop right there.”
Right at this moment, four middle-aged men leapt out from hiding, blocking Jiang Chen’s path.
“You two, hand over all your belongings now!
If not, don’t blame us for attacking you!”
A man with a ferocious scar on his face threatened them.
Looking at this, Jiang Chen burst out into laughter.
Pretty good luck for them to bump into some robbers right as they arrive in the city.
These four men had pretty strong cultivation bases, all of them were Early Divine Core warriors.
However, trying to rob Jiang Chen with those mere cultivation bases, it was a funny joke.
“Brother Jiang, welcome to the chaotic Inferno City.

There are people who group together and hide outside the main gate, and when they see someone with weaker cultivation bases than themselves, or the ones who come here for the first time, they will strike and rob them.
These men are really smart, the know about all the alliances, and their strengths, in details.
They know who can be offended and who can’t be offended like the back of their palm.”
Tian Yishan said.
“Interesting, it seems they consider me a newcomer.
Since they want to rob us, we won’t have to be polite with them.”
Jiang Chen shrugged his shoulder, then he looked at Big Yellow.
Big Yellow instantly understood what he wanted, so he took a step forwards and said, “You four!
Hand over all your belongings to us!
If not, this master dog will get angry!”

chapters.title: Chapter 207 - Fury
paragraphs: The four men stared at the mighty big yellow dog in front of them, startled.
“What the fuck?! How could a dog be so aggressive?”

“Hey, what the fuck? We are the ones robbing you, not the other away around! Look carefully at the current situation and the difference between our strengths! Hurry up, hand over all your belongings, and we will spare your lives. If not... well, it’s perfectly normal for people to die in Inferno Hell.”

The four men were extremely aggressive. They had found out the cultivation levels of their targets, two Heavenly Core warriors that they were not worried about at all, and one Divine Core warrior whose energy was in a mess. Obviously, he was badly wounded, so they didn’t need to worry about him either. This group was just an easy target that walked up to their doorstep. They would be struck by thunder if they let them go just like that.
“Are you sure you want to rob me?”
Jiang Chen tried to confirm it again.
“Damn it, looks like this kid doesn’t even know how to judge a situation. Let’s teach him a lesson! Brothers, let’s do it, strip everything they got!”
The man who looked like their leader of this group shouted out loudly. Four men dashed towards Jiang Chen at the same time.
Bang bang bang...

Sounds of punches sounded out from the scene. In just a few breaths of time, Jiang Chen, Big Yellow, and Tian Yishan left the place, walking towards the main gate, and leaving behind the four aggressive men.
The four men stared back at the trio, and they could stop themselves from crying.
This was too mean, couldn’t they just leave them some clothes? How could they meet other people like this?

The four men left leaving behind a glorious image. They were robbed off everything, and were standing naked in the shivering breeze while covering their crotches with both hands. All of them had panda eyes and looked really miserable.
“Boss, this is all your fault! Why did you ask us to strip them off everything they got? If you hadn’t done that, perhaps we would still have our clothes now!”
“Don’t say any more. Don’t we still have extra clothes in our storage rings?”
“Damn it, our storage rings were taken away as well! Now we are left with two balls that might be worth some money...”
“Sigh! The fish which nibbles at every bait will eventually be caught. Why was that young man so strong? Was he really just a Heavenly Core warrior?”

The four naked men were standing straightly in the cold breeze. The shivering wind kept blowing at their crotches. It was a miserable encounter for these four Divine Core warriors, but luckily, they were still alive at least.
“Kaka, Little Chen, you’re so fierce, you should have at least left them with their underpants.”
Inside Inferno City, Big Yellow was laughing with joy as he stared at the burning clothes in front of him.
“They are lucky I didn’t kill them.”
Jiang Chen gave Big Yellow a smile. He turned around and looked at Tian Yishan, then he said, “Brother Tian, where are Guan Yiyun and the other men?”
“It’s very easy to find them in the outer perimeter. Yan Shuo has occupied our previous stronghold, and I’m guessing he’s keeping junior disciple Guan there. Let me lead you there quietly.”
Tian Yishan said.
“Alright.”

Jiang Chen nodded his head and followed Tian Yishan as they began rushing towards the stronghold. There was no difference between night and day in Inferno Hell, as the there was no sun or moon, and the skies had the same color all day long. It was depressing sight.
Soon after, Tian Yishan led Jiang Chen to a manor. The manor wasn’t huge, but there was a historical feeling to it.

“There is a secret chamber in the manor, and if my guess is correct, they should be keeping junior disciple Guan in that secret chamber. I know of an entrance behind the secret chamber, we can enter directly from there. Let’s not alert Yang Shuo and his men, let’s first get our men out. If not, once we engage in a fight, junior disciple Guan and the other men might lose their lives.”
Tian Yishan said. He was a man with careful thoughts as well.
Behind the manor, a majestic demon lord was laying in front of the entrance to the secret chamber. It was at the peak Heavenly Core realm, and it had a pair of fierce eyes.
“This demon beast was caught by Yang Shuo, he’s using it to guard the door.”
Tian Yishan said.
“Kill this demon beast and enter the secret chamber.”

Right as Jiang Chen finished speaking, Big Yellow turned into a beam of light. With extremely great speed, he opened up his big mouth and cut the throat of this demon beast with his razor sharp teeth and killed it on the spot. Its blood was splashing all over the place, but not even a single sound was made.

Tian Yishan was shocked. He had never seen Big Yellow attack before, so he didn’t think this dog was so powerful. He could actually kill a peak Heavenly Core demon lord in an instant. But, in the next second, he felt like it did make sense. Since Jiang Chen was so mighty, a dog following him would not be weak either.

The trio opened up the narrow back door and snuck in. Behind the door, there was a tunnel which lead downwards. It was pretty dark inside. At the end of the tunnel, there was an underground secret chamber.
Ahh!!

Not long after they walked in, Jiang Chen began hearing some horrible screams from the secret chamber. The screams didn’t seem to stop, and it really gave them an eerie feeling. It wasn’t hard for them to imagine what kind of pain the men inside were experiencing.
“It’s Guan Yiyun!.”
Jiang Chen’s expression became stern. He had heard Guan Yiyun’s voice from the screams just now. He couldn’t bear it any longer, and his killing intent was unleashed from his body.
Right now, inside the underground secret chamber.

This was a huge secret chamber, and cruel torturing was being carried out right now. It was a horrible scene. Right in the middle of the secret chamber, seven men with naked upper bodies were tied onto some iron poles. Their bodies were covered with blood, their skin was split and flesh broke forth. Horrible scars could be seen everywhere, and blood kept leaking out from their terrible wounds.
Right in front of them, a luxuriously dressed adult man was sitting on a bamboo chair, pleasantly watching the ongoing torturing as if he was viewing the nicest scenery.
“Bastard! Kill us now if you dare, kill us now!”

A young man in his mid twenties roared out. He kept spitting out blood as he let out horrible roars. He had the most wounds and scars on his body, and his vision was blurring. Obviously, even with his Divine Core cultivation base, he was going to pass out after going through such cruel torture for a long period of time.
This man was Guan Yiyun.
“You want me to kill you? Not that simple! You have offended young master Yang Shuo, and that is a crime that deserves eternal torture! Men, give me something more explosive!”
The adult man said.

There were four of Yang Shuo’s men in the secret chamber, but they were only peak Heavenly Core warriors. When they heard the adult man’s words, a ferocious smile emerged on all their faces. One of them took out a palm-sized tube, then he walked up to Guan Yiyun and opened the tube. Immediately, a pure red snake swam out from it. The snake sent forth a pungent smell which told that it carried a deadly poison
“Guan Yiyun, this is a King Serpent. I think you should have heard of it before.”

The man said with a hideous smile on his face. After that, he placed the poisonous snake on Guan Yiyun’s body. When the snake smelled the blood, it immediately went towards one of the wounds on Guan Yiyun’s body, and tried its best to penetrate itself into his wound.
Ahhh!!

Even the toughest men wouldn’t be able to withstand this kind of pain. Guan Yiyun instantly let out a terrifying cry. A sizzling sound could be heard from his body, and his skin quickly turned into a dark purple color. The pain coming from the corrosion was not something ordinary people could imagine.
Ahh!!
At the same time, terrifying screams once again sounded out throughout the entire secret chamber.
“I can’t take it anymore!”

Someone let out a painful shout and completely silent afterwards. The deadly poison from the King Serpent was not something anybody could resist. Besides, all of them were severely injured. The pain they were experiencing was unimaginable.
“Hahaha...”

The adult man who was sitting in a bamboo chair let out a pleasant laugh, as if this kind of creepy scream was the most beautiful melody in this world. The pleasant feeling brought to him by torturing people could really satisfy his twisted mind, and he had learnt all this from Yang Shuo.

Right at this moment, three figures appeared in the secret chamber. When Jiang Chen looked at Guan Yiyun, flames of fury exploded forth in his eyes, and he was unable to restrain his anger any longer.
“Who are you?
When the adult man saw the uninvited guests, his expression immediately became cold.
“The man who is going kill you.”

Jiang Chen’s body swayed, and he arrived in front of the adult man in an instant. He clenched his palm onto the man’s throat, causing the man to feel like there was a gigantic mountain pressing him, making it so that he couldn’t even breath properly.
“Big Yellow, Yishan, capture all these men, but do not kill them.”
Jiang Chen ordered.
“Understood!”
Tian Yishan replied as he immediately dashed forwards. The four Heavenly Core warriors were no match for Tian Yishan and Big Yellow, they were pressed onto the ground in an instant.
“Junior disciple Guan.”
Tian Yishan walked up to Guan Yiyun and hurriedly broke the iron chains on his body, then he helped him down.
“Senior disciple Tian, why did you come back?”
Guan Yiyun kept throwing up blood as he spoke. His life force was getting weaker and weaker.
“Junior disciple Guan, look who is here to save you!”
Tian Yishan said.
Jiang Chen threw the adult man onto the floor, then he walked up to Guan Yiyun.
“Senior disciple Guan, I’m here to rescue you.”
Jiang Chen said with a smile on his face.
“Junior disciple Jiang, it really is you...”
Cough cough...
When Guan Yiyun saw that Jiang Chen had come to his rescue, a joyful expression emerged on his face. But, he had no idea why Jiang Chen had come to Inferno Hell, or why he was with Tian Yishan.
“Don’t speak right now.”

Jiang Chen placed his palm onto Guan Yiyun’s body. With a powerful force, he sucked out the King Cobra and all the deadly poison in Guan Yiyun’s body. After that, Jiang Chen threw out his hand and sucked out all King Cobras and poison from the other men.
Witnessing this, Tian Yishan was stunned once again. It was a deadly poison, and Jiang Chen had absorbed it all into his body, and he was still not affected by it. This was really frightening.
Ahh!!
Guan Yiyun let out another horrible cry, then he passed out instantly. When a man was relieved from a long, tense situation, he would immediately pass out.
“Brother Jiang, junior disciple Guan’s condition is really serious.”
Tian Yishan said. He glanced at the rest of the men, and all of them seemed to be have the same serious conditions. None of them could remain conscious right now, they had all passed out.
“Hmph! An eye for an eye, I’ll serve them the same treatment, and let them taste the feeling of having deadly poison in their bodies!”
Jiang Chen let out a cold snort. He was covered in flames of fury, he was really furious right now. Since the enemies were so cruel, he would pay them back with an crueler approach.
Jiang Chen glared at the few men who were laying on the floor, then a hideous grin emerged on his face.

Guan Yiyun instantly let out a terrifying cry.
A sizzling sound could be heard from his body, and his skin quickly turned into a dark purple color.
The pain coming from the corrosion was not something ordinary people could imagine.
Ahh!!
At the same time, terrifying screams once again sounded out throughout the entire secret chamber.
“I can’t take it anymore!”
Someone let out a painful shout and completely silent afterwards.
The deadly poison from the King Serpent was not something anybody could resist.
Besides, all of them were severely injured.
The pain they were experiencing was unimaginable.
“Hahaha...”
The adult man who was sitting in a bamboo chair let out a pleasant laugh, as if this kind of creepy scream was the most beautiful melody in this world.
The pleasant feeling brought to him by torturing people could really satisfy his twisted mind, and he had learnt all this from Yang Shuo.
Right at this moment, three figures appeared in the secret chamber.
When Jiang Chen looked at Guan Yiyun, flames of fury exploded forth in his eyes, and he was unable to restrain his anger any longer.
“Who are you?
When the adult man saw the uninvited guests, his expression immediately became cold.
“The man who is going kill you.”
Jiang Chen’s body swayed, and he arrived in front of the adult man in an instant.
He clenched his palm onto the man’s throat, causing the man to feel like there was a gigantic mountain pressing him, making it so that he couldn’t even breath properly.
“Big Yellow, Yishan, capture all these men, but do not kill them.”
Jiang Chen ordered.
“Understood!”
Tian Yishan replied as he immediately dashed forwards.
The four Heavenly Core warriors were no match for Tian Yishan and Big Yellow, they were pressed onto the ground in an instant.
“Junior disciple Guan.”
Tian Yishan walked up to Guan Yiyun and hurriedly broke the iron chains on his body, then he helped him down.
“Senior disciple Tian, why did you come back?”
Guan Yiyun kept throwing up blood as he spoke.
His life force was getting weaker and weaker.
“Junior disciple Guan, look who is here to save you!”
Tian Yishan said.
Jiang Chen threw the adult man onto the floor, then he walked up to Guan Yiyun.
“Senior disciple Guan, I’m here to rescue you.”
Jiang Chen said with a smile on his face.
“Junior disciple Jiang, it really is you...”
Cough cough...
When Guan Yiyun saw that Jiang Chen had come to his rescue, a joyful expression emerged on his face.
But, he had no idea why Jiang Chen had come to Inferno Hell, or why he was with Tian Yishan.
“Don’t speak right now.”
Jiang Chen placed his palm onto Guan Yiyun’s body.
With a powerful force, he sucked out the King Cobra and all the deadly poison in Guan Yiyun’s body.
After that, Jiang Chen threw out his hand and sucked out all King Cobras and poison from the other men.
Witnessing this, Tian Yishan was stunned once again.
It was a deadly poison, and Jiang Chen had absorbed it all into his body, and he was still not affected by it.
This was really frightening.
Ahh!!
Guan Yiyun let out another horrible cry, then he passed out instantly.
When a man was relieved from a long, tense situation, he would immediately pass out.
“Brother Jiang, junior disciple Guan’s condition is really serious.”
Tian Yishan said.
He glanced at the rest of the men, and all of them seemed to be have the same serious conditions.
None of them could remain conscious right now, they had all passed out.
“Hmph!
An eye for an eye, I’ll serve them the same treatment, and let them taste the feeling of having deadly poison in their bodies!”
Jiang Chen let out a cold snort.
He was covered in flames of fury, he was really furious right now.
Since the enemies were so cruel, he would pay them back with an crueler approach.
Jiang Chen glared at the few men who were laying on the floor, then a hideous grin emerged on his face.

chapters.title: Chapter 208 - Wicked and Merciless
paragraphs: “You, what do you want to do?”
The adult man was freaked out, he could sense fierceness and danger from Jiang Chen’s gaze.
“What you have done to them, I will do to you.”
The hideous smile on Jiang Chen’s face became bigger and bigger, striking terror into their heads.
“Who are you? Do you have any idea where this place is? This is young master Yang Shuo’s territory! If you offend him, you’ll die without a burial ground!”
The adult man threatened.

But this kind of threat was useless against Jiang Chen, the evil smile on Jiang Chen’s face wasn’t shaken at all. He extended his palm, then a green light appeared on all five fingertips. The lights flickered like beautiful snakes. The man however, he could sense a shivering danger from the lights, enough danger to make his soul tremble.
Tian Yishan placed Guan Yiyun on the floor and set the other men free. Due to suffering from serious injuries, all of them had passed out, and two of them had forever lost their breath.
Sigh...

Tian Yishan let out a heavy sigh, a painful look of grief emerged on his face. These men had followed him for quite some time, and although they were only in an alliance to increase their chances of survival, they had actually established a pretty solid relationship between each other. Watching them die in such a horrible way made him feel really bad.
“Two died, and the rest are seriously injured.”

Tian Yishan glared at the five men on the floor as he spoke in a vicious manner. After that, he looked at the green lights on Jiang Chen’s fingertips. His words just now were for Jiang Chen, because if he wanted to fight young master Yang Shuo and bring justice to his men, he would need Jiang Chen’s help.
“Today, I’ll kill them all, no mercy.”
Jiang Chen spoke fiercely. With just one sentence from him, the temperature in the secret chamber had dropped. Jiang Chen took a step forwards and arrived in front of the peak Heavenly Core warrior.
“You, what are you trying to do?”

The frightened man was trembling all over his body. This young man in front of him was too frightening. Their leader couldn’t even withstand a single attack from him, they were like sheep waiting to be slaughtered by Jiang Chen.

“What am I trying to do? I’ll do the same as you did to them. I’ll cut open your skin, and inject deadly poison into your bloodstream. Oh, I forgot to tell you, the poison on my fingertips is the poison of the Green Hellish Python. Also, it has been mixed with the deadly poisons from the Silent Poisonous Needle. I don’t know whether or not you have heard about the needle before, so I’ll tell you. It’s a poisonous needle made from 49 poisonous herbs, and now I’m going to use this poison on you. I wonder how long you can last, before you die.”
Jiang Chen spoke without any emotions. Although he sounded calm, his words were like a lightning strike to these people.

They might not have heard about the Silent Poisonous Needle, but they were surely familiar with the Green Hellish Python. Its poison was far more poisonous than that of the King Serpent. Furthermore, it was mixed with other poisons as well. At this moment, everyone including the Divine Core warriors, had a change in expression.
“Kaka, I’m guessing they won’t last more than a minute!”
Big Yellow let out a hearty laughter.
“I had the same thoughts.”
Tian Yishan said with a grin on his face.
“Buddy, let me help you.”

After saying that, Big Yellow leapt onto one of the man and bit down on the man’s chest with his sharp teeth. Followed by a tearing sound and shrill scream, a deep wound was drawn out on the man’s chest. His skin was ripped apart, and he was bleeding nonstop.
Swoosh!
At the same time, Jiang Chen crooked his finger and shout out a green light, which went right into the man’s wound.
Hsss...
The deadly poison was tremendously good at corroding, it turned the red blood into black blood in an instant.
Ahh!!

The man let out a shrilling scream, it was absolutely terrifying, and it didn’t sound like it was coming from a human. Just from the scream itself, only could easily tell what kind of pain this man was suffering. This simply was one of the cruelest torture methods in the world.

Soon, the poison penetrated into the man’s hurt, and made the entire body black. All his flesh ad blood was severely corroded, and the man had become completely silent. He just laid motionlessly on the floor, even his eyeballs had melted because of the deadly poison.

The Green Hellish Python’s poison was a violent poison. Normally, just touching it would make a person feel extremely bad, and risk dying. And if the poison was injected into one’s bloodstream, even the Yuan energy wouldn’t be able to resist it. The deadly poison would penetrate into all internal organs and kill the man.

The outer four men had been keeping silent like cicadas in the cold weather upon seeing Jiang Chen using the deadly Green Hellish Python’s poison. Now, when they saw their man being killed by it, they were even more frightened. Three Heavenly Core warriors were trembling nonstop with terrified expressions and cold sweat dripping down from their faces.
The Divine Core adult man couldn’t resist this kind of fear either. His face became extremely dark, and he breathed rapidly.

Terrifying, this was extremely terrifying. Being killed like this was simply too cruel. Witnessing this torture, and knowing that it would soon be his turn... It was a feeling no one could understand.
“Your turn.”
Jiang Chen said in a casual manner with a calm smile on his face, as if killing someone was something very normal to him.
But in these men’s eyes, Jiang Chen’s smile was like the smile of the devil. All of them were cruel and fierce, but compared to this young man in front of them, they couldn’t even be called ruthless.
Jiang Chen walked up to another Heavenly Core warrior.
“Big Yellow.”

Right as Jiang Chen’s words left his mouth, Big Yellow leapt onto the man and tore a big wound on the man’s chest with his sharp teeth. Once again, Jiang Chen shot out the green light from his finger into the wound, causing the man to let out a shrill cry. Soon afterwards, he followed the footsteps of the previous man and died on the spot.
Jiang Chen didn’t look at the dead body, he just walked towards the third man.
“No, please don’t...”
The man extremely terrified. Everyone were scared of death, even if there were some who weren’t afraid of death in Inferno Hell, no one would want to be killed like this. This was really terrifying.
Slash!

It was useless to beg right now. Big Yellow was not slow at all, once again, he tore open a wound on the man’s chest. The pleasant feeling of kill someone had made Big Yellow start bouncing up and down with excitement. Tian Yishan who was stand next to them felt his anger easing off by a lot. All these men deserved a thousand deaths, they deserved the cruelest torture in this world.

At the same time, Tian Yishan was once again shocked by Jiang Chen’s approach. This man was really a peerless genius that couldn’t be found once even in a thousand years. Not only did he possess mighty combat strength, he also knew how to attack with poison.
“Ahh!! Young man, if you dare kill me, young master Yang Shuo won’t let you go for sure! You can’t even dream about walking out of this stronghold alive!”

The man with two red eyes shouted towards Jiang Chen. His voice was extremely loud, and he shouted using his Yuan energy. With this, the men outside the secret chamber would be able to hear his voice.
Obviously, the man wasn’t trying to threaten Jiang Chen, he was actually signaling for help.

“I’m sorry, but I’m not leaving this stronghold today, because I’m going to occupy it. None of your friends will be able to leave here alive, all of them will die. Same goes for that Yang Shuo. Compared to you, his death will be much more miserable. Don’t worry, your turn will soon come up. With your cultivation level, I’m sure you’ll be able to withstand the poison for a longer time than the others, and you will be able to taste pain for a much longer time.”
Jiang Chen said with a smile on his face, the smile of a devil.

Guan Yiyun’s miserable condition had made him furious. He had decided to kill that young master Yang Shuo today. Besides, since he had just arrived at Inferno City, he needed to establish his dignity and status here.
Ahh!!
The last Heavenly Core warrior let out a frightening roar. He threw up a mouthful of blood, he had actually shattered all his internal organs with his own Yuan energy, he had committed suicide.
It took huge courage for someone to commit suicide, especially for a cultivator.
But when facing Jiang Chen’s horrifying approach, the man would rather kill himself than suffer. At least he would be able to die faster.
“You do have some guts.”
Jiang Chen said with a smile. Then, he turned to the last Divine Core man and said, “I’ll give you a chance to kill yourself.”
“Devil, you’re a devil!”

The adult man felt like his heart was going to break into pieces, he had never been so close to death. This young man only seemed to be in his late teens, but his approach was much more ruthless than Yang Shuo. Killing a man like it was nothing, that was extremely brutal.
“What’s going on?”

Right at this moment, a loud shout sounded out from outside the secret chamber. After that, four men appeared at the entrance on the other side of the secret chamber. When these four men saw what was going on within the secret chamber, their expressions instantly changed.
“Quickly, save me!”
The adult man who was lying on the floor felt like had grasped a life-saving straw, so he hastily screamed out for help.
“Who are you?”
The leading man asked as he stared at Jiang Chen. There was a long scar on his forehead, which might be a scar caused from a battle with some demon beasts. It made him look extremely ferocious.
Two of them were Early Divine Core warriors, and the other two were peak Heavenly Core warriors.

In Inferno Hell, the peak Heavenly Core realm was the weakest cultivation level, and they could only hope to survive in the outer perimeter of Inferno City. Entering Inferno Hell with an even lower cultivation level was simply the same as seeking death.
Jiang Chen didn’t bother with these four men. He took out a sharp sword which emitted a cold light and pointed it at the man’s chest.
Slash!

The tip of the sharp sword impaled the adult man’s chest. Jiang Chen started cutting downwards, and he did it slowly on purpose, making sure that everybody in the room could heard the sound of the sword cutting through the man’s flesh, and his blood leaking out bit by bit.
Ahh!!
The adult man let out a horrifying scream. He knew he was going to die, so a hopeless look emerged in his eyes.
“Stop it!”
One of the Early Divine Core warriors shouted out loudly. He immediately sprinted towards Jiang Chen with speed great as lightning.
Hmph!
Jiang Chen let out a cold snort. He pulled the longsword out off the man’s chest, and swung it back towards the Divine Core warrior who was rushing towards him.
Slash!

The razor sharp sword instantly sliced the Early Divine Core warrior in half, causing blood to splash all over the secret chamber. The two-part dead body was thrown not far away, and it was still struggling and moving after death.

chapters.title: Chapter 209 - Slaughter
paragraphs: Roar!

Everyone had a change in their expression. When the three men who were in great rage and were getting ready to storm in saw the Early Divine Core warrior being chopped in half by Jiang Chen, they were immediately scared and stopped their movements.
“Enemy attack! Enemy attack!”

The three of them immediately turned around and alarmed the others as they fled towards the inner parts of the stronghold. They were scared they would get sliced in half if they ran too slowly, so none of them even bothered caring about the adult man’s safety.
Looking at this, the adult man who had his chest pierced by Jiang Chen’s sword had lost all hope. This young man in front of him was too terrifying, there was no way he would spare his life.
Swoosh!
Jiang Chen waved his hand and unleashed a beam of green light into the adult man’s wounded chest. The poison broke into tiny threads of green light that looking like mini poisonous snakes.
Ahh!!

It was pain that even an iron man couldn’t withstand. The horrifying screams of the adult man sounded out throughout the entire stronghold. He kept rolling and struggling like crazy on the floor. Due to his cultivation base being stronger than the others, his ability to withstand the poison was far greater than the previous men. And because of this, the pain he was suffering was far greater than that of the previous men.
“Enjoy the taste of pain and death.”

Jiang Chen said in an indifferent one. He turned around and looked at Tian Yishan and the few other men who were laying on the floor, including Guan Yiyun. All of them had suffered severe injuries. But luckily, the poison in their bodies had been completely absorbed by Jiang Chen, which saved them from instant death.
“Brother Jiang, what should we do now? I think this secret chamber has been surrounded by Yang Shuo’s men right now.”

Tian Yishan asked. No doubt, Jiang Chen’s performance was incredible, but he knew Yang Shuo very well. As a genius from the Myriad Sword Sect in the Jiang Province, Yang Shuo’s cultivation level and tricks were far beyond ordinary men. Now, they had wreaked havoc in Yang Shuo’s stronghold and killed his men. With his temper, he wouldn’t let them get away with it.

“I said it before; blood will be shed, and there will be no survivors. I want to establish my authority in the outer perimeter of Inferno City and get revenge for Guan Yiyun. No one is allowed to harm my friends.”

Jiang Chen said with a calm voice. He wasn’t worried about that Yang Shuo at all. If this was before he had gained 600 Dragon Marks, he might not have had such confidence. But now, Yang Shuo posed not threat to him.
Big Yellow’s eyes lit up brightly. He knew Jiang Chen really well, his buddy had become really furious today. With this, blood would be shed everywhere in this stronghold.
“Keep Guan Yiyun and the rest of the men in this secret chamber, let’s go meet that Yang Shuo.”

Jiang Chen tidied up his clothing, and with the sword in his hand, he started walking out from the secret chamber. He would show no mercy today. In inferno Hell, slaughtering was something perfectly normal, as lives were worthless in a place like this.
“You men inside, get he hell out and face your deaths!”
Within the stronghold, someone shouted out loudly into the secret chamber.
Jiang Chen and Big Yellow walked out side by side, while Tian Yishan followed closely behind. They walked step by step out from the secret chamber, and arrived at an empty field in the manor.

Right as they exited the secret chamber, Jiang Chen immediately sensed numerous killing intents and ferocious energies, enough to fill the skies above. There were even some demonic energies hovering around the place.

When the trio walked out from the secret chamber, over 20 men immediately rushed over and surrounded them. All of these men carried combat weapons, and there were even four powerful Divine Core demon beasts mixed in the group that looked brutal and ruthless.

Doesn’t matter if it was the number of men or demon beasts, it all went to show Yang Shuo’s incredible tricks. In this Inferno City, being able to make so many people follow him willingly, and can even make Divine Core demon beasts surrender to him; all of this was enough to show what amazing strength Yang Shuo possessed.
“That’s him, he killed a few of our men!”

When one of the men saw Jiang Chen, he immediately shouted out loudly. Next to the man, there stood a Mid Divine Core old man. The man looked to be in his fifties, his body seemed full of power and grandeur, and he wore animal skin as clothing.
“Tian Yishan, so it’s you! I never thought you would still be alive, and even managed to get help! It’s too bad you don’t know how to cherish your life and didn’t escape while you had the chance!”
The old man said upon seeing Tian Yishan.

“Brother Jiang, this man is Liu Kui, he is a cruel guy, and a Mid Divine Core warriors. He was exiled to Inferno Hell by a big sect in the Jian Province, and he is now one of Yang Shuo’s followers. He’s not easy to deal with.”
Tian Yishan told Jiang Chen through his divine sense.
Jiang Chen had a grin on his face. He wasn’t afraid when surround by so many strong men. Jiang Chen turned to Liu Kui and spoke with a calm voice, “Where is Yang Shuo? Tell him to get here now.”

“Haha, do you really think that handling someone like you requires young master Yang Shuo to be here in person? Me alone is more than enough to handle all of your, there is no need to disturb young master Yang Shuo’s cultivation.”
Liu Kui burst into laughter. He was very confident in his own abilities, therefore he didn’t take Jiang Chen seriously.
“Is that so?”
After saying that, Jiang Chen swayed his body and swung his sword.
Ahh!!
Three screams sounded out, three men were slashed into half. Two of them were peak Heavenly Core warriors, and the last one was an Early Divine Core warrior.
Duo to Jiang Chen’s sudden quick attack, none of them had time to react, and were killed instantly.
Roar!

The expressions of everyone here changed dramatically. No one had expected that in this situation, not only did Jiang Chen not beg for mercy, he actually had the courage to attack. This was outrageous.
What was even more frightening was Jiang Chen’s ability. He could actually kill an Early Divine Core warrior so easily. This was extremely frightening, even Liu Kui had a change in expression.
“Damn it, attack! Kill them all!”

Liu Kui shouted his order out loudly. Immediately, everyone in the stronghold unleash all their energy and started attacking Jiang Chen’s group. The three powerful Divine Core demon beasts let out brutal roars as well, and they threw their mountain like bodies towards Jiang Chen.
“Kill them all, leave no survivors.”
Jiang Chen said with an extremely cruel voice.
Roar!

Big Yellow let out a loud roar. Golden colored symbols blinked on his head, and in an instant, he transformed into a trail of light and forcefully dashed forwards. At the same time, Tian Yishan drew out his combat weapon and started attacking with red eyes. His injuries weren’t as bad as Guan Yiyun’s, and after consuming the Revival Pill given to him by Jiang Chen, he was almost fully recovered. With his current combat strength, he had no problem dealing with ordinary Early Divine Core warriors.

Big Yellow was laughing out heartily. He really liked this kind of bloody and adventurous scene. Only problem was that he felt somewhat bored, as his innate abilities had yet to awaken, and he could only use his speed to dodge his opponents’ attacks. He dodged the Divine Core warriors, and focused only on attacking the Heavenly Core warriors.
No Heavenly Core warrior could withstand a single blow from his metal like head. They all died miserable deaths.
Jiang Chen was attacking with the Soaring Heavens Sword, and nobody could withstand more than a single strike. Blood splashed all around, and men were slashed in half by Jiang Chen.
Ahh!!
Blood-curdling screeches filled the entire stronghold, and so did the angry roars of the demon beasts. They mixed into a beautiful melody of slaughter.

Blood splashed to the skies, the atmosphere was filled with an intense smell of blood. In just a mere minute, the group of 20 people was left with only 3 men. Besides Liu Kui, there were another two Early Divine Core warriors still alive.
Looking at the dead bodies on the floor, and the headless demon beast corpses, these three men felt it difficult to breath. Even Liu Kui had a drastic change in expression.
Now, Liu Kui had lost his confidence. The young man in front of him was too frightening, no one could withstand a single strike from him. Even he himself couldn’t do something like this.
Liu Kui sensed a dangerous feeling from Jiang Chen. He knew he was no match for this young man.
“Old Liu, what should we do now? The enemy is too strong, we have suffered great losses now.”
One of the men asked.
“We have no choice but to wake young master from his cultivation, only young master can kill this young man.”
Liu Kui told the man. At the same time, an invisible thread of divine sense shot out from his mind towards the inner area of the stronghold.
“You three have to die as well.”
Jiang Chen raised his sword and pointed it at the three men in front of him.
“Haha, young master will soon arrive! Young man, you have killed so many of our men, be prepared to bear the endless fury and torture of the young master!”
Liu Kui burst out into laughter. However, before the smile disappeared from his face, Jiang Chen had disappeared from his sight.
Ahh!
Immediately after Jiang Chen had disappeared, a painful scream sounded out next to Liu Kui. Another Early Divine Core warrior had been cut in half by Jiang Chen.
“Not good!”
The other man sensed the danger, so he dared not hesitate. He immediately flew high up into the skies, away from the danger.
“Wish to run? Stay behind!”
Jiang Chen raised the Soaring Heavens Sword and unleashed a ray of light which collided right into the man who just flew away. Blood exploded from the man’s body, and he was instantly killed.

Ha!

Clang!

Two combat weapons collided and produced a huge amount of sparks. Liu Kui was knocked back by Jiang Chen’s attack nearly 100 meters before he was able to regain control of his body. He was a Mid Divine Core warrior after all, he still had the abilities to fight Jiang Chen, even if it was just for a short amount of time.
“Everyone in this place will be killed today. Since you’ve harmed my friend, you will have to bear the consequences.

Jiang Chen’s stern gazed locked onto Liu Kui. If he hadn’t bumped into Tian Yishan today, he wouldn’t have known about Guan Yiyun’s whereabouts, and if he came here any later, he might have just found Guan Yiyun’s dead body.
“Hmph! Who is the one shamelessly boasting? You’re simply seeking death by killing the men in my stronghold!”

Right at this moment, a loud shout sounded out from afar. A figure suddenly rushed out from the inner area of the stronghold and arrived next to Liu Kui. Then man had a handsome face, and he wore a long, blue gown. He looked about the same age as Tian Yishan.
But, the cruel and ferocious look in this man’s eyes told Jiang Chen that he was a brutal man.
“Young master!”

Liu Kui looked at Yang Shuo as if he had just found his savior. An extremely joyful expression emerged on his face. Liu Kui had witnessed Yang Shuo’s strength before, and he knew that no matter how strong the young man in front of him was, there was no way he would be a match for Yang Shuo.
Yang Shuo turned around and looked at the dead bodies scattered across the place. Blood was still leaking out from some of the bodies. In an instant, fury filled his eyes.
“You did all this?”
Yang Shuo stared angrily at Jiang Chen.

Chapter 210 - Demon Taming Lock
Jiang Chen didn’t answer Yang Shuo’s question. The blood dripping from his longsword was the best answer to the question.
“So you are Yang Shuo?”
Jiang Chen asked as he threw an examining look onto Yang Shuo.
“Young master, this guy is really strong, and not easy to deal with. Even I am no match for him.”

Liu Kui said with a sigh. He had a frightened expression on his face, and he was unable to pull himself out from his panicked state. He had never seen a young Heavenly Core man who possessed so much combat strength. This had gone beyond his knowledge and imagination.
“Hmph! You’re courting death by killing so many of my men. I don’t care who you are, today I will torture and kill you.”

Yang Shuo let out a cold snort. It wasn’t easy to cultivate a group of men in Inferno City. All these men had pledged loyalty to him and worked under his command. He would always send them to hunt for monsters in the depths of Inferno Hell, and he would be able to get a share of their harvest. Put it this way, as long as he had a group of men working for him, he would be able to enjoy good wealth and benefits without doing anything himself.
Now, all his men had been killed in such a short period of time. This was no different than destroying his only source of income. Of course, Yang Shuo had become extremely angry.

“Yang Shuo, a genius from the Jian Province’s Myriad Sword Sect, your strength is quite sold. But too bad, you’ve offended someone you shouldn’t have; you hurt my friend. Today, I’ll bring my friend justice, and that’s the reason why I want to kill everyone in this stronghold, including you. Yang Shuo, remember, my name if Jiang Chen. If you don’t remember it now, you won’t have the opportunity later on.”
Jiang Chen said with an indifferent tone. He felt extremely confident, as he possessed 600 Dragon Marks. So, he didn't really worry when facing a genius like Yang Shuo.

“Haha, I think you’re referring to Guan Yiyun and those other men. Since you’re here to get yourself killed, I’ll fulfill your wish; all of you are going to die today. Let me see how strong you, Tian Yishan’s help is.”
Yang Shuo burst into laughter.
“If that’s the case, attack now.”
Jiang Chen shrugged. He casually put away the longsword and remained standing in the same spot.
“There is no need for me to personally attack you. Shamanic Fire Ape, come out now!”

Yang Shuo suddenly shouted out loudly. A round-shaped lock which glowed in a dark light appeared in his hand. There were numerous mystical symbols carved onto the lock itself, and if examined carefully, the symbols were actually patterns which resembled demon beasts.
Ding-ling!

The black colored lock dinged. Followed by the dinging sound, a ground-shaking roar suddenly sounded out from the depths of the stronghold. After that, a flaming figure suddenly appeared above the skies.

It was a powerful fire ape, and its entire body was emitting a flaming red light. The fire ape was over 10 meters tall, and it looked like a tall pagoda. When the fire ape saw Yang Shuo, an intense hatred emerged in its eyes. But when it saw the black lock in his hand, the intense hatred was turned into fear and meekness.

The fire ape let out an angry roar as it descended from the skies. It slammed into the ground with massive force, causing an explosion to sound out, the entire strong hold to shake, and countless cracks to appear on the ground. It unleashed a tremendous demonic energy combined with scorching flames, enough to send fear deep into one’s heart.

“Brother Jiang, be careful, this is a Shamanic Fire Ape, and it has reached the Mid Divine Core realm. I don’t know how Yang Shuo managed to make this Shamanic Fire Ape obey his command. Also, all the other demon beasts, they are all controlled by Yang Shuo.”

Tian Yishan’s expression changed, and without any hesitation, he explained to Jiang Chen. Normally, demon beasts all had violent tempers, and considered humans their mortal enemies, even more so for demon beasts who had broken through to the Divine Core realm. All of them had their own prides and dignities, and they would rather die than be controlled by a human. This Shamanic Fire Ape had reached the Mid Divine Core realm, but it was still willing to be controlled by Yang Shuo, confusing other.
“It’s because of the black lock in that guy’s hand. It actually has an energy that can make all demons submit to its command. Even I feel uncomfortable when facing it.”
Big Yellow said. He looked at the black lock which was held in Yang Shuo’s hand, al although he didn’t fear it as much as the Shamanic Fire Ape did, he still felt hatred towards the thing.

“That’s the Demon Taming Lock, it’s an item that’s really difficult to me. I never thought this Yang Shuo would actually own one. No wonder why he’s able to make those demon beasts obey his command. Obviously, this Shamanic Fire Ape is controlled by the Demon Taming Lock and are unable to reject Yang Shuo’s command.”

Jiang Chen said. His eyes lit up as he looked at the Demon Taming Lock, this kind of item was extremely rare and precious. If he was able to obtain this Demon Taming Lock, the advantages he would gain would be huge.
“Brother Jiang, what should we do now?
Tian Yishan looked extremely worried.
“Hmph! Don’t worry, I’ll just killed this Shamanic Fire Ape and get its demon soul, after that, I’ll kill Yang Shuo and get his Demon Taming Lock.”

Jiang Chen let out a cold snort. A grin appeared on his face, because in his mind, Yang Shuo was just a small obstacle in his path towards the ultimate goal. Everything Yang Shuo had done and obtained, it would all belong to Jiang Chen in the end.

“What a boaster. Jiang Chen, you’re just a Heavenly Core warrior, and you’re not even close to approaching the Divine Core realm. I really want to see what you have in order to deal with a Mid Divine Core Shamanic Fire Ape.”
Yang Shuo was extremely aggressive. He raised the Demon Taming Lock in his hand and waved it towards the Shamanic Fire Ape, then he gave out an order, “Shamanic Fire Ape, kill this man for me.”
Yang Shuo pointed at Jiang Chen.
Roar!

The Shamanic Fire Ape was furious, and flames were shooting out from its eyes. As a Divine Core demon beast, it had its own pride and dignity, that’s why it felt extremely enraged upon being controlled by a young human man. However, because of the Demon Taming Lock, it was forced to obey Yang Shuo’s command. The appearance of Jiang Chen had given it a target to release its anger on. It wanted to channel all its anger and killing intent toward Jiang Chen.
Bang!
The Shamanic Fire Ape punched a huge hole in the ground, then it jumped about 30 meters into the air, forcefully throwing its majestic body which was covered in scorching flames toward Jiang Chen.

Tian Yishan’s expression changed dramatically. With his cultivation level, he could only handle ordinary Mid Divine Core warriors, but he was no match for the Shamanic Fire Ape. A brutal opponent like this was really frightening.
“You guys move aside, let me handle it.”

Jiang Chen had a calm look in his eyes. The Shamanic Fire Ape was much more difficult to handle than the Double Headed Black Crow. However, Jiang Chen wasn’t the same as he was when he dealt with those black crows either. 600 Dragon Marks were more than enough for him to handle this ape.
“Six Profound Solar Fingers!”

Jiang Chen shouted out loudly. He forcefully pointed his finger, like a sword. In an instant, five sky piercing fingers shot towards the Shamanic Fire Ape. Along the way, all five fingers merged into one, which gave it a tremendous increase in power.
“Die for me now!”

The Shamanic Fire Ape let out shrill cries, all of its fur was standing up, and countless golden colored light beams shot out from its body and flew towards the solar finger. There were even some explosive flames mixed in with the beams used to counter-attack.
Bang!

At this moment, the skies seemed to be falling, and the ground seemed to be breaking apart. The explosive flames and energy ripples swept across the place, and the entire stronghold was covered by the powerful explosion. But surprisingly, not even a single building in this stronghold had been damaged.
It was as if all the building in Inferno City were protected by an invisible force, so no one was able to cause even the slightest damage to them.
Such violent ripples could be sensed by half the population in Inferno City. However, the people were still calm. Here, combat and slaughter happened every single day, it was just too normal.

The brutal Shamanic Fire Ape was forced back nearly 4 meters by the impact. Its face carried a shocked expression; it had never expected that a Heavenly Core human could possess such tremendous combat strength, and be able to force it back with just a single strike. This was simply unimaginable.
But, there was only one thought in the furious Shamanic Fire Ape’s mind, and that was killing this young man in front of it to release its anger. Therefore, it leapt at Jiang Chen once again.
“I still can’t unleash the sixth solar finger. If I could, there would be no way for this Shamanic Fire Ape to withstand it at all.”

Jiang Chen sighed. The Six Profound Solar Fingers came from the mighty Nine Celestial Solar Energies. He knew how powerful this skill could be, if he was able to unleash its sixth finger, there was no way this Shamanic Fire Ape would be his match.
“Buddy, this Shamanic Fire Ape is a brutal being, so why don’t you fight brutality with brutality?”
Big Yellow said. He felt so anxious right now, if he was a Divine Core demon beast now, if he could get his powerful innate abilities to awaken, he would have already jumped into the fight.
“Fine, I’ll confront brutality with brutality. Let’s see how far this Shamanic Fire Ape can go.”

Jiang Chen let out a loud shout, then the Firethorn Combat Armor appeared on his body. The armor glowed brightly in a golden color, and there were countless razor sharp thorns standing on the armor’s surface, which looked devastating.

Jiang Chen forcefully stomped the ground, then he flew high up into the sky. Using the Firethorn Combat Armor as a weapon, he rammed into the Shamanic Fire Ape. This was a truly brutal way of attacking.
“What kind of combat skill is this? It actually combines offense and defense! Where did this guy come from, why is he so powerful?”

Witnessing Jiang Chen unleashed the Six Profound Solar Fingers, forcing the Shamanic Fire Ape back, and now even unleashing the mighty Firethorn Combat Armor, the arrogant Yang Shuo couldn’t help but feel shocked. Although he thought of himself as a peerless genius, he was convinced that if he was at the same cultivation level as Jiang Chen, there was no way he would be able to match his combat strength. To be frank, if he was at the same cultivation level as Jiang Chen, Jiang Chen would be able to kill him in an instant.

“Brother Jiang has really shocked me. I left the Qi Province two years ago, but I had never expected that such a glorious, peerless genius would appear! His appearance is really good fortune for the Black Sect!”
The shocked expression on Tian Yishan’s face was getting thicker and thicker. Jiang Chen’s mightiness had completely stunned him.
Bang!
Under the few shocked gazes, Jiang Chen who was wearing the Firethorn Combat Armor crashed into the brutal Shamanic Fire Ape. The massive collision produced a large amount of sparks in the air.
