He had just broken through to the Divine Core realm, and wasn’t strong enough compared to the other men.
That’s why he was immediately wounded after jumping into the fight.
“Lao Wang, can you do it or not?
If not, just back off!”
While fighting some men, Yang Meng turned towards Wang Heng and shouted.
“Fuck, of course I can, I’m a man too!”
Wang Heng said while gnashing his teeth.
A battle like this could easily ignite the bravery of a man, this was a true battlefield.
“Everyone, be careful, we’re outnumbered by the enemies!
Don’t get separated, that will be too dangerous!”
Guan Yiyun reminded everyone in a serious manner.
The seven of them had grouped together and formed a solid line of defense.
If they were split up by the enemy, the consequences would be devastating.
There were so many enemies all over the place, if they were split up and forced to face the enemy alone, it would be life-threatening situation.

Right at this moment, Jiang Chen was fighting dozens of Mid Divine Core warriors all alone, Big Yellow was ramming and slamming into the enemies, causing a tremendous pressure to weigh down on the enemies.
Neither of them were able to help Tian Yishan and the other men, so the men had to rely on themselves.
Big Yellow’s body was full of power and grandeur.
He spat out his tongue as he ran around crazily amidst the middle of the enemy group, without even caring about the oncoming attacks.
Because, even if the combat weapons collided with him, they couldn’t even cause any damage to his skin and fur.
“Fuck the hammer, what’s this dog’s head made off?
It’s so hard!
Ahh!!
Daddy is going to die!”
Big Yellow was too brutal, he made these people feel as if he was invincible.
And because he was so extremely fast, if any of these men didn’t pay enough attention, they would be rammed by Big Yellow and die on the spot.
Ahh!!
On the others side, shrill screams also sounded out without stop.
Jiang Chen was showing his mightiness!
The Bloodthirsty Sword had transformed into a flexible poisonous snake, and in just a short moment, he had killed eight men with his sword.
Although he was facing a group of dozens of strong warriors, his speed was simply too amazing, causing the enemies to have a difficult time even reaching him.
Jiang Chen’s sword was extremely fast and cruel.
When he used the Heavenly Saint Sword and ventured across the world, he had spread his frightening name across the land.
Jiang Chen didn’t know any miraculous sword skills, and his sword could only be described as fast, extremely fast, and accurate.
There was nothing that couldn’t be destroyed by his sword; this was his unique sword skill, there no name, just no mercy.
“Everyone, don’t be thrown into confusion, unleash your combat weapons and attack from all directions!”
Zhuge Yun shouted.
Many people started panicking because of Jiang Chen’s sword, their arrogance and confidence was long gone.
Jiang Chen’s existence caused death to hover around them at all times.
Clang clang...

Combat weapons could be seen everywhere, killing intents leaked out everywhere, violent energy ripples were hovering in the skies above the stronghold, blood mist was floating in every single inch of the air.
The floor underneath their feet was covered in fresh and hot blood, broken limbs and dead bodies were everywhere.
“Let me see how you’re going to regroup and secure your position.
Nine Phantom Wolves!”
Jiang Chen shouted out loudly.
Immediately, nine identical Jiang Chens appeared in the middle of the battlefield.
The warriors who were getting ready to strike together and kill Jiang Chen became stunned, the nine identical Jiang Chens confused them, and no one knew which Jiang Chen they had to attack.
The enemy was stunned, and Jiang Chen didn’t waste any time.
The real Jiang Chen resolutely attacked, cutting of three heads at the same time, in an extremely ruthless manner.
Swoosh swoosh swoosh...
Jiang Chen maintained the Nine Phantom Wolves.
There were still nine identical Jiang Chens at the scene, and the frightened enemies were completely confused by this.
What they could do now was attack every single Jiang Chen they saw...
But too bad, after all the phantoms had been destroyed, Jiang Chen had once again killed another two men.
“Damn it, I can’t do this anymore, this is too abnormal!”
Someone couldn’t bear it any longer.
Fighting with someone like this was incredibly painful.
“Hmph!
Since you guys came here seeking death, I’ll let you die pleasant deaths.
Firethorn Combat Armor!”
Jiang Chen shouted out loudly once again.
He put away the Bloodthirsty Sword as the Firethorn Combat Armor covered his entire body, then he rammed towards the frightened warriors in a formidable manner.
Swoosh swoosh...
Not only did the Firethorn Combat Armor have incredible defense, it could also unleash powerful attacks.
Countless golden beams shot out from the sharp thorns on the armor, landing on the enemies in a messy way.
Clang clang clang...
All these chiefs were scared by Jiang Chen’s attacks.
When they saw that Jiang Chen had switched to another, stronger attack, they immediately raised the combat weapons in their hands to block the attacks.
But, after they had completely blocked all the golden beams, Jiang Chen had arrived in front of them.
Bang!
The Firethorn Combat Armor was simply too powerful!
It was almost guaranteed death if a person was rammed into by it, even if he was a Mid Divine Core warrior.
Bang bang bang...
At this moment, both Jiang Chen and Big Yellow were crashing and slamming around in the separate groups in a similar manner, killing their enemies and causing them to wet their pants in terror.
“I quit, daddy doesn’t want to attack anymore!”
One of the Mid Divine Core chiefs who had a broken arm shouted out loudly.
There was no way he could continue fighting, their opponent was simply not a human at all, and he was just like a ferocious beast.
The situation on the battlefield was completely different from what they had expected.

Initially, they thought that no matter how strong Jiang Chen was, he wouldn’t be able to withstand such a massive combined attack from nearly 50 Mid Divine Core warriors, but no one could foresee Jiang Chen being this formidable.
“Do you truly believe you can quit at any time?
Die now!”
With a massive killing intent, Jiang Chen unleashed the True Dragon Palm and slammed into the man, causing him to become a meat paste.
Ahh!!
Blood-curdling screeches didn’t seem to stop sounding out.
An unprecedented cruel slaughter was going on in the outer perimeter of Inferno City, and this battle would definitely be recorded in the history of Inferno Hell.
After the battle, it would take a long time for the alliances in the outer perimeter to recover.
Both Jiang Chen and Big Yellow were extremely formidable, and none of these few hundred men could resist their attacks.
Tian Yishan and the other men were wounded all over their bodies, but these were just some minor injuries.
Their killing intents were soaring, and they kept striking with the combat weapons while all their eyes were completely bloodshot.
“The Unrivalled Iron Fan!”
Zhuge Yun finally unleashed an explosive attack.
The folding fan in his hand begun spinning rapidly, and with a push from his yuan energy, the folding fan transformed into a fan as huge as a mountain.
It shone brightly as it flew towards Jiang Chen.
Zhuge Yun was a peak Mid Divine Core warrior, he was the strongest man in the crowd.

If it was a few days ago, Jiang Chen might need to exert a lot of effort in order to kill him, but now, with the combat strength brought from 750 Dragon Marks, Zhuge Yun was nothing but a mere low dog in front of him.
“Since you are the leader, I’ll kill you first.”
Jiang Chen leapt forwards, he pointed his finger out like a sword and unleashed the Six Profound Solar Fingers in an instant.
Six gigantic and bright fingers merged into one and pierced towards the gigantic iron fan.
Bang!
A ground-shaking explosion sounded out, the air around the collision exploded because of the attack, and Zhuge Yun’s iron was easily pushed away by Jiang Chen’s attack.
After Jiang Chen had become able to unleash the sixth solar finger, the power of the Six Profound Solar Fingers reached an incredible stage.
Even Yang Shuo’s Myriad Returning Sword was no match for him, let alone Zhuge Yun’s iron fan.
Puh!
A mouthful of blood was forced out from Zhuge Yun’s mouth, his body trembled in midair, and with a pale faced and shocked expression; he finally experienced how terrifying Jiang Chen was.
Jiang Chen was not someone he could deal with at all, and if he knew this, he wouldn’t be here today.
Swoosh!
Jiang Chen didn’t let them off easily.
He moved in a ghostly manner, and in an instant, he arrived in front of Zhuge Yun.
After arriving in front of Zhuge Yun, he forcefully slapped his face.
The slap sent Zhuge Yun flying down from the skies, causing him to be forcefully thrown on the ground, making him dizzy.
Jiang Chen quickly descended from the skies, killing another man along the way.
“Go to hell!”
Jiang Chen ruthlessly attacked without showing any mercy.
He forcefully stomped his foot onto Zhuge Yun’s head, crushing it and causing blood to splash out like a fountain.
Zhuge Yun had finally been killed, in a tragic way.
“Who dares resist, I will kill without mercy!”
Jiang Chen looked like a formidable overlord.
He retracted the Firethorn Combat Armor and once again retrieved the Bloodthirsty Sword.
He slashed out with his sword, cutting another Mid Divine Core warrior in half.
His loud warning had stunned all the enemies, and at this point of time, more than half of the Mid Divine Core warriors had been killed by him.
Every time he killed someone, Jiang Chen would snatch their storage rings, giving him a big amount of wealth.
“Zhuge Yun is dead!
I quit, I want to surrender; I’m willing to submit!
Someone shouted out loudly.
A battle like this was really frightening, and none of these men had experienced anything remotely similar before.
“We’re quitting too, surrender, we’re willing to surrender, please spare our lives!”
“We surrender, please spare our lives!”
The will to surrender could be contagious, especially when once faced a hopeless slaughter.
All of the men were cruel and ferocious, they had experienced all sorts of dangerous fights, but for a meaningless fight like this, surrendering was their best option.
This was not a fight, this was a one-sided slaughter; there was just no meaning for them to continue.
When a man lost the ability to fight for his life, it was useless to continue fighting.
Zhuge Yun was dead, and they believed that if they continued to fight, they would all be killed by Jiang Chen; no one doubted that.
They had witnessed Jiang Chen’s ruthlessness, he wouldn’t even furrow his brows after killing every single man here.
All the chiefs had surrendered, and those men who were seriously injured by Big Yellow felt long ago felt scared.
Therefore, they followed their chiefs’ decision to surrender immediately.
“You’re not allowed to surrender, master dog still hasn’t killed enough!”
Big Yellow roared out, ‘you’re not allowed to surrender’, scaring everyone and causing them to start crawling on the ground.

chapters.title: Chapter 224 - Master Dog, I’m sorry
paragraphs: Big Yellow was bouncing around while spitting fire from his mouth. His killing intent had reached a new peak, and therefore, he didn’t allow these men to surrender freely.

Zhuge Yun was dead, and so was more than half the Mid Divine Core warriors. The remaining men were all scared, and had lost their will to fight. Over 500 men came here, but now there were less than 300. Dead bodies were piled up everywhere, hot and fresh blood was flowing around like a river. These men were in the middle of a fight just now, so they didn’t pay much attention to the scene, but since the fighting had come to a complete stop, the survivors immediately gasped upon seeing the carnage. It wasn’t difficult for them to imagine what would happen if they kept fighting, they would most likely become one of the bodies on the ground.

The entire sky above the stronghold was filled with blood red mist, the pungent smell of blood rushed into everyone’s noses. This was not the same peaceful stronghold anymore; it had turned into a tragic hell.
“We don’t want to fight anymore, we’re willing to surrender! Chief Jiang, from now on, we will obey your every command!”
Someone couldn’t hold himself any longer, he spoke on the verge of tears.
“Master dog, I surrender, I’m willing to serve the master dog!”

“Me too! What happened today was not our intention, it was Zhuge Yun who kept provoking us, we sincerely wanted to submit to chief Jiang and master dog, but that Zhuge Yun provoked us and said he would kill us if we didn’t do as he said!”

“That’s right, we were forced to do this! Chief Jiang is such a mighty man, and we are just some small character who aren’t even qualified to be your match! Zhuge Yun was a fool to try and fight you, he brought disgrace upon his own head! It served him right to die!”
“He deserved to die, I’ve long ago grown tired of him! If not because of his stupid idea, I would have come here to submit to chief Jiang yesterday!”
All the men kept expressing their regret, scared that Jiang Chen and Big Yellow wouldn’t even give them a chance to surrender.
Fuck!

Even Jiang Chen couldn’t help but curse. Tian Yishan and the other were also rolling their eyes. Finally, they had witnessed how shameless a man could be. This group of people had committed every hideous crime and unpardonable wicked deed possible. When they came to Inferno Hell, they too had done anything they could to ensure their survival. They were a bunch of shameless bastards! After Zhuge Yun had died, they had actually blamed everything on him! If Zhuge Yun was still alive right now, he might just die instantly after hearing their words.
“Shut your fucking mouths!”

Guan Yiyun shouted out furiously, sending these men into complete silence without daring to say another word. Now, they had become flesh for the fishes for the sacrificial vessels, and in order to ensure their survival, they had to do whatever their opponent said.
All the Mid Divine Core warriors stared at Jiang Chen in a pathetic manner, waiting for him to say something. Jiang Chen’s ruthlessness had cast an eternal shadow in their minds.
“Although you want to submit to me, I have no intentions of having you as my subordinates. I can spare your lives, but since you have done something wrong, you must be punished.”

Jiang Chen slowly put away the Bloodthirsty Sword as he spoke. Hearing that Jiang Chen wasn’t going to kill them, the men immediately let out sighs of relief. But, they were wondering what kind of punishment Jiang Chen would bestow upon them.

“Hand over everything in your storage ring, pills, demon souls, devil souls, crystal cores, herbs, natural essences, combat weapons, everything! Those who dare keep a single item... the sword in my hand will show what it means to have no mercy.”
Jiang Chen said with a grin on his face. This was a daylight robbery!
“What?”
Everyone exclaimed upon hearing Jiang Chen’s words. They had a feeling that someone was slicing and cutting away their flesh, bit by bit.
“Haha, chief Jiang is really mean, this is worse than killing them!”
Wang Heng who was covered in wounds had burst out into laughter.

“That’s right, chief Jiang is going to strip you of everything you got! He won’t even let them keep their Mortal Restoration Pills! It’ll be extremely difficult for them to survive in Inferno Hell, no one can absorb natural yuan energy from the outside world here in Inferno Hell, and in order to cultivate, everyone needs Mortal Restoration Pills and crystal cores! Without natural resources to cultivate, it will be incredibly tough for them to progress in here.”

“If that’s the case, their best option would be to try and hunt for Nine Life Crystal Beasts... but since chief Jiang also wants their combat weapons, they will only have a slim chance of surviving upon meeting a Nine Life Crystal Beast. Also, those demon beasts and devils aren’t easy to deal with either.”
“Serves them right! They should be thankful that chief Jiang decided to spare their lives! If we were the ones defeated by them today, we wouldn’t have a chance at survival!”

Tian Yishan and the others felt incredibly happy right now. Jiang Chen was killing them without actually doing it himself. More importantly, the majority of warriors in the outer perimeter was gathered here, a huge amount of wealth would be gained by confiscating all their belongings. Even without counting the pills, natural essences, demon souls and crystal cores, there would be more than a few hundred combat weapons, all different ranks.
Damn it! This was such an enormous amount of wealth, this was unbelievable!
“I’ll count to three, hand over everything in your storage rings. After that, I’ll begin killing those who haven’t handed everything over. Don’t think I’m joking, I only joke with my friends.”
Jiang Chen said with an indifferent tone.
“Chief Jiang, we will give you all our treasures, but can you at least spare our combat weapons?”
Someone asked. As long as they still had their combat weapons, the chances for them to survive would be greater.
Swoosh!
Right as the man’s words left his mouth, Jiang Chen unleashed a beam from his sword, instantly chopping off the man’s head.
“Nope.”
A light smile could be seen on Jiang Chen’s face. However, in the eyes of these men, it was the smile of the devil! He was simply too ruthless, too brutal!
“You do have one more option... death.”
Jiang Chen never showed his enemies any mercy. Sparing their lives was the biggest act of mercy Jiang Chen could show.

Now, no one dared hesitate any longer. All of them immediately took out everything they had in their storage rings. Now, the entire stronghold was emitting all sorts of colorful shines. The auras from the varieties of the natural essences dispersed the pungent smell of blood at once.

With a thought in his mind, Jiang Chen stored all the treasures into his storage ring. He had killed quite a number of men, and he had snatched a lot of storage rings. Once a ring was full, he could still use another ring. And in the end, he could still store all rings into just a single storage ring. Besides, Yang Shuo and Zhuge Yun’s storage rings were pretty spacious as well, he had no worries about running out of space to store all the treasures.
Witnessing Jiang Chen taking all their treasures, many of these men silently started crying. Some of them who were seriously injured even threw up some of their blood.
This was cruel! This action was an indirect way of killing most of them!

At this moment, all the survivors couldn’t help but inwardly curse at Zhuge Yun. Their expressions made it seem like they were going to tear his dead body into millions of pieces. The outcome today was directly related to Zhuge Yun! If not his decision, although these men didn’t want to submit to Jiang Chen, they would still have no other alternative than to submit. Now, not only had many of them died, the survivors had even been robbed by Jiang Chen. How were they going to survive in Inferno Hell?
“Kaka, so satisfying, what an enjoyable moment!”

Wang Heng burst into laughter. After having come to Inferno Hell, he had never been as happy as he was today. Never had he experienced such an enjoyable moment! Tian Yishan and Guan Yiyun were laughing out loudly as well. As Jiang Chen’s fellow disciples, they couldn’t feel more proud than this.
The way these men looked at Jiang Chen was filled with admiration. This man in front of them had always shone in a unique glow and a manly charisma.

All kinds of treasures flowed into Jiang Chen’s storage ring like water, including all the storage rings from those who Jiang Chen had previously killed. Jiang Chen had actually cleanly swept the entire outer perimeter of Inferno City, and if there was a ranking for the ability to rob, Jiang Chen would certainly be number one.

Soon, all the treasures had been taken away by Jiang Chen. Those who had lost their treasures had an expression more awful than one that would appear if their mother died. But, no matter what, they were still alive. If they hadn’t handed over their treasures, they would be dead, and the treasures would end up with Jiang Chen regardless.
“Chief Jiang, can we leave now?”
One of the Mid Divine Core chiefs asked, on the verge of tears.
“Get lost.”

Jiang Chen casually waved his hand. Today’s loot was enormous, and he had probably become the wealthiest man in Inferno City right now. His current wealth was more enormous than the entire Black Sect’s wealth.
Hearing that Jiang Chen pardoned them, no one dared hesitate any longer. Everyone immediately turned around and began walking.
“Stop right there!”
But at this moment, Big Yellow suddenly asked them to stop, causing these people to instantly stop moving.
Damn it! Not finished yet?!
All the men’s faces darkened. They knew that this dog was not easy to deal with.
“Did master dog let you go?”
Big Yellow said while holding his head up high. All men immediately turned to Jiang Chen, but Jiang Chen just turned around, almost as if he hadn’t heard what Big Yellow said.
“Bastards, you have insult this master dog with your words just now, you really deserve to be killed! According to master dog’s temper, I should bite you all to death on the spot!”

Big Yellow’s words made these men become panicked once again. It looked like there was still doubts about whether or not their lives would be spared today. They had all witnessed how ruthless this dog was, Big Yellow would really bite them to death!

“But, since Little Chen has spared your lives, this master dog will spare you the same kindness. However, since I can’t bite you to death, master dog’s anger won’t be appeased. Master dog also has to punish you!”
Big Yellow stood up on his two back legs and placed his two front legs behind his back. The way he behaved looked really funny.
Punished again? The men’s faces darkened once again.
“Punished again? We don’t even have anything with us now!”
Someone picked up his courage and spoke.
“Damn it! Who wants anything from you? Each of you, come forth and bow down to the master dog! After that you must say; master dog, I’m sorry!”
Big Yellow said in a serious manner.
Fuck!
Jiang Chen, Guan Yiyun and the other men almost tripped on their own feet and fell onto the ground. Damn it, you're just a dog, do you really want to be so arrogant?
“Hurry up, we start with you.”
Big Yellow pointed at one of the nearest men.
Black lines filled up the man’s forehead. Bowing to a dog and apologizing? How was he going to face people in the future?

The man let out a silent sigh and gave up all thoughts of resisting. It was still doubtful whether or not he could survive in the harsh environment in Inferno Hell, but he still had to ensure his survival right now, he had no other choice but to do as told. He walked up to Big Yellow, bowed down and said, “Master dog, I’m sorry.”
“You’re not sincere enough, say it again loudly! If I still can’t feel your sincerity, master dog will bite you to death on the spot!”
Big Yellow once again showed off his emperor’s arrogance and manners.

Damn it!
Not finished yet?!
All the men’s faces darkened.
They knew that this dog was not easy to deal with.
“Did master dog let you go?”
Big Yellow said while holding his head up high.
All men immediately turned to Jiang Chen, but Jiang Chen just turned around, almost as if he hadn’t heard what Big Yellow said.
“Bastards, you have insult this master dog with your words just now, you really deserve to be killed!
According to master dog’s temper, I should bite you all to death on the spot!”
Big Yellow’s words made these men become panicked once again.
It looked like there was still doubts about whether or not their lives would be spared today.
They had all witnessed how ruthless this dog was, Big Yellow would really bite them to death!
“But, since Little Chen has spared your lives, this master dog will spare you the same kindness.
However, since I can’t bite you to death, master dog’s anger won’t be appeased.
Master dog also has to punish you!”
Big Yellow stood up on his two back legs and placed his two front legs behind his back.
The way he behaved looked really funny.
Punished again?
The men’s faces darkened once again.
“Punished again?
We don’t even have anything with us now!”
Someone picked up his courage and spoke.
“Damn it!
Who wants anything from you?
Each of you, come forth and bow down to the master dog!
After that you must say; master dog, I’m sorry!”
Big Yellow said in a serious manner.
Fuck!
Jiang Chen, Guan Yiyun and the other men almost tripped on their own feet and fell onto the ground.
Damn it, you're just a dog, do you really want to be so arrogant?
“Hurry up, we start with you.”
Big Yellow pointed at one of the nearest men.
Black lines filled up the man’s forehead.
Bowing to a dog and apologizing?
How was he going to face people in the future?
The man let out a silent sigh and gave up all thoughts of resisting.
It was still doubtful whether or not he could survive in the harsh environment in Inferno Hell, but he still had to ensure his survival right now, he had no other choice but to do as told.
He walked up to Big Yellow, bowed down and said, “Master dog, I’m sorry.”
“You’re not sincere enough, say it again loudly!
If I still can’t feel your sincerity, master dog will bite you to death on the spot!”
Big Yellow once again showed off his emperor’s arrogance and manners.

chapters.title: Chapter 225 - Illusion Heart Sutra
paragraphs: Plop!

The man thought he was going to be forgiven, but when he heard Big Yellow’s words, he immediately fell onto the ground. Fuck, these were the most difficult words he had ever had to speak. Never in his wildest dreams had he thought that he would have to bow down in front of a dog and call him master dog. Also, the first time wasn’t enough, he had to do it again, and if he wasn’t sincere enough, he would be killed.
“Hahaha...”
Wang Heng and the others couldn’t help but burst out into laughter.
“Big Yellow is really a genius that can’t be seen in 10,000 years!”
Guan Yiyun as well was laughing out loudly with his mouth wide open. This dog was too funny, he could actually kill someone with this kind of torture.
The man stood up from the ground. With his face having turned red, he shouted out loudly without even raising his head, “MASTER DOG, I’M SORRY!!”
Who could have known that this guy’s heart just broke into two pieces after repeating himself to Big Yellow?

“Fine, this dog master is satisfied with your apology, now get lost. The rest of you, you have to be like him, the louder your voice is, the more respect you show to master dog. Quickly, line up, come forth one at a time, and do not rush.”
Big Yellow raised his paw and waved in front of him.
Tian Yishan and the others felt like they were soon going to faint. Do not rush? Who would rush to do such a shameful thing?
“Daddy can’t take it any longer.”
Jiang Chen covered his face with his hand and walked away; he couldn’t watch this any longer.
But Guan Yiyun and the other men were enjoying this moment. What happened was something they couldn’t forget for the rest of their lives, it was an incredibly rare miracle!
After that, all the men who had had been robbed by Jiang Chen lined up and shouted with all their strength towards Big Yellow, “MASTER DOG, I’M SORRY!!”
Who knew if anyone went back and committed suicide because of depression?

Big Yellow felt as if he was in paradise. Never once had he felt so pleasantly enjoyed before! His tail was happily wagging. Over 200 men, Big Yellow had paid his full attention to these men as they bowed and apologized to him, asking those he was unsatisfied with to repeat with more sincerity, and only let those he was satisfied with go.

All the men left the place in dejection, and finally, peace had returned to the noisy stronghold. Those who walked out from the stronghold kept shouting towards the skies. What happened today had become the biggest shame of their lives. Many of them were cursing at Zhuge Yun, and someone even pointed at the survivors who attacked together with Zhuge Yun. The ending of those men were even more tragic; not only had they been robbed by Jiang Chen and insulted by a dog, just when they were grateful that their lives had been spared, all the other men started beating them and crippling them on the spot. It was a tragic ending.
Within the stronghold, blood and dead bodies could be seen everywhere. The place had turned into a foul hell. Tian Yishan and the other men were frowning as they looked at the scene.
“Chief Tian, we have to get rid of these bodies.”
Yang Meng said.
“Just burn them all.”

The majestic Big Yellow flew into the sky and hovered above the dead bodies, then he spat out some flames, then, all the bodies were burned into ashes. The flame even burnt away the blood on the ground. After that, Guan Yiyun waved his hand and unleashed a storm of yuan energy, dispersing all the ashes. Finally, the stronghold had returned to its original state. Only the faded pungent smell of blood, and cracks on the floor remained after the violent battle.

Right at this moment, Jiang Chen returned to the scene. When Tian Yishan and the other men saw Jiang Chen, a respectful look immediately emerged in their eyes. Although it was the first time Wang Heng and the other men had met up with Jiang Chen, they were filled with admiration towards Jiang Chen’s ultimate ruthlessness.
“Chief Jiang, thank you for saving our lives!”
Yang Meng yang.

“We’re brothers, don’t mention it. I and brother Tian, as well as senior disciple Guan are from the same sect. From today onwards, you are all one of us, so just spare the formalities. Here are some crystal cores and Mortal Resurrection Pills, take them and divide it amongst yourselves.”

Jiang Chen casually waved his hand and threw out a few storage rings towards these men. There were at least a few hundred thousand Mortal Restoration Pills contained within these storage rings, and there were even quite a number of crystal cores at different stages and realms. This amount of wealth was nothing to Jiang Chen, as he had already accumulated a large amount of wealth. Although Jiang Chen had yet to check out his harvest, he could imagine the vast amount of treasures he had now; he almost had the combined wealth of every single person in the outer perimeter of Inferno City.
“Chief Jiang, you saved our lives, we’d feel too ashamed to take these Mortal Restoration Pills and crystal cores from you.”
Someone who felt embarrassed said.
“Just take whatever junior disciple Jiang wants to give us. Although junior disciple Jiang is cruel and merciless toward his enemies, he isn’t stingy with his own brothers.”
Guan Yiyun said.
“If that’s the case, thank you, chief Jiang!”

Yang Meng said while cupping his fist toward Jiang Chen. Everyone here were older than Jiang Chen, but in a universe where strength meant everything, they didn’t feel embarrassed about addressing Jiang Chen as chief. Of course, if they really wanted to take age into consideration, all of them would have to address Jiang Chen as ancestor. The age of Jiang Chen’s mind was definitely the same as an ancient demon.
“Buddy, what an exciting fight today! The entire outer perimeter is going to see big destruction!”
Big Yellow had a victorious expression on his face. He had fulfilled his goal to show off his mightiness, he felt really satisfied.

“That’s right, such a violent fight has never happened in the outer perimeter of Inferno City before! Chief Jiang has robbed every single person in the outer perimeter, he is definitely the number one robber in Inferno Hell!”
Wang Heng said with a smile on his face.
Kapow!
Just as his words left his mouth, he was lightly slapped on top of his head. Wang Heng turned around and saw Tian Yishan staring into his eyes, “What did you say? What do you mean by robber?”
“Hehe, what I mean is that it was their fortune to be robbed by chief Jiang.”
Wang Heng was laughing out heartily.

“Junior disciple Jiang, no one in the outer perimeter of Inferno City dares challenge us anymore. All the alliances in the outer perimeter have collapsed, and for them to survive, they will definitely venture into the depths of Inferno Hell, or try to rob other people. Inferno Hell will become even more chaotic in the future, and there are three more months until the doorway to the outside world opens up. What should we do next?”
Guan Yiyun asked.

“I don’t believe junior disciple Guan is aware of this, but the reason why brother Jiang came to Inferno Hell is to look for the Earth Devil. Since all the conflicts in the outer perimeter have come to a conclusion, I think brother Jiang is going to venture into the deepest parts of Inferno Hell in search for the Earth Devil?”
Tian Yishan said.
“What?! Earth Devil?!”

Guan Yiyun and the few other men exclaimed at the same time. All of them had heard about the Earth Devil before, it was the king of Inferno Hell, and Jiang Chen was actually eyeing it. His courage simply knew no limits.
“Junior disciple Jiang, you really have to think twice about this! Also, why do you want to hunt for the Earth Devil?”
Guan Yiyun asked in a puzzled tone.
“To save Han Yan.”
Jiang Chen said.
“What happened to Han Yan?”
Guan Yiyun was startled.
Jiang Chen explained what happened in the Black Sect after Guan Yiyun left, focusing on the incident where Fan Kun had assaulted Yan Chenyu and Han Yan.

“Han Yan was seriously injured, and he could die at any time. I need the Earth Devil’s demon soul in order to save his life, that’s why I came to Inferno Hell to look for the Earth Devil. I know that with my current strength, there is no way I can be its match, but I can’t just sit here and do nothing. At least, I can find out some details about this Earth Devil.”
Jiang Chen said.

“Damn it! That bastard Fan Kun, he must have thought that no one from the inner circle could stop him after I left, that’s why he behaved so arrogantly and did all that! But, it was his misfortune to offend you!”

Guan Yiyun couldn’t help but curse out. When he was still in the Black Sect, although Fan Kun was backed by his grandfather, Guan Yiyun could actually suppress him. Fan Kun still behaved nicely back then. When Guan Yiyun left, Fan Kun began behaving arrogantly.
“We must save Brother Yan, but it’s extremely dangerous to kill the Earth Devil.”
Guan Yiyun frowned.
“Never mind, I know you all suffered injuries, let’s rest for now. I’ll proceed to the depths of Inferno Hell tomorrow. Putting aside the Earth Devil, I really want to check out this place.”
Jiang Chen said.
“Alright, we’ll follow chief Jiang and venture into the deeper areas, we can also kill some Nine Life Crystal Beasts along the way.”
Everyone were nodding their heads. Now, they had made Jiang Chen their ultimate leader. No matter what decision Jiang Chen made, they would just follow without any objections.

After that, the men returned to their individual rooms within the stronghold to rest. They had suffered some minor injuries in the violent battle just now, but nothing too serious. With their cultivation level, it would only take them a day to fully recover.
Jiang Chen and Big Yellow entered the same room.
“Hehe, buddy, hurry up and check on our loot today!”
Big Yellow couldn’t wait any longer.

“No need to check it out, we’ve gotten a huge amount of loot this time. Quite a few storage rings are actually filled. I think there are more than 100,000,000 Mortal Restoration Pills, 8,000 Earth Restoration Pills, piles of demon souls and devil souls, over 500 combat weapons, 300 of them mid-ranked combat weapons, and the rest are high-ranked combat weapons.”
Jiang Chen said with a big smile.
“Fuck! Buddy, you instantly because a millionaire! This is a huge amount of wealth!”
Big Yellow was excitedly bouncing up and down. After robbing so many warriors, of course there would be a lot of wealth.
Suddenly, while Jiang Chen was scanning the storage rings with his divine sense, he found a thick book hidden within one of the storage rings.
“This is Yang Shuo’s storage ring, he actually hid something within... Don’t tell me it’s some rare treasure?”
With a thought in his mind, the golden colored book immediately appeared in Jiang Chen’s hand. Then, he saw three big words on the cover: Illusion Heart Sutra.
“What is this?”
Big Yellow asked.
“This is the powerful combat skill Yang Shuo used, he used an illusion realm to trap me that day when we fought, and he almost killed me. This is the skill he used.”

Jiang Chen’s eyes lit up. An illusion realm that could even confused Jiang Chen was certainly something extraordinary. Yang Shuo must have obtained the Illusion Heart Sutra through luck and accident. Jiang Chen knew how terrifying the Great Illusion Realm was, as he had experienced it himself.

Jiang Chen eagerly flipped over to the first page. The book only had a few pages, but it clearly stated how one could unleash the Great Illusion Realm. When Big Yellow extended his dog head and finished reading the book, he too couldn’t help but feel surprised.
“Damn! This Heart Sutra is really terrifying, the illusions created by it can actually change according to different people!”
Big Yellow said.

“That’s right, the Illusion Heart Sutra focused on fantasy and heart. As long as a man has a fantasy in his mind, he will be affected by the Great Illusion Realm. His heart will be immersed in his own fantasy, and he will have a difficult time pulling himself out.”
Jiang Chen sighed. Everyone had fantasies, and the fantasy existed within their hearts.

chapters.title: Chapter 226 - Inferno Hell Slaughter
paragraphs: If it was just some ordinary combat skill, Jiang Chen would definitely not pay any attention to it, but this Illusion Heart Sutra was something Jiang Chen’s soul craved for. He had been focused on cultivating the Nine Celestial Solar Energies in his previous life, so not once had he tried to learn anything regarding illusion. It was also partly because this kind of skill was incredibly rare.

But more importantly, there was a great risk when unleash an illusion realm. Not everyone would be affected by an illusion realm, and once the illusion didn’t work as it is supposed to, the person who unleashed it would suffer a massive backlash, and if the illusion realm was forcefully broken by someone, the backlash would be even greater, just like what happened to Yang Shuo.

But this Illusion Heart Sutra was different from ordinary illusion skills, because everyone had some sort of fantasy, and the fantasy exists within their heart. Once a person was trapped in the Great Illusion Realm, he would be trapped in his own fantasy without being able to pull himself out.

It happened to Jiang Chen. What happened on the Saint Cliff 100 years ago had cast an unforgettable shadow in Jiang Chen’s heart. The Realm of Immortals was a fantasy he couldn’t forget, even in his second life. The scene on the Saint Cliff was a nightmare that he would never be able to forget. Therefore, even Jiang Chen was almost killed by Yang Shuo, as he was trapped in the illusion, and couldn’t pull himself out. If it was just some ordinary illusion, Jiang Chen would easily be able to get out.
This was the terrifying part of the Illusion Heart Sutra. Therefore, Jiang Chen prepared to spend some time cultivating it. It might be put to good use during a critical moment.
“Buddy, this Illusion Heart Sutra is really awesome! Why don’t you cultivate it?”
Big Yellow said.

“It’s a really good skill, it would be a waste not cultivating it. I’ve never cultivated any illusion skills before, but since I have the Great Soul Derivation skill as my foundation, I think it’ll be a piece of cake for me to cultivate the Illusion Heart Sutra.”

Jiang Chen’s eyes lit up, and a confident look emerged on his face. Cultivating an illusion skill was a test to the person’s mind and soul. Jiang Chen had the Great Soul Derivation skill as his foundation; which gave him a unique advantage when it came to cultivating the Illusion Heart Sutra.
“Big Yellow, go find another place to sleep, I’ll start cultivating this Illusion Heart Sutra. Once I’m done, we’ll proceed to the depths of Inferno Hell to find out more about the Earth Devil.”
Jiang Chen said.

After Big Yellow Dog left, Jiang Chen had immersed himself totally in the cultivation of Heart Sutra of Fantasy, the most important aspect in cultivating it was the ability of sense, using it together with the scripts written in the Heart Sutra and unleashed the Realm of Great Illusion.

At the same time, in an unknown place near the border of Inferno Hell, a human figure suddenly descended from above. It was a young man with a long, fiery red robe. He had a pair of sharp eyes, and flames were emitting from all over his body.

“Jiang Chen, I, Huo Yuner have been quenching my body using magma, and I have gone through miserable pain. Finally, I’ve mastered my flame skill and broken through to the peak Mid Divine Core realm. Just you wait, I’ll kill you in this hellhole and get revenge for you insulting me that day!”

The young man in the fiery red robe was none other than Huo Yuner from the Green Sanctuary Sect. Back in the day, Jiang Chen killed Yun Can at the Black Sect, and insulted Huo Yuner with his words, leaving behind an unforgettable shadow in his heart. Since then, Huo Yuner had sworn that he would definitely fight Jiang Chen one day. Even if he would get himself killed, he still wanted to fight.

After he had returned from the Black Sect, Huo Yuner had gone back into the Karst Cave and began quenching himself with magma, allowing him to master his flame skill in a very short period of time and experience a surge in his cultivation level. But, rushing for a quick result was inadvisable, as it would hinder Huo Yuner’s future development. But, he didn’t care so much about that. He wanted to get rid of the shadow that Jiang Chen had left in his heart, because if he didn’t, he would be able to have any development in his cultivation in the future.

After having a surge in his cultivation level, Huo Yuner had become extremely confident. With his cultivation at the peak Mid Divine Core realm, he believed that he would easily be able to kill Jiang Chen, so he rushed to Inferno Hell at once. The goal for this trip was simple; kill Jiang Chen.
One day later...

Jiang Chen who had been cultivating for an entire day finally opened his eyes. Two bright beams shot out from his eyes, causing the air in front of him to vibrate. Streams of energy swam around Jiang Chen’s body, and light waves could be seen around him.
A light smile emerged on Jiang Chen’s face. With a thought in his mind, the light waves went back into his body.
“The Great Illusion Realm is truly amazing.”

Jiang Chen said with a smile. In just one day, he had completely mastered the Illusion Heart Sutra and was able to unleash the Great Illusion Realm. If Yang Shuo was still alive and learned how quickly Jiang Chen mastered the skill, his jaw would definitely drop.

Jiang Chen pushed open the door, then he immediately saw Tian Yishan and the other men, waiting outside his room. All of them were brimming with energy, and their injuries were fully recovered. Also, Wang Heng’s cultivation base at the Early Divine Core realm had completely stabilized.
“Chief Jiang, are we leaving now?”
Wang Heng asked.

“Yes, I’m going to enter the depths of Inferno Hell now. First, I’ll have to find out where the Earth Devil is. Jiang Chen said.

Yang Meng said.

They all picked up a high-ranked combat weapon that suited them. Inferno Hell was a place filled with dangers, and if they had a high-ranked combat weapon, it would be a great help to their combat strength.

The group of men were flying extremely quickly across numerous mountain ranges and wastelands, bumping into man human warriors along their way. These warriors were either rushing back to Inferno City from the depths of Inferno Hell, or they were going towards the depths of Inferno Hell.

Those who just came back from the depths of Inferno Hell were mostly in groups of few warriors. It was rare to see a lone ranger here. Also, most of them were injured and in different conditions. From this, one could easily tell how dangerous the depths of Inferno Hell was.

When most of these warriors saw Jiang Chen’s group, they immediately showed their hostility and avoided bumping into his group. In Inferno Hell, robbing and being robbed was perfectly normal, it happened almost every single day; that’s why no one dared be careless here.
Put it this way, everything around a warrior was his enemy within Inferno Hell. Demons, devils, Nine Life Crystal Beasts, and humans. The relationship between them had always been hostile.
“Why haven’t we encountered any monsters yet?”
Jiang Chen asked.
“Because of some unknown reason, no demons or devils can be found within 2,000 miles of Inferno City. Beyond this 2,000 mile radius, the amount of demons and devils will become greater.”
Tian Yishan answered.

Soon after, Jiang Chen and the group passed the 2,000 mile line. An ancient mountain range that stretched as far as the eye could see appeared in front of them. Countless mountain peaks could be seen everywhere on the massive mountain range. All kinds of flowers, plants and trees with cold characteristics were growing everywhere, and the skies above the mountain range was covered in greyish fog, giving the entire mountain an indescribable creepiness.
Under such an environment, anyone would feel gloomy, and their emotions would tense up.
“Let’s go.”

Jiang Chen was the first one to descend and begin walking into the mountain range. Big Yellow had an excited expression, and he went 3-4 meters forwards with each jump he took. He eventually surpassed Jiang Chen.
Roar!

An angry roar sounded out from not far. A nearly 10 meter tall figure covered in a steaming devilish aura suddenly emerged and got in Big Yellow’s way. The creature had a ferocious look, and devilish flames emerged from its body. It was an Evil Devil.
“An Early Divine Core Evil Devil! We just arrived here, and we actually bumped into an Early Divine Core Evil Devil... so unlucky...”
Guan Yiyun said with a smile. Although they were unlucky, none of them panicked. For them, an Early Divine Core Evil Devil couldn’t pose any threat to them.
Swoosh!
Right after Guan Yiyun’s words left his mouth, Big Yellow had already started moving. With extreme speed, he slammed his diamond grade head into the Evil Devil’s head.
Bang!

A deep yet subtle banging sound was heard. The Evil Devil didn’t even have the chance to let out a cry as its head had already been crushed into pieces. Jiang Chen threw his hand out and grabbed the devil soul.

All the devil souls and demon souls were treasures for Jiang Chen. Although he didn’t want to use them right now, he could still save them for later use, just like how he was saving Mortal Restoration Pills and Earth Restoration Pills. He would need to form 108,000 Dragon Marks before it could be considered that he had mastered the Dragon Transformation skill, and currently, he only had 750 Dragon Marks. It was still a long way to go. He had no idea how much energy he would actually need in order to reach that level, so therefore, the more souls he saved up, the better.
“Master dog’s head is really formidable, it shines so brightly it almost blinded my eyes!”

Wang Heng’s words wasn’t really flattery, as everyone here had the same thought. They never knew that a dog’s head could be so strong! It was a Divine Core Evil Devil, and if any of them had bumped into one, it would take them a tremendous amount of effort to kill it. But, Big Yellow, he just killed it in an instant, it didn’t even have the time to react.

Jiang Chen reminded.

All the men nodded their heads. In fact, they didn’t really need to be reminded by Jiang Chen. All of them had stayed in Inferno Hell much longer than Jiang Chen had, and it wasn’t their first time coming to the depths of Inferno Hell. They even knew which places they could go, and which places to avoid.

An hour later, the group of men arrived at the depths of some woods. The conditions of these men was different from before. Tian Yishan and the other men were tightly gripping their combat weapons, and there was blood dripping down from the combat weapons.

These men had fought and slaughtered continuously along their way, they had killed dozens of powerful demons and devils, including one Nine Life Crystal Beast. Wang Heng exclaimed. His expression immediately became serious, as the Nine Life Crystal Beast was the toughest creature to kill.
