chapters.title: Chapter 227 - Natural Formation
paragraphs: In Inferno Hell, it was very easy to recognize the aura of a Nine Life Crystal Beast, as they had the purest essence aura that no other monster could compare with. Their auras also caused all the fog to disappear wherever they went.

The few glowing figures in front of them were Nine Life Crystal Beasts, and that’s why Wang Heng and the others had suddenly become so serious. Actually, all those who came to Inferno Hell hoped to bump into a Nine Life Crystal Beast, but at the same time, everyone were scared of doing so. A crystal core was truly an excellent treasure which provided endless benefits to warriors, but Nine Life Crystal Beast had nine lives, which made it extremely difficult to kill. Also, it had incredible combat strength that few demons or devils could compare with.
“Judging from the auras, I think there are at least 8 Nine Life Crystal Beasts. Looks like our luck today is really bad.”

Yang Meng said. For any human warrior, it was extremely bad luck to bump into a group of Nine Life Crystal Beasts. Each crystal beast had nine lives, and no one could fight a group of 8 crystal beasts. Even if an alliance’s group had more than ten men, they would still run away upon seeing such a big group of crystal beasts.
“This isn’t bad luck, you should say that we have good luck today!”
Guan Yiyun said with a smile on his face.

“That’s right! If there only were a few of us here, the only option left for us after bumping into so many Divine Core crystal beasts would be to run. However, we have Big Yellow and brother Jiang with us today, and that means that these crystal beasts are here to give us their crystal cores.”
Tian Yishan shrugged his shoulders and spoke with a casual expression.
Roar!

The creatures continuously let out roars. In just the blink of an eye, a total of 8 crystal beasts arrived in front of Jiang Chen’s group. Out of these 8 crystal beasts, 6 of them were Divine Core monsters, and the remaining two were Heavenly Core monsters. The strongest crystal beast was a Mid Divine Core monster. With its formidable combat strength and unique nine lives, even a Late Divine Core warrior would have to be extra careful when dealing with it.

The Nine Life Crystal Beast had no mouth, but the sound it made was unusually deep, and it also carried a slight shrill tone, causing anyone who heard it to feel extremely uncomfortable. Because of the crystal beast’s unique characteristics, they would usually hunt for demons and devils, and eat their souls, transforming it in into the purest energy for themselves. At the same time, they were also able to eat the Divine Cores in human bodies. It was considered a great supplement for them.
The eight crystal beasts had locked down on Jiang Chen and his group. It wasn’t hard to hear excitement in their roars just now, it was as if they had just found the most delicious food.

“The Divine Core crystal cores are very useful to me, especially those Mid Divine Core crystal cores. Brothers, let’s kill them all, I’ll keep those Mid Divine Core crystal cores, the rest belongs to you.”

A light smile emerged on Jiang Chen’s face. Then, the Bloodthirsty Sword appeared in his hand. He slightly moved his body, turning himself in a beam of light as he dashed towards the Mid Divine Core crystal beast.
Kaka...

Big Yellow loved fighting, it was a natural instinct for all Divine Beasts. When Jiang Chen had started moving, Big Yellow had also started ramming towards one of the crystal beasts while rocking his head back and forth.
Bang!

Big Yellow was extremely fast. With just a single head-butt, he had crushed the Early Divine Core crystal beast into pieces. As expected, in the next second, the crystal beast was revived, and its energy was completely identical to its previous state.
“Brothers, let us kill! The crystal cores will belong to the person who kills it!”

Tian Yishan strengthened his spirit and dashed forwards. There were seven of them in the group, and all of them were Divine Core warriors. Also, Tian Yishan and Guan Yiyun were both super strong men from the younger generation, and it wasn’t really difficult for them to deal with ordinary Nine Life Crystal Beasts. All it took was killing them nine times.
Bang!
At this moment, killing intents filled the scene, countless energy ripples were wreaking havoc within the woods, and all flowers, herbs and trees were destroyed in an instant.

When the Mid Divine Core crystal beast saw Jiang Chen coming towards it, it immediately let out a wild roar. Then, it raised its seemingly indestructible palm and slapped towards Jiang Chen. If the palm hit its target, Jiang Chen would be turned into meat paste.
“Hmph! Die for me now!”

Jiang Chen let out a cold snort. The longsword in his hand continuously let out a buzzing sound, then he covered the entire Bloodthirsty Sword with his golden colored yuan energy. With all his strength, Jiang Chen slashed the sword towards his target.
Slash!
Followed by a slashing sound, the crystal beast’s palm was cut in half. The sword didn’t stop there, it continued and cut the crystal beast’s body in half as well.

Jiang Chen had 750 Dragon Marks right now, which gave him incredible combat strength. No ordinary Mid Divine Core warriors would be his match, and the same went for the strong crystal beasts. Just one day ago, the combined forces of over 50 Mid Divine Core warriors was easily defeated by Jiang Chen.
Click click!
After killing it with a single strike, the Nine Life Crystal Beast revived to its original state, then it once again initiated an attack towards Jiang Chen.
“The ending will be the same even if you have 900 lives, let alone 9 lives.

Jiang Chen seemed incomparably majestic, and the longsword in his hand seemed like the most powerful weapon in the world. He attacked once again, and even though the powerful crystal beast tried its best to defend itself, it still couldn’t survive Jiang Chen’s sword attack. It was killed once again.
Only a Late Divine Core crystal beast might be a match for Jiang Chen right now.
Roar!
The eight crystal bears let out furious and once again engaged in a cruel fight with Jiang Chen and his group.

Big Yellow was the fastest amongst all the people here, and his head was like a perfect diamond that could crush anytime. In just a few breaths time, he had completely killed the Early Divine Core crystal beast. He didn’t even allow it the chance to escape.
“The energy contained within this crystal core seems nice, and the taste isn’t bad either. This master dog likes it.”
Big Yellow put the crystal core into his mouth, and using his dog teeth, he crunched the crystal core into pieces, giving it a taste before completely swallowing it.
“Big Yellow; it’s such a waste for you to eat the crystal core. A reckless waste of treasure.”
When Jiang Chen who had killed his opponent six times saw Big Yellow eat the crystal core, he couldn’t help but comment.
“Get lost! Why is it a waste when daddy eats them? A treasure like this is useful for the master dog as well! If I obtain any more crystal cores in the future, don’t try and take them from me!”
Big Yellow said.

Jiang Chen shook his head and didn’t bother about the dog anymore. He kept waving and striking with the longsword in his hand, and in just a short moment, he had killed his opponent 8 times. When the crystal beast revived for the last time, fear finally emerged in its single eye, and without any hesitation, it turned around and started running.

The powerful crystal beast did have some intelligence. Under normal circumstances, when they fought an opponent who was much stronger than them, after being killed a few times, they would evaluate how much energy their opponent had consumed. If the opponent was still brimming with energy, and didn’t look tired at all, they would choose to flee.
“Trying to run?”
A grin emerged on Jiang Chen’s face. He wouldn’t give this crystal Beast any chances to escape; there was no way he would mess up with a sure thing.
Bang!

The energy carried by the sword was simply massive! The Bloodthirsty Sword descended from the skies in an invincible manner, and for the last time, it slashed the crystal beast in half. The shattered body finally began transforming into bits of bright lights which merged to become a transparent crystal core. Without hesitation, Jiang Chen took the crystal core and stored it in his storage ring.
Bang bang bang...

Energies splashed all over the place, Guan Yiyun and the others were still fighting. Obviously, there was no way their speed could be compared to Jiang Chen and Big Yellow. The battle between Wang Heng and the two Heavenly Core crystal beasts had almost come to an end.
“These guys are too slow. This master dog will help them finish.”
Big Yellow said in an impatient manner.
“Don’t do it, Big Yellow. Just let them finish the fight themselves.”

Jiang Chen stopped Big Yellow from interfering. He had told these men that those crystal cores belongs to him, and therefore, he would let them obtain it by themselves. All these men were fierce and brutal people, and since they had been able to survive in Inferno Hell for such a long time, they surely had their own strong skills.
Soon, with the joint forces of these few men, the battle had come to an end, and the few men began dividing the obtained crystal cores.
“Satisfying, what a joyful satisfaction!”
One of the men said. After the battle, not only did he not show any fatigue, he actually looked more energetic.
“It’s a pleasant experience to fight together with chief Jiang!”
Wang Heng said with an excited tone.
“Let’s go, we’ll move deeper into the area.”
Jiang Chen said.
“Junior disciple Jiang, the dangers will become greater the deeper we venture. We need to be extra careful.”
Guan Yiyun reminded.

“That’s right, there is a high possibility of us bumping into some Late Divine Core demons and devils in the depths of Inferno Hell, or perhaps even the mighty Combat Soul beings. Besides that, I’ve also heard that there are some natural formations and defense mechanisms within the depths of Inferno Hell, which is really powerful as well.”
Tian Yishan too reminded everyone.
“Alright, everyone, be extra careful as we venture deeper into this area.”
Jiang Chen nodded his head, then he led the group and continue their journey towards the depths of Inferno Hell.
After nearly four miles of walking, the road within the mountain range became extremely rough. It was very inconvenient to walk on it, but for all these Divine Core warriors, this was nothing.
Ahh!
Suddenly, everyone heard a loud shout. When they turned around, they immediately found out that Wang Heng had disappeared.
“Wang Heng disappeared, it was him who let out that shout just now!”
Yang Meng was shocked.
“What happened?”
Guan Yiyun furrowed his brows. Everyone were tense as they looked around, but they found nothing.
“There is nothing around here, no signs of monsters either. It’s impossible for Wang Heng to randomly disappear...”
Tian Yishan furrowed his brows as well.
Right at this moment, Jiang Chen’s gaze stopped between the two black trees not far away from them; it was the exact location where Wang Heng had disappeared.
“Guys, look at that spot.”
Jiang Chen said.
Everyone turned around and looked at the spot Jiang Chen pointed at. However, they could only see two ordinary trees, and they didn’t find anything unusual.
“Junior disciple Jiang, that spot looks normal, there is nothing special about it.”
Guan Yiyun said.

“How could it be normal? Just now, it was you who reminded me, you told me there are natural defense mechanisms and formations in the depths of Inferno Hell. Here, there is natural formation, and Wang Hen disappeared into this formation.”
Jiang Chen said.
“Good catch, Little Chen! You can even see natural formations!”

Big Yellow praised. He had a certain level of understanding towards defense mechanisms and formation, most likely because of his innate treasure hunting ability. Therefore, Big Yellow could immediately tell there was a natural formation after it was pointed out.
“What? You’re saying there is a natural formation between these two trees?”
Guan Yiyun was shocked.

“That’s right. A natural formation is very different from those made by humans. A natural formation is naturally formed by nature after gathering natural yuan energies; it’s a miraculous process, and humans know very little about it. Anyone can easily be trapped by it if they don’t pay enough attention.
Jiang Chen explained.

sentences.text: In Inferno Hell, it was very easy to recognize the aura of a Nine Life Crystal Beast, as they had the purest essence aura that no other monster could compare with.
Their auras also caused all the fog to disappear wherever they went.
The few glowing figures in front of them were Nine Life Crystal Beasts, and that’s why Wang Heng and the others had suddenly become so serious.
Actually, all those who came to Inferno Hell hoped to bump into a Nine Life Crystal Beast, but at the same time, everyone were scared of doing so.
A crystal core was truly an excellent treasure which provided endless benefits to warriors, but Nine Life Crystal Beast had nine lives, which made it extremely difficult to kill.
Also, it had incredible combat strength that few demons or devils could compare with.
“Judging from the auras, I think there are at least 8 Nine Life Crystal Beasts.
Looks like our luck today is really bad.”
Yang Meng said.
For any human warrior, it was extremely bad luck to bump into a group of Nine Life Crystal Beasts.
Each crystal beast had nine lives, and no one could fight a group of 8 crystal beasts.
Even if an alliance’s group had more than ten men, they would still run away upon seeing such a big group of crystal beasts.
“This isn’t bad luck, you should say that we have good luck today!”
Guan Yiyun said with a smile on his face.
“That’s right!
If there only were a few of us here, the only option left for us after bumping into so many Divine Core crystal beasts would be to run.
However, we have Big Yellow and brother Jiang with us today, and that means that these crystal beasts are here to give us their crystal cores.”
Tian Yishan shrugged his shoulders and spoke with a casual expression.
Roar!
The creatures continuously let out roars.
In just the blink of an eye, a total of 8 crystal beasts arrived in front of Jiang Chen’s group.
Out of these 8 crystal beasts, 6 of them were Divine Core monsters, and the remaining two were Heavenly Core monsters.
The strongest crystal beast was a Mid Divine Core monster.
With its formidable combat strength and unique nine lives, even a Late Divine Core warrior would have to be extra careful when dealing with it.
The Nine Life Crystal Beast had no mouth, but the sound it made was unusually deep, and it also carried a slight shrill tone, causing anyone who heard it to feel extremely uncomfortable.
Because of the crystal beast’s unique characteristics, they would usually hunt for demons and devils, and eat their souls, transforming it in into the purest energy for themselves.
At the same time, they were also able to eat the Divine Cores in human bodies.
It was considered a great supplement for them.
The eight crystal beasts had locked down on Jiang Chen and his group.
It wasn’t hard to hear excitement in their roars just now, it was as if they had just found the most delicious food.
“The Divine Core crystal cores are very useful to me, especially those Mid Divine Core crystal cores.
Brothers, let’s kill them all, I’ll keep those Mid Divine Core crystal cores, the rest belongs to you.”
A light smile emerged on Jiang Chen’s face.
Then, the Bloodthirsty Sword appeared in his hand.
He slightly moved his body, turning himself in a beam of light as he dashed towards the Mid Divine Core crystal beast.
Kaka...
Big Yellow loved fighting, it was a natural instinct for all Divine Beasts.
When Jiang Chen had started moving, Big Yellow had also started ramming towards one of the crystal beasts while rocking his head back and forth.
Bang!
Big Yellow was extremely fast.
With just a single head-butt, he had crushed the Early Divine Core crystal beast into pieces.
As expected, in the next second, the crystal beast was revived, and its energy was completely identical to its previous state.
“Brothers, let us kill!
The crystal cores will belong to the person who kills it!”
Tian Yishan strengthened his spirit and dashed forwards.
There were seven of them in the group, and all of them were Divine Core warriors.
Also, Tian Yishan and Guan Yiyun were both super strong men from the younger generation, and it wasn’t really difficult for them to deal with ordinary Nine Life Crystal Beasts.
All it took was killing them nine times.
Bang!
At this moment, killing intents filled the scene, countless energy ripples were wreaking havoc within the woods, and all flowers, herbs and trees were destroyed in an instant.
When the Mid Divine Core crystal beast saw Jiang Chen coming towards it, it immediately let out a wild roar.
Then, it raised its seemingly indestructible palm and slapped towards Jiang Chen.
If the palm hit its target, Jiang Chen would be turned into meat paste.
“Hmph!
Die for me now!”
Jiang Chen let out a cold snort.
The longsword in his hand continuously let out a buzzing sound, then he covered the entire Bloodthirsty Sword with his golden colored yuan energy.
With all his strength, Jiang Chen slashed the sword towards his target.
Slash!
Followed by a slashing sound, the crystal beast’s palm was cut in half.
The sword didn’t stop there, it continued and cut the crystal beast’s body in half as well.
Jiang Chen had 750 Dragon Marks right now, which gave him incredible combat strength.
No ordinary Mid Divine Core warriors would be his match, and the same went for the strong crystal beasts.
Just one day ago, the combined forces of over 50 Mid Divine Core warriors was easily defeated by Jiang Chen.
Click click!
After killing it with a single strike, the Nine Life Crystal Beast revived to its original state, then it once again initiated an attack towards Jiang Chen.
“The ending will be the same even if you have 900 lives, let alone 9 lives.
Jiang Chen seemed incomparably majestic, and the longsword in his hand seemed like the most powerful weapon in the world.
He attacked once again, and even though the powerful crystal beast tried its best to defend itself, it still couldn’t survive Jiang Chen’s sword attack.
It was killed once again.
Only a Late Divine Core crystal beast might be a match for Jiang Chen right now.
Roar!
The eight crystal bears let out furious and once again engaged in a cruel fight with Jiang Chen and his group.
Big Yellow was the fastest amongst all the people here, and his head was like a perfect diamond that could crush anytime.
In just a few breaths time, he had completely killed the Early Divine Core crystal beast.
He didn’t even allow it the chance to escape.
“The energy contained within this crystal core seems nice, and the taste isn’t bad either.
This master dog likes it.”
Big Yellow put the crystal core into his mouth, and using his dog teeth, he crunched the crystal core into pieces, giving it a taste before completely swallowing it.
“Big Yellow; it’s such a waste for you to eat the crystal core.
A reckless waste of treasure.”
When Jiang Chen who had killed his opponent six times saw Big Yellow eat the crystal core, he couldn’t help but comment.
“Get lost!
Why is it a waste when daddy eats them?
A treasure like this is useful for the master dog as well!
If I obtain any more crystal cores in the future, don’t try and take them from me!”
Big Yellow said.
Jiang Chen shook his head and didn’t bother about the dog anymore.
He kept waving and striking with the longsword in his hand, and in just a short moment, he had killed his opponent 8 times.
When the crystal beast revived for the last time, fear finally emerged in its single eye, and without any hesitation, it turned around and started running.
The powerful crystal beast did have some intelligence.
Under normal circumstances, when they fought an opponent who was much stronger than them, after being killed a few times, they would evaluate how much energy their opponent had consumed.
If the opponent was still brimming with energy, and didn’t look tired at all, they would choose to flee.
“Trying to run?”
A grin emerged on Jiang Chen’s face.
He wouldn’t give this crystal Beast any chances to escape; there was no way he would mess up with a sure thing.
Bang!
The energy carried by the sword was simply massive!
The Bloodthirsty Sword descended from the skies in an invincible manner, and for the last time, it slashed the crystal beast in half.
The shattered body finally began transforming into bits of bright lights which merged to become a transparent crystal core.
Without hesitation, Jiang Chen took the crystal core and stored it in his storage ring.
Bang bang bang...
Energies splashed all over the place, Guan Yiyun and the others were still fighting.
Obviously, there was no way their speed could be compared to Jiang Chen and Big Yellow.
The battle between Wang Heng and the two Heavenly Core crystal beasts had almost come to an end.
“These guys are too slow.
This master dog will help them finish.”
Big Yellow said in an impatient manner.
“Don’t do it, Big Yellow.
Just let them finish the fight themselves.”
Jiang Chen stopped Big Yellow from interfering.
He had told these men that those crystal cores belongs to him, and therefore, he would let them obtain it by themselves.
All these men were fierce and brutal people, and since they had been able to survive in Inferno Hell for such a long time, they surely had their own strong skills.
Soon, with the joint forces of these few men, the battle had come to an end, and the few men began dividing the obtained crystal cores.
“Satisfying, what a joyful satisfaction!”
One of the men said.
After the battle, not only did he not show any fatigue, he actually looked more energetic.
“It’s a pleasant experience to fight together with chief Jiang!”
Wang Heng said with an excited tone.
“Let’s go, we’ll move deeper into the area.”
Jiang Chen said.
“Junior disciple Jiang, the dangers will become greater the deeper we venture.
We need to be extra careful.”
Guan Yiyun reminded.
“That’s right, there is a high possibility of us bumping into some Late Divine Core demons and devils in the depths of Inferno Hell, or perhaps even the mighty Combat Soul beings.
Besides that, I’ve also heard that there are some natural formations and defense mechanisms within the depths of Inferno Hell, which is really powerful as well.”
Tian Yishan too reminded everyone.
“Alright, everyone, be extra careful as we venture deeper into this area.”
Jiang Chen nodded his head, then he led the group and continue their journey towards the depths of Inferno Hell.
After nearly four miles of walking, the road within the mountain range became extremely rough.
It was very inconvenient to walk on it, but for all these Divine Core warriors, this was nothing.
Ahh!
Suddenly, everyone heard a loud shout.
When they turned around, they immediately found out that Wang Heng had disappeared.
“Wang Heng disappeared, it was him who let out that shout just now!”
Yang Meng was shocked.
“What happened?”
Guan Yiyun furrowed his brows.
Everyone were tense as they looked around, but they found nothing.
“There is nothing around here, no signs of monsters either.
It’s impossible for Wang Heng to randomly disappear...”
Tian Yishan furrowed his brows as well.
Right at this moment, Jiang Chen’s gaze stopped between the two black trees not far away from them; it was the exact location where Wang Heng had disappeared.
“Guys, look at that spot.”
Jiang Chen said.
Everyone turned around and looked at the spot Jiang Chen pointed at.
However, they could only see two ordinary trees, and they didn’t find anything unusual.
“Junior disciple Jiang, that spot looks normal, there is nothing special about it.”
Guan Yiyun said.
“How could it be normal?
Just now, it was you who reminded me, you told me there are natural defense mechanisms and formations in the depths of Inferno Hell.
Here, there is natural formation, and Wang Hen disappeared into this formation.”
Jiang Chen said.
“Good catch, Little Chen!
You can even see natural formations!”
Big Yellow praised.
He had a certain level of understanding towards defense mechanisms and formation, most likely because of his innate treasure hunting ability.
Therefore, Big Yellow could immediately tell there was a natural formation after it was pointed out.
“What?
You’re saying there is a natural formation between these two trees?”
Guan Yiyun was shocked.
“That’s right.
A natural formation is very different from those made by humans.
A natural formation is naturally formed by nature after gathering natural yuan energies; it’s a miraculous process, and humans know very little about it.
Anyone can easily be trapped by it if they don’t pay enough attention.
Jiang Chen explained.

chapters.title: Chapter 228 - Devil’s Cave
paragraphs: Obviously, Wang Heng had accidentally stepped into a natural formation and disappeared.
“Chief Jiang, what should we do now? Is Wang Heng in any danger?”
Yang Meng worriedly asked.

“Under normal circumstances, the person who stepped into a formation would be trapped, and he would definitely not disappear. Therefore, the invisible formation here should be similar to an illusion realm. I suppose the real scene behind these two trees are as simple as what we are looking at right now, perhaps there is something unusual here, but it’s covered by this formation, like a camouflage that’s trying to distract us. Therefore, I assume that Wang Heng disappeared because he entered the scene behind this formation. Wang Heng’s life isn’t at risk, currently.”
Said Jiang Chen said.

“That’s right, this formation carries an illusionary characteristic, but it won’t hurt anyone. Therefore, Wang Heng won’t get killed by this formation. But, we can’t eliminate the possibility that there is danger on the other side of the formation, as none of us know what’s on the other side.”
Big Yellow commented with what he knew as well.

Tian Yishan and Guan Yiyun looked at each other, both could see shock in each other’s eye. What shocked them wasn’t the formation, but Jiang Chen’s understand towards formation. He explained it all like he was a grandmaster when it came to formations.

A young man in his teens, it was hard to imagine why he seemed to know everything. He had unique innate abilities and formidable combat strength, and he was also able to concoct all sorts of pills with 100% effectiveness with ease. And now, he showed them his vast knowledge in formations and defense mechanism. They wouldn’t believe that an abnormal monster like this actually existed if they didn’t personally know him.
“What should we do now?”
Guan Yiyun asked.

“I also want to know what’s behind this formation, I have decided to enter the formation and check it out for myself, while saving Wang Heng at the same time. All of you just wait here for me, there is no need to take the risk together.”

When Jiang Chen passed the two trees on the road side just now, even with his extraordinary senses, he couldn’t sense that there was a formation there. This proved that this formation was amazing. He had now arrived at the depths of Inferno Hell, and his goal was to search for the Earth Devil. But if he kept walking around like this, he would most likely not be able to find anything. Therefore, he wanted to try his luck by entering the formation.
“I’ll go with you.”
Guan Yiyun said.
“Let’s go in together, we can help of help if anything happens in there. Also, I too want to check out what’s happening behind the formation.”

Tian Yishan said. No one had any objections to his decision, it was safest for them to follow Jiang Chen and Big Yellow. If Jiang Chen and the rest all went into the formation, the danger would be just the same as if they had decided to stay here.
“If that’s the case, let’s enter the formation together. Everyone, be extra cautious.”
Jiang Chen reminded.

After saying that, Jiang Chen became the first person two walk towards the center of the two trees. Big Yellow followed closely behind, and he was followed by Guan Yiyun, Tian Yishan and the rest of the men.

Jiang Chen’s eyes lit up. He kept staring at the spot behind the two trees. He was cultivating the Great Soul Derivation skill, and that gave him incredibly sensitive senses. He had finally sensed the aura of the invisible natural formation.

Jiang Chen stepped between the two trees, and when his body touched the invisible formation, he immediately felt a powerful suction force invisibly working on him. Jiang Chen’s didn’t resist this force, and in an instant, he too disappeared, just like Wang Heng.
Big Yellow was even wilder, he just bashed into the center of both trees; and then he disappeared.

Behind them, Tian Yishan, Guan Yiyun and the rest of the men stared at each other. Without hesitating, the immediately followed the footsteps of Jiang Chen and Big Yellow, disappearing into the other side of the formation.

Indeed, on the other side of the formation, there was a completely different scene. Jiang Chen and the group were standing chill, and when sensing the chilling breeze blowing from all directions, their expressions became unnatural.

Underneath their feet there was a small hill. There was a dusky airflow all over the place, and chilling breeze kept blowing in their faces. When these men turned around, they couldn’t find the same two trees. There was nothing, and it was as if they just entered another dimension.
But they could actually feel that the atmosphere in this place was similar to Inferno Hell. Therefore, this place should still be within Inferno Hell, but the formation had isolated the area.
Not far from them, a man dressed in black clothes was looking around with a panicked expression. When he saw Jiang Chen, a joyful expression emerged on his face.
“Chief Jiang, you guys came here too?”
The man in black clothes was none other than Wang Heng who had accidentally stepped into the formation.
“Wang Heng, why are you careless that you stepped into the invisible natural formation?”
Yang Meng blamed Wang Heng. Actually, his expression became much more relaxed when he found out Wang Heng was alright.
“It was an accident. What is this place, actually? A boundless stretch of desolated mountains, and the ominous feeling I get from this place is much heavier than outside.”
Wang Heng said.
“The devil auras here are really strong.”
Tian Yishan said with a frown on his face.
“You’re right, intense devil auras fill every single inch of this place. I think there are a lot of Evil Devils in this place.
Guan Yiyun said.

“Not only that, aside from the intense devilish energy here, demonic energy is extremely sparse here. Looks like we have entered a devil cave. Be cautious, everyone, this place might be the colony of the Evil Devils.”
Jiang Chen said.
“What? A colony for Evil Devils? That means we just jumped into a huge crowd of devils? How are we going to leave this place?”

Wang Heng exclaimed. All of these men knew how powerful Evil Devils were, and in Inferno Hell, they were the second most powerful creatures, after the Nine Life Crystal Beast. With just the few of them here, it wasn’t difficult to imagine how dangerous it was for them to walk into a devil cave that was filled with Evil Devils.

“This place is a part of Inferno Hell, not a separate dimension. Because of the formation, I’m afraid we’re very far away from the place we were just now, and all we can do now is keep walking forwards. As long as we can leave this devil cave, we’ll be able to return to where we came from.”
Jiang Chen said.
Everyone were inwardly sighing. They couldn’t help but take a deep breath. It looked like it was going to be a tough path in front of them.
Roar!

Angry roars began sounding out throughout the place. It was the furious roars of the Evil Devils. Figures of powerful Evil Devils came into sight far in front of them. Obviously, these Evil Devils were coming towards them.
Looking at this, the group felt their nerves tensing up. No one had any idea how many Evil Devils were out there.

Jiang Chen on the other side, he had a relaxed expression. These Evil Devils were terrifying and frightening for other people, but for Jiang Chen, they were merely tonics in his eyes. The True Dragon Flames was a natural predator for these Evil Devils, and as long as he didn’t bump into some extra powerful Evil Devils, he would be able to kill them all with his flames.

Soon, the Evil Devils began spring towards them. There were a total of five Evil Devils. For Jiang Chen and his group, these five Evil Devils were nothing, because there was only one Evil Devil in the Divine Core realm, and the rest were all Heavenly Core monsters. Their combined strength meant nothing in front of these men.
“Kill them, quickly!”

Jiang Chen let out a cold snort. Big Yellow became the first one to dash forwards, and in an instant, he killed the Early Divine Core Evil Devil with his head. At the same time, Tian Yishan and Guan Yiyun attacked at the same time, killing the other four Heavenly Core Evil Devils in the blink of an eye.
Roar roar...

Even though they had finished the fight in a split second, the energy ripples and auras of human warriors still alerted the Evil Devils in the inner area of this place. Angry roars upon roars could be heard from all directions, and figures of powerful Evil Devils began appearing around the place. There were at least a couple dozens of them. At the moment, the entire place was filled with massive amounts of devilish auras, enough to send shivers down anyone’s spine.
“Damn it, how come there are so many Evil Devils here?”
Yang Meng couldn’t help but start cursing.

Jiang Chen didn’t show any emotion on his face, but his eyes were actually lighting up. For him, these Evil Devils were merely a pile of tonics, a great wealth. And the more there were, the better. Since he had come to Inferno Hell, he couldn’t leave the place with both hands empty; he had to obtain sufficient benefits, and save a huge amount of resources for his future breakthroughs. He had to kill these Evil Devils and take their devil souls to prepare for his future cultivation.
Swoosh!

This time, Jiang Chen was the one who initiated the attack. He turned into a beam of light and rammed into the group of Evil Devils. Big Yellow leapt in the crowd as well. When it came to fighting, he was happier than anyone else.
“Kill!”

Guan Yiyun let out a cold snort. All men in the group jumped into the fight at the same time. At the moment, intense killing intents filled the atmosphere, and the air itself was vibrating due to their attacks.
Bang!
Jiang Chen waved his hand and unleashed a flame sea. The True Dragon Flame, which carried the purest yang energy, instantly covered a few Evil Devils.
Roar...

The Evil Devils let out shrill cries. They had an incredible fear towards the flames, as if they had just seen their natural predator. The Heavenly Core Evil Devils couldn’t resist it at all, and were killed on the spot.

Even those Early Divine Core Evil Devils couldn’t resist the scorching heat from the True Dragon Flames. Although they wouldn’t be killed instantly, they would still roll and struggle within the flame sea, furiously roaring.
Hmph!

Jiang Chen let out a cold snort once again. Underneath his control, the True Dragon Flames transformed into countless fire arrows. These arrows were injected with yuan energy, and they swept across the Evil Devils.

In just a short moment, many Evil Devils had their bodies impaled by these fire arrows, and were killed by the True Dragon Flames. Numerous black colored devil souls were purified by the flames and fell into Jiang Chen’s storage ring.
“Haha, all of you, die!”

Jiang Chen was laughing out loudly. He expanded the coverage of the flame sea, covering more than half of the Evil Devils within. The strongest Evil Devils in this new batch were only Early Divine Core monsters, and they simply had no ability to resist Jiang Chen’s attack.
Roar roar...

The roars seemed to sound out endlessly. Many Evil Devils were burnt into ashes by the scorching True Dragon Flame, and none of the Evil Devils could unleash their evil energy underneath the True Dragon Flame’s pressure. This flame was truly their bane.

In just the blink of an eye, more than half of the Evil Devils had died. It all happened before Tian Yishan and the other men could even strike. They were stunned on the spot as they stared at Jiang Chen who was bravely slaughtering.
“Heavens, what kind of flame is that? It’s giving frightening feeling.”

“I can sense an aura of a king from the flame itself, it’s a flame with the purest yang energy, which is also the perfect rival for these Evil Devils. Look at those Evil Devils, they are scared off Jiang Chen’s flames, it’s a natural rival for them.”

“Chief Jiang is definitely the bravest man I have ever met, no one can compare with him! No wonder he didn’t show any worry on his face, even after finding out we are in the devil’s cave, it’s because he has the ultimate weapon that can defeat these Evil Devils!”

Everyone were shocked by what they witnessed. It seemed like there was no need for them to attack, just Jiang Chen alone would be able to defeat thousands upon thousands of these creatures. This wasn’t a battle, it was one-sided slaughter where no suspense existed.

Big Yellow became the first one to dash forwards, and in an instant, he killed the Early Divine Core Evil Devil with his head.
At the same time, Tian Yishan and Guan Yiyun attacked at the same time, killing the other four Heavenly Core Evil Devils in the blink of an eye.
Roar roar...
Even though they had finished the fight in a split second, the energy ripples and auras of human warriors still alerted the Evil Devils in the inner area of this place.
Angry roars upon roars could be heard from all directions, and figures of powerful Evil Devils began appearing around the place.
There were at least a couple dozens of them.
At the moment, the entire place was filled with massive amounts of devilish auras, enough to send shivers down anyone’s spine.
“Damn it, how come there are so many Evil Devils here?”
Yang Meng couldn’t help but start cursing.
Jiang Chen didn’t show any emotion on his face, but his eyes were actually lighting up.
For him, these Evil Devils were merely a pile of tonics, a great wealth.
And the more there were, the better.
Since he had come to Inferno Hell, he couldn’t leave the place with both hands empty; he had to obtain sufficient benefits, and save a huge amount of resources for his future breakthroughs.
He had to kill these Evil Devils and take their devil souls to prepare for his future cultivation.
Swoosh!
This time, Jiang Chen was the one who initiated the attack.
He turned into a beam of light and rammed into the group of Evil Devils.
Big Yellow leapt in the crowd as well.
When it came to fighting, he was happier than anyone else.
“Kill!”
Guan Yiyun let out a cold snort.
All men in the group jumped into the fight at the same time.
At the moment, intense killing intents filled the atmosphere, and the air itself was vibrating due to their attacks.
Bang!
Jiang Chen waved his hand and unleashed a flame sea.
The True Dragon Flame, which carried the purest yang energy, instantly covered a few Evil Devils.
Roar...
The Evil Devils let out shrill cries.
They had an incredible fear towards the flames, as if they had just seen their natural predator.
The Heavenly Core Evil Devils couldn’t resist it at all, and were killed on the spot.
Even those Early Divine Core Evil Devils couldn’t resist the scorching heat from the True Dragon Flames.
Although they wouldn’t be killed instantly, they would still roll and struggle within the flame sea, furiously roaring.
Hmph!
Jiang Chen let out a cold snort once again.
Underneath his control, the True Dragon Flames transformed into countless fire arrows.
These arrows were injected with yuan energy, and they swept across the Evil Devils.
In just a short moment, many Evil Devils had their bodies impaled by these fire arrows, and were killed by the True Dragon Flames.
Numerous black colored devil souls were purified by the flames and fell into Jiang Chen’s storage ring.
“Haha, all of you, die!”
Jiang Chen was laughing out loudly.
He expanded the coverage of the flame sea, covering more than half of the Evil Devils within.
The strongest Evil Devils in this new batch were only Early Divine Core monsters, and they simply had no ability to resist Jiang Chen’s attack.
Roar roar...
The roars seemed to sound out endlessly.
Many Evil Devils were burnt into ashes by the scorching True Dragon Flame, and none of the Evil Devils could unleash their evil energy underneath the True Dragon Flame’s pressure.
This flame was truly their bane.
In just the blink of an eye, more than half of the Evil Devils had died.
It all happened before Tian Yishan and the other men could even strike.
They were stunned on the spot as they stared at Jiang Chen who was bravely slaughtering.
“Heavens, what kind of flame is that?
It’s giving frightening feeling.”
“I can sense an aura of a king from the flame itself, it’s a flame with the purest yang energy, which is also the perfect rival for these Evil Devils.
Look at those Evil Devils, they are scared off Jiang Chen’s flames, it’s a natural rival for them.”
“Chief Jiang is definitely the bravest man I have ever met, no one can compare with him!
No wonder he didn’t show any worry on his face, even after finding out we are in the devil’s cave, it’s because he has the ultimate weapon that can defeat these Evil Devils!”
Everyone were shocked by what they witnessed.
It seemed like there was no need for them to attack, just Jiang Chen alone would be able to defeat thousands upon thousands of these creatures.
This wasn’t a battle, it was one-sided slaughter where no suspense existed.

chapters.title: Chapter 229 - Violent Bloodthirsty Devil
paragraphs: Whoosh...

The flames were dancing around, and the strong wind was blowing through the scene. Jiang Chen looked like a Fire God that had just descended from the heavens as he fought dozens of powerful Evil Devils all by himself, burning these creatures and making them let out miserable roars. Not long after that, all of the Evil Devils were burning to death, and their purified devil souls were stored within Jiang Chen’s storage ring at once.
Roar...

But, just as the battle ended, more furious roars sounded out from many different Evil Devils. Countless devilish energies shot up into the skies, and devil flames could be seen from where the roars sounded out. Once again, countless Evil Devils had appeared in the men’s sight. But this time, there were more than a hundred of them, and even more were coming from behind.
“Heavens! Why are there so many Evil Devils here? This really is a devil cave!”

Tian Yishan opened his mouth wide in shock, all the other men’s faces turned pale as well. There were so many Evil Devils in front of them, and once the battle begun, Jiang Chen would for sure not have any time to pay attention to them. Without Jiang Chen’s flame, they wouldn’t have an effective weapon that could defeat these Evil Devils, and once they were surrounded by them, it would mean an endless fight for them. Even if they survived the attack, they would die from depleting their own yuan energy.
“What should we do?”
Wang Heng’s expression became awful.

“The number of Evil Devils will definitely become greater and greater, this place is their colony. Senior disciple Guan, let’s split up right now, you and the rest of the men walk along the outer perimeter of this place, I’m sure you’ll be able to leave the devil cave that way. Big Yellow and I will walk in a straight line and cross this land. Not only can we help attract more attention from these Evil Devils, I can also run through this place and find out about the whereabouts of the Earth Devil. The danger will be greater is you guys keep following us, and I won’t be able to take care of you all later.”
Jiang Chen said.

“What? Junior disciple Jiang, you’re going to cross the devil cave? This is too dangerous! I’m sure there are some mighty Evil Devils residing in this colony, it will be extremely difficult for you to deal with them!”
Guan Yiyun worriedly said.

“I’ve made up my mind. Besides, we need to have someone stay back to attract the attention of these Evil Devils, only then can the rest of us have a chance at escaping. If we run in a group, we will all become targeted by these Evil Devils.”
Jiang Chen left no room for objection.
“Fine, if that’s the case, just be extra cautious. Junior disciple Jiang, I’ll meet you back in Inferno City.”

Guan Yiyun said as he patted Jiang Chen’s shoulder. Jiang Chen’s words were correct, the battle just now had alerted and attracted the colony of Evil Devils. If they chose to run around in one group, there was no way they could escape from the Devil Cave. Someone needed to stay back and fight these Evil Devils, only then could the rest of the men take the opportunity to run away. But more important, Jiang Chen was in the search for the Earth Devil. The Earth Devil and the Evil Devil were both devils, and he might be able to find out about the whereabouts of the Earth Devil in this colony of Evil Devils.
The formidable Evil Devils were approaching quickly like a tsunami, it was a dreadful scene, and any ordinary man would be scared to death by just the scene alone.

Guan Yiyun and Tian Yishan brought the rest of the men and backed off from the scene. They were going to walking along the outer perimeter of this land and leave the place. As for Jiang Chen, none of them had any worries about him. It was useless for them to worry about him. Jiang Chen was going to search for the Earth Devil in the deeper area of Inferno Hell, and all of them would just became a burden for him.

After the group left, Jiang Chen finally had no more worries. In an instant, his momentum became like a raging wave. The golden battle axe appeared in his hand, then he unleashed some True Dragon Flames, covering the entire golden battle axe with flames.
The golden battle axe had turned into a flaming battle axe, and it kept producing cracking sounds.
“Big Yellow! Let’s kill to our heart’s content today!
Jiang Chen shouted out loudly.
“Kaka, good, this master dog likes it!”

Big Yellow was extremely excited. A layer of golden flames emerged on the surface of his skin; it was his innate ability, one he have had since the moment he was born. Although its strength couldn’t compare with the True Dragon Flame, it was still a powerful flame. Besides that, the strength of this flame would keep increasing together with his cultivation level.
Roar!

The Evil Devils kept letting out wild roars. The devilish energy unleashed by the hundreds of Evil Devils had flooded the place. Each of these Evil Devils were over 3 meters tall, and the momentum of this specie was simply too brutal.
“Haha, all of you, die!”

Jiang Chen burst out into laughter as he raised the battle axe in his hand high up into the air and forcefully chopped down in front of him, unleashing a razor sharp axe energy that carried the True Dragon Flames. The axe energy landed in the center of the approaching Evil Devils.
Bang!

The ground was shaking, and the air was burning. Jiang Chen’s attack had killed instantly killed five Evil Devils. Three of them were chopped in half, and the other two were killed by the tremendous formed.
Bang bang bang...

On the other side, Big Yellow behaved savagely as a tiger. Using his head, he rammed around within the crowd of Evil Devils, causing blood and broken limbs to splash everywhere. These Evil Devils were actually really strong, many of them had broken through to the Divine Core realm, and some of them were even Mid Divine Core monsters. If any ordinary warriors faced them, their ending would only be tragic.

But too bad, their opponents were Jiang Chen and Big Yellow. Both of them were extraordinary existences. Once they unleashed their full strength, they simply didn’t care how many enemies were in front of them. More importantly, Jiang Chen’s True Dragon Flame was really efficient in dealing with these Evil Devils and give them huge pressures. Under such pressure, none of these Evil Devils could unleash their true combat strength.
Swoosh swoosh swoosh...
Jiang Chen was extremely aggressive, he had turned into an ultimate Evil Devil killer as he kept chopping and slashing with the battle axe in hand, and burning everything with his intense flames.

Every time Jiang Chen waved his axe, an Evil Devil would die. Under the powerful attacks from Jiang Chen and Big Yellow, the overbearing Evil Devils had transformed into tame sheep just waiting to be slaughtered.
“Kaka, awesome!”
Big Yellow kept laughing out loudly as he rammed into the Evil Devils, he really enjoyed this kind of excitement; he loved the pleasant feeling brought to him by slaughtering.

The Evil Devils’ roars seemed endless. They were the cruelest and most ruthless existence, all of their eyes turned red, and without any fear of death, they kept dashing towards Jiang Chen and Big Yellow, like moths flying into the fire.
Roar...

The battle seemed eternal, and each roar was actually the Evil Devils calling for more reinforcements. More and more Evil Devils were flying out from the inner area of this place, and storming towards the battlefield with great speed.
“Damn it, there are so many Evil Devils here! Buddy, we can’t just keep slaughtering like this, they just won’t stop coming!”
Big Yellow said.
“I’ll kill every single one of them. Their devils souls is like tonics for me, and I need to maximize my gains in this trip to Inferno Hell.”

There was no fear on Jiang Chen’s face. He knew better than anyone else the difficulty in cultivating the Dragon Transformation skill. It was a process that consumed an enormous amount of energy. He needed a massive amount of energy. And therefore, all these Evil Devils in front of him were actually the energy that Jiang Chen needed. It would be really difficult for Jiang Chen to encounter a rare opportunity like this in the outside world, that’s why he wanted to kill as much as he possibly could.
With the True Dragon Flames, Jiang Chen could completely suppress these Evil Devils. Even if there was a powerful Late Divine Core Evil Devil here, Jiang Chen wouldn’t feel scared at all.
“Fine, then let’s kill all we can!”

Big Yellow’s brutish nature was completely ignited. He kept letting out ferocious roars as he rammed in Evil Devils in all directions with his majestic body. A pure yang aura was emitting from his body, together with flames that covered his entire body. He too was an Evil Devil killer.

“Big Yellow, we have to push forward while slaughtering. The Earth Devil is the first devil specie to come into existence, and the devilish energy here is incredibly strong. I believe the Earth Devil isn’t far from this place, we have to cross this place and go further.”

Jiang Chen kept waving the battle axe in his hand, killing a large amount of Evil Devils, and harvesting a huge amount of devil souls. An Earth Devil was the most supreme existence amongst all devils, so the place where the Earth Devil they were hunting lived would be filled with vast amounts of devilish energies. But, with the pride of the Earth Devil, it wouldn’t be living together with these Evil Devils, and therefore, Jiang Chen would need to venture deeper into the Devil Cave.

Flesh and blood were flying in all directions, and scorching flames soared into the skies. This was truly a hellish battlefield. The cruel aura of slaughter spread all over the place, and soaked into all the living beings who stood on the edge of life and death.
Roar!
Right at this moment, a vigorous roar sounded from far. In the next second, Jiang Chen and Big Yellow saw a nearly 10 meter tall gigantic devil running towards them.

The gigantic devil seemed different from the other Evil Devils. Not only did its body seem more majestic, its skill was fully covered with blood red patterns, and it had a much more violent devilish energy compared to the Evil Devils.
“Damn it, I knew there was a terrifying existence here! This big guy has reached the Late Divine Core realm, he isn’t easy to handle.”
Big Yellow suddenly trembled.
“This is a Violent Bloodthirsty Devil, a king among the devils. I never expected I would see one here.”
Jiang Chen was shocked by it as well.
“Violent Bloodthirsty Devil, it sounds ferocious.”
Big Yellow kept staring at the approaching gigantic devil.

“This Violent Bloodthirsty Devil, just like its name implies, always thirsts for blood. It only knows how to kill, and it will even drink the blood of Evil Devils once it becomes mad. This Violent Bloodthirsty Devil has reached the Late Divine Core realm, and it won’t be easy to deal with.”
A serious look emerged in Jiang Chen’s eyes.
“Damn it! Buddy, can you deal with it or not? If not, let’s hurry up and run away!”
Big Yellow said.

“Unless I can break through to the Divine Core realm, I won’t be a match for this Violent Bloodthirsty Devil. But, since my True Dragon Flames is the ultimate weapon against all devils, it will also pose a great threat to this Violent Bloodthirsty Devil. I’ll try using my flame to fight it, and if I can kill it, the benefits will be huge. The Violent Bloodthirsty Devil’s Late Divine Core devil soul is worth more than all the devil souls of these Evil Devils.”
Jiang Chen’s fighting spirit was extremely high. He didn’t feel any fear, even when facing such a formidable opponent. There was nothing that could stop him from moving further.
When the Violent Bloodthirsty Devil started running towards them, all the Evil Devils immediately backed off and made way for it.
Roar!

The Violent Bloodthirsty Devil extended its gigantic hand and unleashed a black beam towards Jiang Chen. It was an attack formed entirely from chilly devil energy, and its power was so tremendous that no ordinary warriors could resist it.
Ha!

Jiang Chen let out a loud shout. In an instant, he unleashed the True Dragon Flames without any restrictions, then it turned into a 6 meter long fiery red flame dragon. Jiang Chen grabbed the flame dragon’s tail and slammed it into the Violent Bloodthirsty Devil’s attack.
Bang!
The dragon flame collided with the dark beam, producing a huge amount of sparks that splashed all over the place. The True Dragon Flames burned the dark beam and made it vanish in an instant!

This, combined with the True Dragon Flame’s restraining effects on devilish energy gave him the abilities to fight the Violent Bloodthirsty Devil.
Clang!

The battle axe collided with the devilish weapon. Vast energy ripples swept across the scene, the entire place lit up because of the flame, and devastating energies shattered all mountains underneath and leveled the land.

Jiang Chen was force back a dozen steps before he could regain control of his body. On his opposite side, the Violent Bloodthirsty Devil wasn’t in a good condition either, it too was forced back by the impact.

“Hmph! Although my combat strength can’t match this Violent Bloodthirsty Devil, but because of the True Dragon Flame’s restraining effect, it simply can’t fight with its full strength. Since this is the case, I’ll kill this Violent Bloodthirsty Devil and take its devil soul.”

Jiang Chen inwardly let out a cold snort. The collision had allowed him to find out about the gap between him and the Violent Bloodthirsty Devil. Because of the True Dragon Flames, the gap had become even, and it was now a competition of who had the better abilities.
GRAAA!

Jiang Chen shouted out loudly in an explosive manner. He had the purest yang aura leaking out from all over his body, and he had no fear towards these devilish energies.
The gigantic blood red dragon claw was immediately covered by the True Dragon Flames upon appearing, then it grabbed towards the dark cloud in a formidable way.
Bang!

Bang bang bang...

Jiang Chen let out a cold shout, then he took a step forwards in the skies. In an instant, nine identical Jiang Chens appeared in the sky. The sudden change had baffled the Violent Bloodthirsty Devil.

A movement skill like the Nine Phantom Wolves was most frightening when used in a fight, it would create an unexpected scenario during a critical moment. No matter how strong the opponent was, it would still confuse them for a moment. This was without any doubts a fact, as after Jiang Chen had inherited the skill, he had used it to surprise his opponents many times.
Swoosh!

In the blink of an eye, nine identical Jiang Chens surrounded the Violent Bloodthirsty Devil. All eight phantoms moved exactly like the real Jiang Chen did. They all raised their flaming battle axes high up into the air and chopped down forcefully at the Violent Bloodthirsty Devil.

The Violent Bloodthirsty Devil let out a furious roar. It felt helpless, as it couldn’t tell which of the nine Jiang Chens the real one was. Therefore, it could only divide its strength into nine portions and attack all nine Jiang Chens at the same time.

The Violent Bloodthirsty Devil was restrained by the True Dragon Flames, and because of that, it couldn’t fight at its strongest, and became Jiang Chen’s equal match. If it divided its strength into nine portions, it wouldn’t be Jiang Chen’s match.
Bang!

The Violent Bloodthirsty Devil’s attack shattered all eight phantoms, but being its weakened state, it couldn’t stop the real Jiang Chen, allowing him to hit it with his battle axe. In an instant, the gigantic Violent Bloodthirsty Devil’s body was hit by the attack, and it was forcefully slammed onto the ground, creating a huge crater. Horrible wound could be seen on its body.
Roar!
The Violent Bloodthirsty Devil was severely wound, and that made it become even more berserk. Without any hesitation, it leapt up into the sky, striking toward Jiang Chen once again.

A grin appeared on Jiang Chen’s face. In such a state, the Violent Bloodthirsty Devil was doomed. Jiang Chen’s fighting experience was simply incredible, he knew very well that a devil king such as this Violent Bloodthirsty Devil existed just for fighting and slaughtering, and they had extremely sensitive senses during battle, and that’s the reason why Jiang Chen didn’t unleash the Nine Phantom Wolves when the fight began.

The Nine Phantom Wolves was a secret killing skill, and he had to wait until the perfect moment before he could unleash it. If he used it immediately when the fight started, the Violent Bloodthirsty Devil would most likely find out which the real one was. Therefore, Jiang Chen just kept fighting and provoking the Violent Bloodthirsty Devil until it had gone completely made. Then, he suddenly unleashed the Nine Phantom Wolves, and the furious Violent Bloodthirsty Devil had no way of finding out which Jiang Chen was the real one.
Swoosh!

Looking at the Violent Bloodthirsty Devil who attacked once again, nine identical Jiang Chens appeared once again. After being seriously injured, the Violent Bloodthirsty Devil became even more confused, and had simply no way of telling which one the real Jiang Chen was.
Ha!

Nine identical Jiang Chens shouted out loudly at the same time, then they all forcefully chopped the battle axe down from above. The Violent Bloodthirsty Devil let out many wild roars. With the bad experience just now, it didn’t divide its strength into nine portions this time, it instead focused all its into one attack towards one of the Jiang Chens.

It was worth mentioning that the Violent Bloodthirsty Devil was indeed the most brutal existence amongst all devils. It was actually putting its life at risk by doing this, it was gambling everything it had on this strike, hoping it would strike the real Jiang Chen with a winning ratio of one to nine.

If its guess was correction, the Violent Bloodthirsty Devil would be able to find out the secret trick behind the movement skill, and then it would strike with everything it gotten, never allowing Jiang Chen the opportunity to counter.
But too bad, today was just not the Violent Bloodthirsty Devil’s lucky day. The attack that contained its full strength only shattered one of the phantoms.
When the phantom was destroyed, the real Jiang Chen’s attack had fallen onto it at the same time.
“Die!”

With a grin on his face, Jiang Chen’s razor sharp battle axe hit the center of the Violent Bloodthirsty Devil’s head. From top to bottom, the Violent Bloodthirsty Devil was slice in half and killed on the spot.
With a quick and swift motion, Jiang Chen without hesitation grabbed the Violent Bloodthirsty Devil’s devil soul with his hand.
“Buddy is really smart when it comes to fighting.”
Big Yellow couldn’t help but praise Jiang Chen. A man who could always remain calm was really frightening, especially during a fight.
Aowu...

After killing the Violent Bloodthirsty Devil, all the other Evil Devils immediately let out wild roars. The roars had called more and more Evil Devils toward the scene, and countless Evil Devils began storming toward their direction. A vast amount of devilish energy covered the entire sky above. Jiang Chen saw at least 5 Late Divine Core Evil Devil dashing towards him and Big Yellow.
“Buddy, we can’t fight them this time!”
Big Yellow said.
“Run!”
Without hesitation, Jiang Chen immediately sprinted towards his left. Big Yellow didn’t dare slow down, and he instantly followed.
