chapters.title: Chapter 231 - Combat Soul Realm Evil Devil
paragraphs: Even the strongest tiger can’t stand up to a large pack of wolves. For Jiang Chen, those Evil Devils at the Mid Divine Core realm and below were like sheep, he had no fear no matter how many of them there were. But, those Late Divine Core Evil Devils were actually true wolves, and once they grouped up and attacked in numbers, even if Jiang Chen was as fierce as a right, he couldn’t deal with them.

After all, Jiang Chen was only a peak Heavenly Core warrior, he hadn’t broken through to the Divine Core realm yet, it wasn’t easy for him to defeat Late Divine Core beings. He had already used everything he had to kill the Violent Bloodthirsty Devil just now, and now, with so many Late Divine Core Evil Devils storming the place, he wouldn’t be able to defeat them.

More importantly, Jiang Chen had no idea how many Evil Devils there were in this colony. The battle had just begun not long ago, and now, a lot of Late Divine Core Evil Devils have emerged. If he kept fighting, he might attract an Evil Devil at the Combat Soul realm, and that would be a huge problem.

In Inferno Hell, it was possible to find all sorts of powerful demons and devils. If a mighty Combat Soul devil existed here, it would be likely that another Combat Soul monster existed as well. This place was the colony of the Evil Devils, and Jiang Chen wouldn’t be surprised if a Combat Soul Evil Devil appeared.
Jiang Chen and Big Yellow were fleeing in the opposite direction of where Guan Yiyun and the group fled. With an extreme amount of speed, they just wanted to cross this devil cave.
Aowu!!

The furious roars didn’t seem to stop sounding out, the entire place was echoing with the wild cries of the Evil Devils. Devilish energies were soaring high behind the duo, and a couple of Late Divine Core Evil Devils were chasing behind Jiang Chen and Big Yellow while letting out angry roars.

The huge disturbance had alerted all the Evil Devils in the devil cave, and in just a short moment, countless Evil Devils appeared from all directions, storming toward Jiang Chen and Big Yellow, trying to stop and kill them.

Dozens of powerful Evil Devils appeared in front of them as well, baring their teeth and brandishing their claws while aggressively unleashing their devilish energy. Looking at how they were behaving, it was likely that they wouldn’t give up until Jiang Chen and Big Yellow were eaten by them.
“Damn it! Did we fall in a trap, why are there so many Evil Devils around?”
Big Yellow felt like throwing up blood.
“These Evil Devils are nothing.”

Jiang Chen said. In his previous life, he had once entered the Land of Devils, and there were all kinds of devils there, and all of them were in incredible numbers; it was a land that this tiny devil cave couldn’t compare with.

Unleashing his energy, Jiang Chen drew out the golden battle axe and the Bloodthirsty Sword, one in each hand. He covered both combat weapons with his True Dragon Flames, and before the Evil Devils in front of them could come near, he forcefully attacked with both combat weapons.
Bang!

Energy ripples swept across the place, and flames locked up the entire space in front of them. The bright sword energy and the axe energy cut forwards in a seemingly invincible manner, killing 5-6 Evil Devils in an instant. After that, as if their devils souls were summoned by Jiang Chen, without any delay, they were already in Jiang Chen’s storage ring.
Big Yellow too was extremely aggressive. He sent flesh and blood flying all over the place with his diamond hard head.
Aowuu...

The Evil Devils behind them kept increasing their speed as they chased, and more Evil Devils appeared in front of them. Right at this moment, every single inch of this place had been filled by Evil Devils, and their devilish energy covered the entire sky above them. This made it hard for Jiang Chen and Big Yellow to find out which way to go.
Jiang Chen and Big Yellow were completely surrounded, it looked like they could only fight their way out.
“Buddy, the situation doesn’t look good.”

Although Big Yellow said that, his eyes were actually glowing brightly, and he seemed excited. He was actually in a pretty good mood! The more dangerous a situation was, the more excited Big Yellow would become.
“Let’s go, we’ll slaughter our way into the inner area of this devil cave. Just kill anything that gets in our way!”

Jiang Chen made up a savage decision in his mind, and a cold light could be seen in his eyes. His entire body was filled with killing intent, enough to reach the skies. The sword and axe in his hands were continuously vibrating.
“Kaka, perfect, this master dog loves it!”

Big Yellow was laughing out loudly. He too was in high spirits, and the yuan energy in his body shot out like a vast ocean. Wings of light appeared on his back, and mystical symbols could be seen blinking on his forehead, causing him to brim with an aura of divinity.
Bang!

The entire area was shaking, the auras that filled the land had been messed up, and mountains upon mountains shattered. Vast amounts of devilish energies covered the sky above, wild flames kept burning all over the place, lighting everything up, and causing the place to look like a battlefield from hell.
Far from the scene, Tian Yishan and the group turned around and stared at the battle ripples within the devil cave, all of them had awful expressions.
“Is it right for us just leave them behind like this?”
Wang Heng asked. The terrifying battle ripples and never ending furious roars from the Evil Devils had clearly shown them how intense the fight was, as well as how many Evil Devils there were.
“This is really terrifying! If we go back now, I’m afraid we’ll be flooded by those Evil Devils, we’ll be torn into pieces at once!”
Yang Meng said with a shocked expression.

“With our strength, we won’t be able to provide much help, and we’ll even become burdens for junior disciple Jiang. I believe in junior disciple Jiang, he never does some he isn’t confident about. Besides, he’s here to find the Earth Devil, and he won’t back off until he gets hold of something.”

Guan Yiyun said. He knew Jiang Chen quite well, and this young man was someone who truly cherished friendship. Searching for the Earth Devil was something that could end up with himself getting killed, but after Guan Yiyun learned about what happened to Han Yan, he didn’t try stopping Jiang Chen from doing what he wanted to do anymore.
“Let’s go, we have to hurry up and leave this place. Now, brother Jiang has attracted the attention of all these Evil Devils, we’ll just let him down if we don’t leave this place.”

Tian Yishan said. It wasn’t that they didn’t want to help Jiang Chen, but the situation was different. Under such circumstances, it would be certain death if they returned to help, and they would only become burdens for Jiang Chen. Thus, leaving Jiang Chen behind and letting him fight without the need to worry about anything else was their best option.

The fight was getting much more intense. Jiang Chen and Big Yellow were pushing through the crowd of Evils Devils like two sharp blades. With Big Yellow’s strong, as long as he didn’t bump into any Late Divine Core monsters, he would be safe. If there really was a Late Divine Core Evil Devil approaching them, Jiang Chen would force it back with his sword, and they would be able to continue pushing forwards.
Aowuu...
The furious roars were getting louder and louder, all the Late Divine Core Evil Devils were furious, and they finally surrounded Jiang Chen and Big Yellow from all directions.
“Break open for me!”

Jiang Chen let out a wild shout. This shout of his was unleashed with the Sonic Hawk Cry. The sound waves immediately stunned a huge amount of Evil Devils in front of him, and at the same time, Jiang Chen pushed his way through with the battle axe and Bloodthirsty Sword, killing countless Evil Devils and sending flesh and blood all over the place.
When the attacks from the Late Divine Core Evil Devils arrive at where Jiang Chen stood, he and Big Yellow had already escaped from their trap.
The Evil Devils just wouldn’t give up, they kept crazily chasing behind.

Jiang Chen and Big Yellow were both fleeing with extreme speed. A ferocious look could be seen in Jiang Chen’s eyes. Once again, more Evil Devils appeared in front of them, and they were trapped from all directions once again.
“All of you shall die!”

Jiang Chen let out a shrill roar. His eyes had become red, and even Big Yellow had a cruel expression on his face. The duo had become incredibly savage after killing so much, they were like a suicide squad, and no hordes of enemies could make them feel afraid.

If all roads ahead were closed, he would slaughter until a road opened. In his past life, Jiang Chen had attacked the heavens with sword in hand to pave a path out from this realm, and he was in a similar situation now. If he wanted to find a way out from this devil cave, there was nothing that could stop him.
Rumble...

The entire devil cave had entered a state of turmoil. Jiang Chen’s dark hair was wildly fluttering in the wild wind; he had transformed into an existence much more terrifying than those Evil Devils as he slaughtered like there was no tomorrow.

Jiang Chen and Big Yellow were quickly moving towards the center of the devil cave, causing flesh and blood to splash all over the place, and a river of blood to flow stream along their way. Now, there were more than 15 strong Late Divine Core Evil Devils who had joined the chase, but because Jiang Chen and Big Yellow showed no mercy when killing, combined with their fast and bizarre movements, and the fact that they didn’t allow themselves to face the attacks of the Late Divine Core Evil Devils, they didn’t fall into the traps laid out by the Evil Devils.

The violent slaughtering seemed endless. Jiang Chen and Big Yellow were pushing through the crowd of Evil Devils, and they had been slaughtering nonstop for more than 15 minutes. Finally, they arrived in the center of the place.
In front of them, there was a black colored palace. A huge amount of devilish energies shot up into the sky outside the palace.
Aowu!
Suddenly, an incredibly loud roar sounded out form the palace and swept across the entire devil cave. It echoed nonstop while carrying a mighty devilish power.

Hearing the roar, all the other Evil Devils immediately shut up. An expression that carried both respect and fear emerged on their faces. When Jiang Chen and Big Yellow heard the roar, their expressions dramatically changed.
“Fuck! A Combat Soul Evil Devil!”
Big Yellow almost jumped up from where he stood.
“Run!”

Jiang Chen immediately grabbed Big Yellow’s tail, and without any hesitation, he turned into a trail of light and flew past the black palace in the blink of an eye. He never expected to meet a Combat Soul Evil Devil here, and it would be certain death of they fought a Combat Soul Evil Devil right now. No matter how many brilliant methods they had, the gap between their cultivation levels was simply too huge.
Bang!
Just as Jiang Chen and Big Yellow flew past the palace, a gigantic black hand dashed out from the Devil Palace towards them like a collapsing sky.
“Fuck!”
Big Yellow cursed.
“Dimensional Shift!”
Jiang Chen violently shouted out. A pair of blood red wings instantly emerged on his back, and he crazily unleashed the Dimensional Shift, dodging the black hand in a split second.
Bang!
The gigantic devil hand slapped right onto the ground, causing the entire devil cave to shake with a massive force and a gigantic black crater to appear.
“Qhia Ka!”
An ear-splitting shout spoken in devil language sounded out from the Devil Palace. After that, a being over 30 meters tall shot out from the Devil Palace, chasing after Jiang Chen and Big Yellow.
Swoosh!
The Combat Soul Evil Devil’s speed was incredibly fast. Like an arrow leaving its bow, it shot towards Jiang Chen and Big Yellow with incredible speed.
“Damn it, this Combat Soul Evil Devil’s speed is too fast, there is no way we can escape from its chase!”
Big Yellow wanted to throw up some blood. What an unlucky day for both of them, they had actually entered a cave of devils that had such a strong enemy.

Jiang Chen had an awful expression as well. Even a Combat Soul Evil Devil had such horrifying strength. Did this mean that the Earth Devil who possessed the ultimate bloodline amongst all devils was going to be near invincible?
“Save your breath, let’s run faster!”

Jiang Chen kept unleashing the Nine Phantom Wolves and Dimension Shift, and while disturbing the focus of the chasing Evil Devil, he kept flying crazily with the help of the blood wings. Even with so much effort, the distance between them was constantly shortening.
“There is a valley in front of us, let’s fly in that direction! I can sense a natural defense mechanism within that valley!”

Big Yellow quickly said. He was born with sensitive senses toward all defense mechanisms and formations. Because of that, he had just found a natural defense mechanism within the valley in front of them.

sentences.text: Even the strongest tiger can’t stand up to a large pack of wolves.
For Jiang Chen, those Evil Devils at the Mid Divine Core realm and below were like sheep, he had no fear no matter how many of them there were.
But, those Late Divine Core Evil Devils were actually true wolves, and once they grouped up and attacked in numbers, even if Jiang Chen was as fierce as a right, he couldn’t deal with them.
After all, Jiang Chen was only a peak Heavenly Core warrior, he hadn’t broken through to the Divine Core realm yet, it wasn’t easy for him to defeat Late Divine Core beings.
He had already used everything he had to kill the Violent Bloodthirsty Devil just now, and now, with so many Late Divine Core Evil Devils storming the place, he wouldn’t be able to defeat them.
More importantly, Jiang Chen had no idea how many Evil Devils there were in this colony.
The battle had just begun not long ago, and now, a lot of Late Divine Core Evil Devils have emerged.
If he kept fighting, he might attract an Evil Devil at the Combat Soul realm, and that would be a huge problem.
In Inferno Hell, it was possible to find all sorts of powerful demons and devils.
If a mighty Combat Soul devil existed here, it would be likely that another Combat Soul monster existed as well.
This place was the colony of the Evil Devils, and Jiang Chen wouldn’t be surprised if a Combat Soul Evil Devil appeared.
Jiang Chen and Big Yellow were fleeing in the opposite direction of where Guan Yiyun and the group fled.
With an extreme amount of speed, they just wanted to cross this devil cave.
Aowu!!
The furious roars didn’t seem to stop sounding out, the entire place was echoing with the wild cries of the Evil Devils.
Devilish energies were soaring high behind the duo, and a couple of Late Divine Core Evil Devils were chasing behind Jiang Chen and Big Yellow while letting out angry roars.

The huge disturbance had alerted all the Evil Devils in the devil cave, and in just a short moment, countless Evil Devils appeared from all directions, storming toward Jiang Chen and Big Yellow, trying to stop and kill them.
Dozens of powerful Evil Devils appeared in front of them as well, baring their teeth and brandishing their claws while aggressively unleashing their devilish energy.
Looking at how they were behaving, it was likely that they wouldn’t give up until Jiang Chen and Big Yellow were eaten by them.
“Damn it!
Did we fall in a trap, why are there so many Evil Devils around?”
Big Yellow felt like throwing up blood.
“These Evil Devils are nothing.”
Jiang Chen said.

In his previous life, he had once entered the Land of Devils, and there were all kinds of devils there, and all of them were in incredible numbers; it was a land that this tiny devil cave couldn’t compare with.
Unleashing his energy, Jiang Chen drew out the golden battle axe and the Bloodthirsty Sword, one in each hand.
He covered both combat weapons with his True Dragon Flames, and before the Evil Devils in front of them could come near, he forcefully attacked with both combat weapons.
Bang!
Energy ripples swept across the place, and flames locked up the entire space in front of them.
The bright sword energy and the axe energy cut forwards in a seemingly invincible manner, killing 5-6 Evil Devils in an instant.
After that, as if their devils souls were summoned by Jiang Chen, without any delay, they were already in Jiang Chen’s storage ring.
Big Yellow too was extremely aggressive.
He sent flesh and blood flying all over the place with his diamond hard head.
Aowuu...
The Evil Devils behind them kept increasing their speed as they chased, and more Evil Devils appeared in front of them.
Right at this moment, every single inch of this place had been filled by Evil Devils, and their devilish energy covered the entire sky above them.
This made it hard for Jiang Chen and Big Yellow to find out which way to go.
Jiang Chen and Big Yellow were completely surrounded, it looked like they could only fight their way out.
“Buddy, the situation doesn’t look good.”
Although Big Yellow said that, his eyes were actually glowing brightly, and he seemed excited.
He was actually in a pretty good mood!
The more dangerous a situation was, the more excited Big Yellow would become.
“Let’s go, we’ll slaughter our way into the inner area of this devil cave.
Just kill anything that gets in our way!”
Jiang Chen made up a savage decision in his mind, and a cold light could be seen in his eyes.
His entire body was filled with killing intent, enough to reach the skies.
The sword and axe in his hands were continuously vibrating.
“Kaka, perfect, this master dog loves it!”
Big Yellow was laughing out loudly.
He too was in high spirits, and the yuan energy in his body shot out like a vast ocean.
Wings of light appeared on his back, and mystical symbols could be seen blinking on his forehead, causing him to brim with an aura of divinity.
Bang!
The entire area was shaking, the auras that filled the land had been messed up, and mountains upon mountains shattered.
Vast amounts of devilish energies covered the sky above, wild flames kept burning all over the place, lighting everything up, and causing the place to look like a battlefield from hell.
Far from the scene, Tian Yishan and the group turned around and stared at the battle ripples within the devil cave, all of them had awful expressions.
“Is it right for us just leave them behind like this?”
Wang Heng asked.
The terrifying battle ripples and never ending furious roars from the Evil Devils had clearly shown them how intense the fight was, as well as how many Evil Devils there were.
“This is really terrifying!
If we go back now, I’m afraid we’ll be flooded by those Evil Devils, we’ll be torn into pieces at once!”
Yang Meng said with a shocked expression.
“With our strength, we won’t be able to provide much help, and we’ll even become burdens for junior disciple Jiang.
I believe in junior disciple Jiang, he never does some he isn’t confident about.
Besides, he’s here to find the Earth Devil, and he won’t back off until he gets hold of something.”
Guan Yiyun said.
He knew Jiang Chen quite well, and this young man was someone who truly cherished friendship.

Searching for the Earth Devil was something that could end up with himself getting killed, but after Guan Yiyun learned about what happened to Han Yan, he didn’t try stopping Jiang Chen from doing what he wanted to do anymore.
“Let’s go, we have to hurry up and leave this place.
Now, brother Jiang has attracted the attention of all these Evil Devils, we’ll just let him down if we don’t leave this place.”
Tian Yishan said.
It wasn’t that they didn’t want to help Jiang Chen, but the situation was different.
Under such circumstances, it would be certain death if they returned to help, and they would only become burdens for Jiang Chen.
Thus, leaving Jiang Chen behind and letting him fight without the need to worry about anything else was their best option.
The fight was getting much more intense.
Jiang Chen and Big Yellow were pushing through the crowd of Evils Devils like two sharp blades.
With Big Yellow’s strong, as long as he didn’t bump into any Late Divine Core monsters, he would be safe.
If there really was a Late Divine Core Evil Devil approaching them, Jiang Chen would force it back with his sword, and they would be able to continue pushing forwards.
Aowuu...

“Break open for me!”
Jiang Chen let out a wild shout.
This shout of his was unleashed with the Sonic Hawk Cry.

Jiang Chen and Big Yellow were both fleeing with extreme speed.

Once again, more Evil Devils appeared in front of them, and they were trapped from all directions once again.
“All of you shall die!”
Jiang Chen let out a shrill roar.

The duo had become incredibly savage after killing so much, they were like a suicide squad, and no hordes of enemies could make them feel afraid.

If he wanted to find a way out from this devil cave, there was nothing that could stop him.

chapters.title: Chapter 232 - The Old Man in the Poisonous Miasma Space
paragraphs: “Natural defense mechanism?”

Jiang Chen’s eyes lit up, as if he had just seen a light carrying hope. There were many invisible natural defense mechanisms and formations existing within the depths of Inferno Hell, and they came to this devil cave because of a natural formation. If they could find another natural formation, they would have a chance at escaping the Combat Soul Evil Devil.
“Let’s go!”
Jiang Chen didn’t dare show any neglect. The gigantic creature chasing them was extremely brutal, and it would be devastating if it caught up.
Swoosh!

Both Jiang Chen and Big Yellow immediately increased their speed to their maximum, running crazily toward the valley. Big Yellow’s wings of light made him incredibly fast, and Jiang Chen had a pair of wings inherited from the Blood Winged Hawk. That combined with the Dimensional Shift and Nine Phantom Wolves, he was too good at escaping.
Bang!

Behind them, the Combat Soul Evil Devil kept unleashing attacks, almost hitting and wounding Jiang Chen a few times. The massive energy ripples had shaken his qi and blood, causing him to feel really uncomfortable. If they still maintained the same speed, sooner or later, the Combat Soul Evil Devil would catch up.
But luckily, the valley wasn’t far away from them. Soon, it appeared in both Jiang Chen and Big Yellow’s eyes.

The aura of the natural defense mechanism in this valley was pretty obvious, even Jiang Chen could sense it as they approached. Its aura was much clearer compared to the invisible formation located between the two big trees.
Without hesitation, Jiang Chen and Big Yellow hastily sprinted into the valley, following the aura of the natural defense mechanism. Then, they came to a worn-out cave.
“The defense mechanism is at the entrance of the cave.”
Big Yellow said.
Roar!

Behind them, the Combat Soul Evil Devil kept chasing crazily while unleashing massive amounts of devilish energies along its way, causing whirlwinds that threw dust and stone in all directions to appear.
“Let’s enter!”

Jiang Chen gritted his teeth. There was no time for them to evaluate and speculate about what exists behind the defense mechanism in this cave. If they entered it, they would have a chance to survive, and if they didn’t, they would certainly be killed by the Combat Soul Evil Devil.
Jiang Chen and Big Yellow dashed into the cave, causing ripple to appear in the air. In an instant, the duo had disappeared.

Seeing this, the Combat Soul Evil Devil behind them immediately stopped its gigantic body. It circled around the entrance of the cave twice, then it showed a smile of pride on its face before turning around and leaving. It wasn’t reckless, so it didn’t chase after them.
Swoosh!

When Jiang Chen and Big Yellow went past the defense mechanism, the scene in front of them changed dramatically once again. It was a plain gray world in front of them. The eerie and chilly energies within were so much stronger compared to the outside.

A stinking smell filled up the air within the place, extremely unpleasant and pungent. Besides this, black whirlwinds appeared all over the place, and the air blowing across the place was cutting them to the marrow. It also carried a strong corrosive characteristic.
“Damn it! What a disgusting environment!”
Big Yellow couldn’t help but curse.

“Be careful, there is poisonous miasma all over the place. The stinking poisonous gas merged with the freezing miasma, causing this poisonous miasma to be formed. It’s a deadly thing that can kill any cultivator.”
Jiang Chen reminded.
“These poisonous miasmas can’t do anything to me.”

Big Yellow was walking in a poisonous miasma, and nothing really happened to him. Watching this, Jiang Chen immediately gave him a thumbs up. He recalled the scene where he first met Big Yellow, he had used the Green Hellish Python’s deadly poison on Big Yellow, but no harm was done at all. This proved that Big Yellow could resist most poison. As for the poisonous miasma here, Big Yellow had the unique bloodline of the Divine Beast, Dragon Horse. He was actually the natural enemy of all poisons, this was one of his unique advantages.

As for Jiang Chen, he also had a high resistance towards poison. Besides that, Jiang Chen also unleashed a red barrier of flame, covering his body. It was a barrier formed by True Dragon Flame; the purest yang flame, which also repelled all poison.
Jiang Chen and Big Yellow kept throwing examining looks around. What they found was a place covered with gray fog and nothing else. There were no mountains, no plants, and no trees.
“Look, the defense mechanism is still here.”

Big Yellow turned around and found out the defense mechanism was still behind them, it hadn’t disappeared like the natural formation they had found earlier. It was just that they couldn’t look through it and see what was outside.
“Since the defense mechanism is still here, the devil cave must still be on the other side. Let’s move forward and find a new way out.”
Jiang Chen said.
“Why didn’t that Combat Soul Evil Devil chase after us?”
Big Yellow was puzzled.
“I think that Evil Devil knows something about this place, it might think that we will certainly be killed in this place. Thus, it didn’t chase us in here.”
Jiang Chen said. The environment here was really bad, and it would be certain death if any ordinary man was here.
“This place should be an isolated space, and it doesn’t look big. We just need to find another exit, then we’ll be able to leave this place.”

Jiang Chen said. He had already found out that this place was actually a natural unique space, fully filled with poisonous miasma, and could be considered a natural land of death. It would be really bad luck if anyone ordinary accidentally came to this space.

Jiang Chen was covered by a fire barrier, while Big Yellow just walked next to him like it was nothing. The duo began slowly walking forward. Since the poisonous miasma here was too strong, there were no demons or devils anywhere nearby.
The entire space was extremely quiet, and nothing could be heard except for the tornadoes’ swishing sounds. It gave the space an eerie feeling, as if they had actually come to the real hell.
Crack!
Suddenly, a cracking sound could be heard from underneath Big Yellow’s foot. It sounded really loud when in this quiet environment.
“Damn it, what was that? This master do was spooked!”

Big Yellow jumped up from where he stood and moved aside. He and Jiang Chen both lowered their heads and looked at the ground. Then, they saw an entire skeleton lying where Big Yellow had just stepped. His foot he caused a hole to appear on the skeleton’s chest.
“This is a skeleton of a Divine Core warrior, he must have been dead for a long time. Look, all the bone has become porous, you’ve shattered it.”
Jiang Chen had eagle eyes. Although the skeleton was badly corroded by the poisonous miasma and had turned completely black, Jiang Chen still knew that this was a Divine Core warrior’s skeleton.
“Even a Divine Core warrior died here. Looks like it’ll be tough to find an exit here.”

Big Yellow said. A Divine Core warrior could still survive for quite some time in this poisonous miasma space, and the only explanation for his death would be that he depleted all his yuan energy in order to resist the poisonous miasma. He was killed by the poisonous miasma once he couldn’t repel the deadly poison any longer.

“There is an exit to this place, but the terrifying devil cave is on the other side. In order to survive, there is no way he would have just stayed here, waiting for death to arrive. The reason why he died was because he couldn’t open the defense mechanism and leave this place.”
Jiang Chen’s expression suddenly changed badly.
“What you mean is, the defense mechanism only allows us to enter, but not leave this place?”
Big Yellow’s expression became a serious one as well.
“I do hope it isn’t like that, but I can’t really find another reason as to why this Divine Core warrior died in this place.”
Jiang Chen smiled. With a determined look in his eyes, he said, “Let’s go; just keep moving forward.”
The following journey had completely disappointed Jiang Chen and Big Yellow. They kept bumping into new skeleton along their way, and all these skeletons were once Divine Core warriors.
That meant that none of the warriors who accidentally came to this space had survived, all of them had eventually died. This was a land of death.
“Fuck! A land of death, no wonder that Evil Devil didn’t chase after us! It seems like it really knew about the dangers of this place.”
Big Yellow cursed, “Everyone who came to this place died in the end. Luckily, we’re not afraid of the poisonous miasma here. If not, we’d end up like these people.”
“Still, we have to find a way to leave this place. Being trapped in this place forever is no different than waiting for the inevitable death.”

Jiang Chen furrowed his brows. He kept walking forward with big steps. Now, it was almost certain that there would be any powerful monsters in here. Therefore, they didn’t have to worry about being attacked.
The duo had walked for nearly an hour, and they kept bumping into skeletons. The place seemed really desolate.
“Look, there is light blinking in front!”
Big Yellow suddenly said.
“That’s a defense mechanism, it’s the exit! Let’s go check it out!”
Jiang Chen saw the light as well. Although the rainbow color light seemed faded, it couldn’t escape their eyes. The duo immediately dashed forward, and soon, they arrived at the source of the light.
“There is a man.”

Big Yellow’s eyes lit up. A man with disheveled hair was sitting with both legs crossed, not moving at all, which made him look like a stone statue. But, the weak aura emitting from his body showed that this old man was still alive.
Jiang Chen and Big Yellow slowly approached the old man. As if he had heard something, the old man finally raised his head up, slowly. With cloudy eyes, he looked at Jiang Chen and Big Yellow.

An old man, a really old man who was long past his prime. The robe covering his body was really loose, he had wrinkled skin on his face, and an extremely thing body. He looked just like a skeleton who had nothing but skin. Pretty horrifying.
The old man’s aura was really weak, as if he was going to die at any time. And yet, he was still alive.
“Sigh... someone is here again... someone is going to die soon... sigh.”
The old man let out two sighs. His voice was shrill, making it unpleasant to listen to. It looked like he had gotten used to the deaths happening here.
“A Combat Soul warrior.”

Jiang Chen threw an examining look at the old man. He immediately found out the cultivation level of the old man. But, because the vital signs of the old man were really weak, and there was no yuan energy that could be sensed in his body, as it had been completely depleted, Jiang Chen couldn’t determine which Combat Soul stage this old man was.
But since all Combat Soul warriors had transformed the Divine Core in their bodies into a Combat Soul, Jiang Chen could easily tell that this old man was a Combat Soul warrior.
“Oh?”
The old man was surprised. Obviously, he didn’t expect a young man to actually figure out his cultivation with just a single look.
“Not bad, young man. Too bad you’ve come to this land of death.”

The old man let out another sigh, then he turned around and stared at the glowing defense mechanism in front of him, “It’s been ten years, all who have come have left ahead of me. Now, I’m soon going to leave as well. But, having someone to talk with at this point of time, the heavens are treating me better now.”
The old man carried a smile on his face. The despair and anger he had when he first arrived at this place was long gone; he had seen through life and death.

Since the poisonous miasma here was too strong, there were no demons or devils anywhere nearby.
The entire space was extremely quiet, and nothing could be heard except for the tornadoes’ swishing sounds.
It gave the space an eerie feeling, as if they had actually come to the real hell.
Crack!
Suddenly, a cracking sound could be heard from underneath Big Yellow’s foot.
It sounded really loud when in this quiet environment.
“Damn it, what was that?
This master do was spooked!”
Big Yellow jumped up from where he stood and moved aside.
He and Jiang Chen both lowered their heads and looked at the ground.
Then, they saw an entire skeleton lying where Big Yellow had just stepped.
His foot he caused a hole to appear on the skeleton’s chest.
“This is a skeleton of a Divine Core warrior, he must have been dead for a long time.
Look, all the bone has become porous, you’ve shattered it.”
Jiang Chen had eagle eyes.
Although the skeleton was badly corroded by the poisonous miasma and had turned completely black, Jiang Chen still knew that this was a Divine Core warrior’s skeleton.
“Even a Divine Core warrior died here.
Looks like it’ll be tough to find an exit here.”
Big Yellow said.

A Divine Core warrior could still survive for quite some time in this poisonous miasma space, and the only explanation for his death would be that he depleted all his yuan energy in order to resist the poisonous miasma.
He was killed by the poisonous miasma once he couldn’t repel the deadly poison any longer.
“There is an exit to this place, but the terrifying devil cave is on the other side.
In order to survive, there is no way he would have just stayed here, waiting for death to arrive.
The reason why he died was because he couldn’t open the defense mechanism and leave this place.”
Jiang Chen’s expression suddenly changed badly.
“What you mean is, the defense mechanism only allows us to enter, but not leave this place?”
Big Yellow’s expression became a serious one as well.
“I do hope it isn’t like that, but I can’t really find another reason as to why this Divine Core warrior died in this place.”
Jiang Chen smiled.
With a determined look in his eyes, he said, “Let’s go; just keep moving forward.”
The following journey had completely disappointed Jiang Chen and Big Yellow.
They kept bumping into new skeleton along their way, and all these skeletons were once Divine Core warriors.
That meant that none of the warriors who accidentally came to this space had survived, all of them had eventually died.
This was a land of death.
“Fuck!
A land of death, no wonder that Evil Devil didn’t chase after us!
It seems like it really knew about the dangers of this place.”
Big Yellow cursed, “Everyone who came to this place died in the end.
Luckily, we’re not afraid of the poisonous miasma here.
If not, we’d end up like these people.”
“Still, we have to find a way to leave this place.
Being trapped in this place forever is no different than waiting for the inevitable death.”
Jiang Chen furrowed his brows.
He kept walking forward with big steps.
Now, it was almost certain that there would be any powerful monsters in here.
Therefore, they didn’t have to worry about being attacked.
The duo had walked for nearly an hour, and they kept bumping into skeletons.
The place seemed really desolate.
“Look, there is light blinking in front!”
Big Yellow suddenly said.
“That’s a defense mechanism, it’s the exit!
Let’s go check it out!”
Jiang Chen saw the light as well.
Although the rainbow color light seemed faded, it couldn’t escape their eyes.
The duo immediately dashed forward, and soon, they arrived at the source of the light.
“There is a man.”
Big Yellow’s eyes lit up.
A man with disheveled hair was sitting with both legs crossed, not moving at all, which made him look like a stone statue.
But, the weak aura emitting from his body showed that this old man was still alive.
Jiang Chen and Big Yellow slowly approached the old man.
As if he had heard something, the old man finally raised his head up, slowly.
With cloudy eyes, he looked at Jiang Chen and Big Yellow.
An old man, a really old man who was long past his prime.
The robe covering his body was really loose, he had wrinkled skin on his face, and an extremely thing body.
He looked just like a skeleton who had nothing but skin.
Pretty horrifying.
The old man’s aura was really weak, as if he was going to die at any time.
And yet, he was still alive.
“Sigh... someone is here again... someone is going to die soon... sigh.”
The old man let out two sighs.
His voice was shrill, making it unpleasant to listen to.
It looked like he had gotten used to the deaths happening here.
“A Combat Soul warrior.”
Jiang Chen threw an examining look at the old man.
He immediately found out the cultivation level of the old man.

But, because the vital signs of the old man were really weak, and there was no yuan energy that could be sensed in his body, as it had been completely depleted, Jiang Chen couldn’t determine which Combat Soul stage this old man was.
But since all Combat Soul warriors had transformed the Divine Core in their bodies into a Combat Soul, Jiang Chen could easily tell that this old man was a Combat Soul warrior.
“Oh?”
The old man was surprised.
Obviously, he didn’t expect a young man to actually figure out his cultivation with just a single look.
“Not bad, young man.
Too bad you’ve come to this land of death.”
The old man let out another sigh, then he turned around and stared at the glowing defense mechanism in front of him, “It’s been ten years, all who have come have left ahead of me.
Now, I’m soon going to leave as well.
But, having someone to talk with at this point of time, the heavens are treating me better now.”
The old man carried a smile on his face.
The despair and anger he had when he first arrived at this place was long gone; he had seen through life and death.

chapters.title: Chapter 233 - Wu Jiu [1]
paragraphs: The old man seemed calm, no signs of grievance could be found on his face. However, from his pair of cloudy eyes, one could still tell that he did feel some sorrow.
“If he’s able to leave this place alive, his cultivation will certainly see another breakthrough.”
Jiang Chen thought to himself. The old man had reached a state where he could see through life and death, just this comprehension alone could help him gain incredibly much.
“What? Ten years? You’ve actually stayed here for ten years? A desolate land like this? If this master dog stayed here for ten years, I would certainly be bored to death!”
Big Yellow’s emotions were riled up.
“Being able to stay alive in this harsh environment, you need a cultivation base at the Late Combat Soul realm, at least. There aren’t many of these great warriors in the entire Eastern Continent.”
Jiang Chen said with an indifferent tone.
Hearing this, the old man’s cloudy eyes suddenly light up. He stared at Jiang Chen with a look of disbelief. He couldn’t help but start examining the young man in front of him.

Being able to discover he was a Combat Soul warrior with a single look, and also judging his real cultivation level just from knowing how long he had been here... this was not someone anyone could do, that’s why this old man couldn’t help being shocked.
“What an extraordinary young man... but, too bad...”

The old man kept shaking his head, his eyes filled with deep regret. He could easily tell that Jiang Chen was extraordinary and had innate potential, a genius like this was supposed to become a well-known guy in the world. But now, he had to die in this shit place. What a pity.

“Ten years ago, I travelled alone to Inferno Hell. With my cultivation level, I tried walking through every inch of it, checking and finding out the secrets of Inferno Hell. But, I accidentally came to this Poisonous Miasma Space, and it has been ten years since then.”

The old man said in a self-mocking manner. He didn’t look at Jiang Chen, as if he was just talking to himself. But at the same time, it seemed he rather enjoyed the feeling of talking. It seemed like he hadn’t talked to anyone for quite a long time.

“By estimations, my death will arrive tomorrow. But, I don’t want to be like all the other people who died here, having my body corroded by the poison miasma, that’s too tragic. Young man, once I die tomorrow, I hope you can burn my body into ashes.”
The old man looked at Jiang Chen, focusing on the flames dancing around Jiang Chen’s body.
This was the last request from an old man who had gone past his prime.

Jiang Chen inwardly sighed. The man didn’t ask Jiang Chen to help him accomplish any weird unfulfilled desire at the last moment of his life, and neither did he have any special orders for Jiang Chen. He only requested that Jiang Chen burned his body and allowed him to have a proper death.
“Old man, your estimation is really accurate. If I didn’t come, you’d be dead by tomorrow. But, since I’m here, death will have to wait.”

Jiang Chen walked toward the old man, then he waved his hand and unleashed a flame. The dancing flame looked like a living dragon, it transformed into a flame barrier and covered the old man within. In an instant, all the surrounding poisonous miasma was pushed away, as if it had just met its natural enemy.

Jiang Chen had decided to save this old man, not for any specific reason, but because this old man had been persistently staying alive in this place for ten years. Jiang Chen really respected his endurance. Besides, the old man showed an easy going attitude from his words, and that really gave Jiang Chen a good impression.
“What a violent flame, it actually carries a divine aura. Even the poisonous miasma doesn’t dare try to corrode it.”
The surprised expression the old man’s face became stronger. Shocked, he looked at Jiang Chen.
“This flame is the True Dragon Flame, the king of all flames. Obviously, the poisonous miasma won’t be able to get close to it.”
Big Yellow walked up to the old man with his tail wagging and said.

Only now did the old man pay more attention to the big yellow dog. When he saw that Big Yellow could walk in the poisonous miasma without being affected by it, the shock in his mind was like the raging seas.
This man and dog were both truly amazing beings.

After the short shocking moment, the old man returned to his calm state. He looked at the fire barrier covering his body, and with a smile on his face he said, “Young man, put away this flame barrier, it will only consume your energy and focus; you can’t hold it for a long time. The poisonous miasma has already invaded all my internal organs, I’m a dying person; it isn’t necessary for you to waste any energy on me.”
“I said I wouldn’t let you di here, and I will prove my words. Open up your mind and release your defense; let me help you get rid of all the poisonous miasma in your body.”
After saying that, Jiang Chen placed his palm on the old man’s chest.

The old man’s body swayed a little. He stared at Jiang Chen’s palm with no idea what Jiang Chen was going to do next. He knew very well about his current condition, and it was impossible to get rid of the poisonous miasma that had invaded his body.
“You are a dying person, what are you afraid off? Put away your defense completely, open up your mind.”
Jiang Chen said with a smile.
The old man replied with a smile, “You’re right, I am a dying person, there is nothing I should be afraid of.”
The old man who had been tense for the last ten years had finally loosened up completely at this moment. He saw the confidence in Jiang Chen’s eyes, and it made him feel calm, as well as hope.

Jiang Chen unleashed the Dragon Transformation skill, sending a Dragon Mark from his palm into the old man’s body. Letting someone else’s energy enter one’s body was extremely dangerous, the old man had put away all his defense, and if Jiang Chen was up to something bad, the consequences would be devastating. Trust was the most important aspect in this situation.

But this old man had no fear, because with his current condition, there was nothing that could scare him. After all, he was soon going to die. Besides, if Jiang Chen really was up to something bad, he could just kill the old man with a palm strike, there was no need to go through so much hassle.

The blood red Dragon Mark circulated an entire round within the old man’s body. After that, it returned to Jiang Chen’s body. It only took Jiang Chen three breath times before he had completed the healing process. Finally, he removed his palm from the old man’s chest.
Puh!
The old man violently trembled, and in an instant, he threw up a mouthful of black blood and begun violently coughing.

The old man coughed for some time before he returned to normal. Then, he immediately raised his head and looked at Jiang Chen who was squatting in front of him. An extreme look of astonishment could be seen in his eyes.

The old man checked his body’s condition, and he instantly found out that all the poisonous miasma that had been piling up in his body for the last ten years had disappeared. His internal organs that had completely lost their vital signs were actually pumping with an extreme active force now.

More importantly, since all the poisonous miasma was gone, the old man felt extremely relaxed and comfortable, as if someone had just lifted a gigantic mountain that been weighing down on him for the last 10 years.
“Comfortable, what a pleasant feeling! For the last ten years, I have never felt such a pleasant joy before!”
The old man closed his eyes. He really enjoyed this moment, it was a feeling he hadn’t felt for so many years.
Ten years, day by day, year by year, he had been suffering from constant pain. For ordinary people, suffering such severe pain for ten years would definitely make that person crazy.
The old man did go crazy before, but in the end, he had seen through life and death. Now, Jiang Chen had restored his hope of living.
The old man was immersed in the pleasant moment, and Jiang Chen didn’t disturb him. He had absorbed all the poison in the old man’s body into his own body.

After some time, the old man finally opened up his eyes. He looked at Jiang Chen and said, “Little brother, you actually absorbed all the accumulated poison in my body into yours, that’s really dangerous! But, I can tell that it actually hasn’t affected you... can you tell me how you did it?”

“Old man, I actually absorbed the Green Hellish Python’s demon soul, and it gave me the ability to resist all poisons. The poisonous gas here can’t harm me at all. As for the miasma, my flame can purify it.”
Jiang Chen replied with a smile.
“What an amazing young man! Little brother, you’ve saved my life today, but I’m unable to repay your great kindness.”
The old man bowed toward Jiang Chen.

“The reason why I saved you is because I have a good impression of you. I, Jiang Chen will save the people I like. Those I have a good impression of and want to save, even if he’s just a low dog, will be saved. Those I don’t like, even if he is a king sitting up high, won’t receive the slightest help from me.”
Jiang Chen said in an imposing manner.
The old man felt shocked. He was surprised to see a young Heavenly Core warrior act like this. He had never met anyone like this in his life before, but the old man did like Jiang Chen’s words.

“Saving those you like, good! I, Wu Jiu too lived my life doing whatever I liked, I do things my own way, and not even the heavens can restrict daddy! Brother Jiang Chen, if you don’t mind, just address me as brother Jiu.”
Although the old man had no yuan energy, he could still act in a subduing manner. It was very easy to tell that he was not an ordinary man.
“Haha, being able to meet brother Jiu in this shitty place, fate must have brought us together.”

Jiang Chen laughed out heartily. If those who knew Wu Jiu heard Jiang Chen, a young man, addressing Wu Jiu as brother, they would be extremely shocked. In the entire Martial Saint Dynasty, there were only a handful of people who could address him as brother Jiu. It would be a great honor if they could even address him as Lord Jiu.

With Jiang Chen’s age, he should supposedly address him as senior, but Jiang Chen is actually the reincarnation of a Saint. No one in the entire Saint Origin realm has the qualifications to be his senior. Addressing the old man as brother Jiu was because both of them were like-minded.
“Little brother, although you’ve helped me get rid of all the poison in brother’s body, there is still no way we can leave this place.”
Wu Jiu shook his head as he stared at the defense mechanism which was glowing dimly in front of him.
“What brother Jiu means is that we can’t break this defense mechanism?”
Jiang Chen furrowed his brows.

“That’s right. This is a natural defense mechanism, a remarkable and intact defense mechanism, and there is no way to find a single breaking point on it. If I was a Combat King warrior, I’d be able to break this defense mechanism with the dimensional forces. But too bad, my limited cultivation has caused me to be trapped in here for ten years.”
Wu Jiu felt helpless.
“Brother Jiu, here are some pills and crystal cores, you just use them to restore your cultivation. I’ll check out this defense mechanism.”
Jiang Chen casually threw a storage ring at Wu Jiu. There were quite a lot of Mortal Restoration Pills, natural essences, Earth Restoration Pills, and crystal cores within the ring.
Wu Jiu’s current condition was really bad. His body was like a river that had been completely dried up, and he needed some urgent nourishment.
With these items, Wu Jiu would slowly be able to restore his cultivation.
Wu Jiu’s eyes lit up. He took the storage ring and said, “Alright. Thank you for this.”
Wu Jiu knew about his current condition really well, and therefore, he didn’t reject Jiang Chen’s offer. Jiang Chen’s kindness would forever be in his heart.
Footnotes:
1 - Wu Jiu (武九), the character Wu (武) can be found in Martial Palace (武府) and Martial Saint Dynasty (圣武王朝)

chapters.title: Chapter 234 - Spiraling Defense Mechanism
paragraphs: Leaving Wu Jiu behind, Jiang Chen and Big Yellow started walking toward the defense mechanism. Wi Jiu’s condition had stabilized now, and although the poisonous miasma had caused serious damage to his body, since Jiang Chen had completely absorbed the poison, with Wu Jiu’s peak Combat Soul cultivation base, he wouldn’t have any issues slowly healing.

Besides, Wu Jiu was protected by the True Dragon Flame barrier, he was safe from the poisonous miasma’s corrosion. Together with all the pills, crystal cores and natural essences that Jiang Chen had given him, what Wu Jiu needed to do now was slowly heal himself.

But, since Wu Jiu was trapped here for nearly ten years, all the vital forces in his body had almost been depleted. Even though the poisonous miasma was completely gone, it was no easy task to fully heal. At least not in a short period of time.

Jiang Chen and Big Yellow stood in front of the defense mechanism, both with frowns on their faces. These two guys were experts in formations, and they could easily tell how horrifying the defense mechanism in front of them was.

“All formations are formed with layers of defense mechanisms, and as long as there is a formation, there will be a breaking point somewhere. As long as we can find the breaking point, breaking this formation won’t really be difficult. But, in front of us, there is no formation, but an extremely intact natural defense mechanism, it is so intact that there simply is no breaking point.”
Big Yellow said with a frown on his face.

“You’re right. If it’s a formation, we’d still have a chance at breaking it, but this is literally a defense mechanism as a whole. Big Yellow, do you know anything that might break this defense mechanism?”
Jiang Chen said as he looked at Big Yellow.

“In order to break a defense mechanism, there are only two ways. First is to use force, but even that old man couldn’t break it, let alone both of us. The second method is to create a new defense mechanism. I know one type of defense mechanism that will repulse any other defense mechanism once it is created. With this, we might be able to use the repulsive force between the defense mechanisms and force the natural defense mechanism to focus its strength to one point, so that the other part of it will become weaker. Once that happens, we’ll attack the weak spot, and break the entire defense mechanism.”
Big Yellow said.
“Ordinary defense mechanisms are useless to break this natural defense mechanism, I have tried all sorts of methods for the past ten years.
Wu Jiu said.

Jiang Chen furrowed his brows. In his previous life, he did have some unique accomplishments in the field of defense mechanisms and formations, and he knew at least a few hundreds of them. But, none of them were like what Big Yellow had mentioned.

“All the defense mechanisms you guys know are too low level. In my memory, there is a book called the Heavenly Book of Source Formations, and there are all sorts of ancient defense mechanisms recorded within. There is a defense mechanism called the Spiraling Defense Mechanism, it possesses a spinning force, and once created, it will repel the natural defense mechanism. If we can create this Spiraling Defense Mechanism, we’ll be able to break this thing in front of us.”
Big Yellow explained.
“Heavenly Book of Source Formations?!”

Both Jiang Chen and Wu Jiu exclaimed, especially Jiang Chen. He had traveled everywhere in the Saint Origin realm, but he had never heard about this book before. Also, he didn’t know anything about this Spiraling Defense Mechanism.

But soon after, Jiang Chen felt at ease. The Saint Origin realm was just a lower realm, even if he was the once most powerful and greatest Saint in the realm, there were still many things he didn’t know. The Saint realm wasn’t the peak of cultivation, as there was still the Immortal realm beyond it.

Big Yellow was a Dragon Horse descendant, and he had the complete inheritance of the Divine Beast. He could obtain all sorts of ancient and powerful treasures from his memory. This Heavenly Book of Source Formations was one of his awakened memories.

When Big Yellow was still in the Qi Hai realm, he was already able to break the defense mechanism at the Demon Prison Tower and release a few demon lords. It looked like his knowledge was from the Heavenly Book of Source Formations. Besides, Big Yellow’s amazing treasure hunting ability might also have come from this book.
“Big Yellow, if that’s the case, hurry up and create this Spiraling Defense Mechanism.”
Jiang Chen rushed Big Yellow.
“With my current cultivation level, it will take at least two and a half months to create the Spiraling Defense Mechanism.”
Big Yellow said.
“What?! Two and a half months?!”

Jiang Chen exclaimed. Wu Jiu could still remain calm at this point in time. He had after all been trapped in this place for ten years, so he didn’t really mind waiting another two and a half months. But, Jiang Chen couldn’t wait for so long, he had only been in Inferno Hell for five days, and the doorway to the outside world would be opened in three months. Now, if Big Yellow took two and a half months to create the Spiraling Defense Mechanism, including some unforeseen elements, even if they could leave this place in two and a half months, they would only have ten days before the doorway to the outside world opened. And until now, he still had no news about the Earth Devil.

“The Spiraling Defense Mechanism is an ancient defense mechanism, even the Heavenly Book of Source Formations has classified it as a rare mechanism, and it is really difficult to create one. Two and a half months is the best I can do... Besides, even if I manage to create it, we’ll still be unable to leave this place.”
Big Yellow said.
“Why is that?”
Jiang Chen and Wu Jiu asked at the same time. Wu Jiu’s eyes were blinking, it had been ten years, and he finally saw the possibility to leave this place. Of course he would feel excited.

“Although the Spiraling Defense Mechanism can steal away most of this natural defense mechanism’s strength and cause a weak spot to appear, we still don’t have the strength to break it. Let’s put aside old man Wu Jiu, although he is a Combat Soul warrior, with his current condition, two and a half months won’t allow his cultivation to restore by much. Also, once I create the Spiraling Defense Mechanism, all my energy and spirit will be depleted, so we can only depend on Little Chen to break this natural defense mechanism. But, we need the strong of a Late Divine Core warrior to break it, at least. Therefore, only if Little Chen can break through to the Divine Core realm in two and a half months to break it, we will have the opportunity to leave this place.”

Big Yellow explained. Because of the Heavenly Book of Source Formations, he had a complete understand of the natural defense mechanism, but in order to leave this place, relying on the Spiraling Defense Mechanism Alone would be impossible.

“Alright. I have absorbed a huge amount of demon souls, devil souls and crystal cores, and my cultivation has reached the Heavenly Core realm. I was actually ready to break through to the Divine Core realm. Since we are trapped in this poisonous miasma space, I can actually utilize the harsh environment to stimulate my potential and break through to the Divine Core realm.”

Jiang Chen strengthened his spirit. He was a man who could keep calm even in the most dangerous situations, and although he was left with only a few days after the two and a half months had passed, it was a fate he couldn’t change.
Besides, he had to break through to the Divine Core realm no matter what. If not, even after Big Yellow created the Spiraling Defense Mechanism, they wouldn’t be able to leave this place.

Jiang Chen was going to break through to the Divine Core realm, but he wasn’t going to use any souls, he wanted to break through on his own. Using his own potential and relying on the Dragon Transformation skill’s help to break through to the Divine Core realm, there shouldn’t be any problems with doing this in about two and a half months. Besides, this method of breaking through would help his cultivation base settle down, and his foundation would be much stronger and more solid. Once he broke through to the Divine Core realm, he would be able to continue absorbing souls to form new Dragon Marks.
Without hesitation, Jiang Chen walked and saw down not far from Wu Jiu, then he speedily adjusted himself to his best form. Then, he entered secluded cultivation.
On the other side, Big Yellow had started adjusting his aura as well. Creating a Spiraling Defense Mechanism wasn’t easy, and he couldn’t allow any accidents to happen during the entire process.
Swoosh!
After a short moment, Big Yellow raised up his front hoof and drew a link in midair. A bright trail of light appeared and stood still in the air.
Swoosh swoosh swoosh...
Big Yellow kept drawing and leaving trails of light in the air, which eventually weaved into a gigantic net in front of him.

On the other side, Wu Jiu and Jiang Chen had both entered secluded cultivation. Jiang Chen was going to break through to the Divine Core realm, and Wu Jiu was using pills and crystal cores to slowly restore his cultivation.
One day, two days, three days...

In the blink of an eye, ten days had flashed by. In these ten days, Big Yellow never stopped unleashing defense mechanisms, working hard in creating the Spiraling Defense Mechanism. Jiang Chen remained quiet in his own special state, sitting silently like a meditating monk, as stable as a mountain. Besides the fire barrier covering his body, no energy ripples could be sensed from him. It was as if he had completely entered a state of tranquility

Wu Jiu was the one who had the most change. In just ten days, his cultivation had been restored to the Early Heavenly Core realm, an incredible speed! Besides this, his outlook had changed tremendously as well.

More muscles could be seen on his once skinny body underneath the robe, and the wrinkles on his face had slowly disappeared. He looked much younger now, and he didn’t look like an old man who was long past his prime.
Burning Sky Pavilion!

The Burning Sky Pavilion was similar to the Black Sect, which was located within a massive mountain range. There was also an energy vein underneath the mountain range. Not only did it provide the entire sect with pure natural yuan energy, it also brought them strong fortune.

Right now, within the deepest area in the Burning Sky Pavilion, a young man was sitting on a cushion inside a grand palace. He had an eagle vision and a handsome face, and he portrayed a domineering image from all over his body, as if he was the supreme being of this world.

Opposite of this young man, there sat an adult man who was in his forties. The adult man wore a fiery red long robe, and his aura was no weaker than Daoist Black’s aura. This man was the chief of the Burning Sky Pavilion, Zhao Chongyang, the Qi Province’s true overlord.

“Nanbei, your cultivation base is getting stronger and stronger! After you broke through to the Divine Core realm, your growth became even faster! Looks like it won’t take long before you’re able to break through to the Mid Divine Core realm!”
Zhao Chongyang looked at the young man in front of him and spoke with prideful expression.
This young man was none other than Nanbei Chao.

“I will enter secluded cultivation today to break through to the Mid Divine Core realm. After I break through, the Burning Sky Pavilion will immediately attacked the other three big sects. Before I proceed to the Martial Palace, I want to become the ruler of the entire Qi Province, make everyone submit to me! I, Nanbei Chao will build my own emperor, and become the sole emperor of the entire continent. No matter where I go, I want all people to submit to me!”

Nanbei Chao said word by word with a stern expression. It was an innate overbearing characteristic, a will to conquer everything. The driving force behind Nanbei Chao’s cultivation was to become the most powerful emperor in this world, he wanted every single person to submit to him.

“Alright. With your abilities, once you break through to the Mid Divine Core realm, even I won’t be your match. At that point of time, no one will dare resist when we attack the other three big sects.”

Zhao Chongyang said. He had prepared everything, and once Nanbei Chao broke through to the Mid Divine Core realm, he would attack all three big sects at once, changing the entire structure of the Qi Province.

chapters.title: Chapter 235 - Great Chaos in Inferno Hell
paragraphs: Nanbei Chao’s entire body was glowing in a faded golden light. His blond hair whipped around his head despite the lack of wind, an expression of a might overlord filled his face, and he even wore a dazzling golden robe.

“I, Nanbei Chao am the favored child of the heavens, a supreme existence. My Imperious Ruler skill has reached a profound level, and once I break through to the Mid Divine Core realm, no one in the Divine Core realm will be my match. I am a born king, it is my destiny to rule the entire world and have every single person bow in front of me.”
A domineering and prideful expression emerged on Nanbei Chao’s face.

“Nanbei, you’re just like the shiniest star in the skies, you’re going to have limitless achievements. I’m sure you will leave your own legacy in the Saint Origin realm in the future, just like that Saint who swung his sword and broke the heavens a hundred years ago.”
Zhao Chongyang praised.
“Hmph! That’s nothing, I’m going to be the ultimate emperor of this world; I’ll become the true overlord! All mortals will bow in front of me! The Qi Province is just my first stepping stone.”
Nanbei Chao let out a cold snort. Even the greatest Saint in the world meant nothing to him.

“Oh right, the young man from the Black Sect who had a scheduled fight with you has been in the limelight recently, I heard he’s actually able to kill Divine Core warriors with his mere Heavenly Core cultivation base, even the core disciple of the Heavenly Sword Sect, Yun Can was killed by him. You might want to pay more attention to him.”
Zhao Chongyang suddenly thought about Jiang Chen who had recently caused quite a turmoil in the Qi Province.

“He’s just an ant to me, I’ve never put him in my mind. When the one-year scheduled fight arrives, I’ll step on his head myself, and let him know what a real genius is. With this, I’ll let everyone know what the consequences of offending me area. I don’t need to worry about him right now, just let him live a little longer, just consider it me being kind to him.”
Nanbei Chao always acted in the same aloof manner. He had always despised all those from the younger generation.

“That’s right, that young man simply doesn’t know his own strength, he’s just a dimmed light, and he still tries to fight for the limelight of the brilliant moon, that’s just an act of seeking death. Nanbei, how long will it take for you to break through to the Mid Divine Core realm?”
Zhao Chongyang asked.
“Around two months.”
Nanbei replied.

Within the Poisonous Miasma Space, everything was the same as it was ten day ago. Jiang Chen had no idea about Nanbei Chao’s big plan. Nanbei Chao would need around two months to break through to the Mid Divine Core realm, and that would be around the same time as the doorway to the outside world would open in Inferno Hell.

An isolated space like this easily caused people to lose their track of time. Besides, the two men and the dog were completely immersed in their own special states, they simply didn’t feel the time passing.

Twenty days passed by, they had been trapped in here for one month. Buzzing sounds could be heard in the entire space, countless defense mechanisms filled up the area in front of Big Yellow. He had unleashed a large amount of defense mechanisms, some of them would disappear together with time, and only the stronger ones would remain.

Wu Jiu’s condition was getting better and better, his cultivation had been restored to the peak Mid Heavenly Core realm. At this rate, he would certainly be able to return to the Divine Core realm by the time they left this place, then he would be able to lend a helping hand to Jiang Chen.
Buzz...

Occasionally, buzzing sounds could be heard from Jiang Chen’s body. His bones, his blood, and his flesh were also producing clicking sounds. He was completely immersed in a mindless state, and the Dragon Transformation skill was circulating crazily. All the Dragon Marks were swimming around within his body like real dragons, stimulating Jiang Chen’s potential, and strengthening his foundation.

This was a safe and steady method of levelling up. In just one month, Jiang Chen had formed 20 new Dragon Marks, giving him a total of 770 Dragon Marks. He would only need another 31 Dragon Marks to break through to the Divine Core realm, and he still had about 45 days’ time. Jiang Chen was confident he could do it before he ran out of time.

During the time when Jiang Chen and Big Yellow were trapped in the Poisonous Miasma Space, the entire Inferno Hell had entered a state of turmoil. There were two different chaotic situations, the first was those hundreds of warriors who had been robbed clean by Jiang Chen. In order to survive, they were forced to rob everything that came in their way, and hunt demons and devils all over Inferno Hell.
Their actions had caused battles and fights to erupt everywhere. Many demons and devils had become furious, and some of the demon beast colonies had even emerged. There were wars everything.

But, the chaos caused by these men wasn’t too serious. The second chaotic situation came from the middle area of Inferno City. The incident where Jiang Chen had robbed the entire outer perimeter clean had been heard by everyone, and a lot of strong warriors from the middle area, especially those Late Divine Core warriors, were saying they wanted to defend the natural state of Inferno City. They kept searching for Jiang Chen, they wanted Jiang Chen to pay the price for attacking the natural state of Inferno City.

But in fact, even an idiot knew that they wanting to ‘defend the natural state of Inferno City’, was just bullshit. Inferno Hell was a place where no rules applied, a typical land where the strong preys on the weak. The real motive behind those warriors from the middle area was all the treasures Jiang Chen had obtained.

Everyone knew how much Jiang Chen was worth right now, he was a true fat cat. He had all the treasures that could be found in the outer perimeter of Inferno City. Countless Mortal Restoration Pills, huge amounts of Earth Restoration Pills, numerous demon souls, devil souls, large amount of crystal cores, and limitless natural essences. Not to mention the few hundred combat weapons that were all in his possession now. This was an enormous amount of wealth which made these people envious.

Or, put it this way, Jiang Chen had done something that many people dreamt about doing, but lacked the courage to do. Now, as long as they could find and kill Jiang Chen, they would be able to obtain an inestimable wealth.

Therefore, none of the Divine Core warriors would let go of this opportunity, they were all rushing around in search for Jiang Chen, scared someone else might find him first. It was as if they were in the hunt for an easy prey. With this, Inferno Hell had become even more chaotic.

Within a remote valley somewhere within Inferno Hell, Tian Yishan and a few other men who were suffering from some minor injuries were hiding. During the past month, they had no courage to return to Inferno City. After leaving the devil cave, they had been roaming Inferno Hell, passing time with constant slaughter.
“What a mess, Inferno Hell has become a complete mess! Damn it! Those men from the middle area of Inferno City are attacking, so we can’t even return to Inferno City!”
Wang Heng said with extreme anger.
“Fuck, those bastards are too much! They say they want to defend the natural state of Inferno City, but in actuality, they’re all just look for chief Jiang’s wealth, they just don’t feel shame!”
“We can’t go back right now, once we return, those strong warriors from the middle area will definitely find us, and because of our relationship with chief Jiang, they certainly won’t let us go.”
“The thing is, we have no idea where chief Jiang is right now. It has been one month, and there are still no news from him at all. I’m really worried about him.”

All of them had worried expressions on their faces. Their lives had been saved by Jiang Chen once, and back in the devil cave, Jiang Chen was the one who attracted the Evil Devils’ attention, giving them a chance to escape from danger. If not, with their strength, they wouldn’t be able to leave the place even if they grouped together.
“Do you think chief Jiang was perhaps killed in the devil cave? If not, he should have escaped from there by now.”
Yang Meng carefully said.
“Get lost!”
Guan Yiyun and Tian Yishan both forcefully slapped Yang Meng’s head.

“What bullshit! Brother Jiang is an amazing man, he has the powerful flame that can restrain all Evil Devils; there is no way he could die in the devil cave. Even if he bumped into some extra powerful Evil Devils that he couldn’t defeat, he would have no problem running away.”
Tian Yishan said.

“Junior disciple Jiang came here for the Earth Devil, and I’m sure he’s in the middle of searching for it. There’s less than two months until the doorway to the outside world opens, and I’m sure junior disciple Jiang will definitely appear before that. For the time being, let’s try our best not to bump into those men from Inferno City.
Said Guan Yiyun said.

Everyone nodded their heads in agreement. Before the doorway opens, Jiang Chen would definitely appear. Aside from those who had committed serious crimes in the outside world, those who came to cultivation in Inferno Hell wouldn’t let go of the chance to leave, because once they missed it, they would have to wait for one more year.

Soon, another month passed by. Within the Poisonous Miasma Space, Big Yellow was sweating from all over his body. From his eyes, one could easily tell that he was pretty tired. In front of him, there was a spiraling disc that kept emitting rainbow colored lights, and buzzing sounds continuously sounded out from it.
Above the disc, layers of spiraling patterns could be seen. This was the Spiraling Defense Mechanism that Big Yellow had spent two months making.

Wu Jiu opened up his eyes, his cultivation had been restored to the Early Divine Core realm. Judging from his speed, he would be able to restore his cultivation back to the Mid Divine Core realm by the time they left this place. The speed could be considered incredible. But, since he had suffered severe injuries before this, it was no easy task for him to return to his peak form, it just got tougher and tougher to restore his cultivation back to his peak.

Wu Jiu seemed to be in his fifties now, and his beard had become black. A resolute expression filled his face, and an overbearing feeling could be sensed from his brows, causing anyone who stared into his eyes to feel a chill running down their backs. At the same time, he was unintentionally unleashing an aura of a supreme person.
He turned around and looked at the Spiraling Defense Mechanism in front of Big Yellow, and a look of shock appeared in his eyes.
“What a profound defense mechanism, it truly is something passed down from the ancient era. It’s so complicated that even I can’t understand it.”
Wu Jiu praised, “Big Yellow, how much more time do you need to complete this Spiraling Defense Mechanism?”
“Should be within half a month. I just don’t know if that guy can break through to the Divine Core realm in time or not.”
Big Yellow said. Both he and Wu Jiu turned to look at Jiang Chen at the same time.

At this moment, blood red Dragon Marks covered Jiang Chen’s entire body. A blood red dragon formed from his qi and blood was swimming around above his head, and his aura was getting stronger and stronger.

“Brother Jiang is truly an amazing man, a truly remarkable peerless genius. He isn’t even a Divine Core warrior, and he can still unleash such powerful vigor, qi, and blood. I wouldn’t be able to find anyone who comes close to him in the entire Martial Saint Dynasty.”
Wu Jiu couldn’t help but praise.

At that point in time, he would be able to break through to the Divine Core realm.
