sentences.text: Nanbei Chao’s entire body was glowing in a faded golden light.
His blond hair whipped around his head despite the lack of wind, an expression of a might overlord filled his face, and he even wore a dazzling golden robe.
“I, Nanbei Chao am the favored child of the heavens, a supreme existence.
My Imperious Ruler skill has reached a profound level, and once I break through to the Mid Divine Core realm, no one in the Divine Core realm will be my match.
I am a born king, it is my destiny to rule the entire world and have every single person bow in front of me.”
A domineering and prideful expression emerged on Nanbei Chao’s face.
“Nanbei, you’re just like the shiniest star in the skies, you’re going to have limitless achievements.
I’m sure you will leave your own legacy in the Saint Origin realm in the future, just like that Saint who swung his sword and broke the heavens a hundred years ago.”
Zhao Chongyang praised.
“Hmph!
That’s nothing, I’m going to be the ultimate emperor of this world; I’ll become the true overlord!
All mortals will bow in front of me!
The Qi Province is just my first stepping stone.”
Nanbei Chao let out a cold snort.
Even the greatest Saint in the world meant nothing to him.

“Oh right, the young man from the Black Sect who had a scheduled fight with you has been in the limelight recently, I heard he’s actually able to kill Divine Core warriors with his mere Heavenly Core cultivation base, even the core disciple of the Heavenly Sword Sect, Yun Can was killed by him.
You might want to pay more attention to him.”
Zhao Chongyang suddenly thought about Jiang Chen who had recently caused quite a turmoil in the Qi Province.
“He’s just an ant to me, I’ve never put him in my mind.
When the one-year scheduled fight arrives, I’ll step on his head myself, and let him know what a real genius is.
With this, I’ll let everyone know what the consequences of offending me area.
I don’t need to worry about him right now, just let him live a little longer, just consider it me being kind to him.”
Nanbei Chao always acted in the same aloof manner.
He had always despised all those from the younger generation.
“That’s right, that young man simply doesn’t know his own strength, he’s just a dimmed light, and he still tries to fight for the limelight of the brilliant moon, that’s just an act of seeking death.
Nanbei, how long will it take for you to break through to the Mid Divine Core realm?”
Zhao Chongyang asked.
“Around two months.”
Nanbei replied.
Within the Poisonous Miasma Space, everything was the same as it was ten day ago.
Jiang Chen had no idea about Nanbei Chao’s big plan.
Nanbei Chao would need around two months to break through to the Mid Divine Core realm, and that would be around the same time as the doorway to the outside world would open in Inferno Hell.
An isolated space like this easily caused people to lose their track of time.
Besides, the two men and the dog were completely immersed in their own special states, they simply didn’t feel the time passing.
Twenty days passed by, they had been trapped in here for one month.
Buzzing sounds could be heard in the entire space, countless defense mechanisms filled up the area in front of Big Yellow.
He had unleashed a large amount of defense mechanisms, some of them would disappear together with time, and only the stronger ones would remain.
Wu Jiu’s condition was getting better and better, his cultivation had been restored to the peak Mid Heavenly Core realm.
At this rate, he would certainly be able to return to the Divine Core realm by the time they left this place, then he would be able to lend a helping hand to Jiang Chen.
Buzz...
Occasionally, buzzing sounds could be heard from Jiang Chen’s body.
His bones, his blood, and his flesh were also producing clicking sounds.
He was completely immersed in a mindless state, and the Dragon Transformation skill was circulating crazily.
All the Dragon Marks were swimming around within his body like real dragons, stimulating Jiang Chen’s potential, and strengthening his foundation.
This was a safe and steady method of levelling up.
In just one month, Jiang Chen had formed 20 new Dragon Marks, giving him a total of 770 Dragon Marks.
He would only need another 31 Dragon Marks to break through to the Divine Core realm, and he still had about 45 days’ time.
Jiang Chen was confident he could do it before he ran out of time.
During the time when Jiang Chen and Big Yellow were trapped in the Poisonous Miasma Space, the entire Inferno Hell had entered a state of turmoil.
There were two different chaotic situations, the first was those hundreds of warriors who had been robbed clean by Jiang Chen.
In order to survive, they were forced to rob everything that came in their way, and hunt demons and devils all over Inferno Hell.
Their actions had caused battles and fights to erupt everywhere.
Many demons and devils had become furious, and some of the demon beast colonies had even emerged.
There were wars everything.
But, the chaos caused by these men wasn’t too serious.
The second chaotic situation came from the middle area of Inferno City.

The incident where Jiang Chen had robbed the entire outer perimeter clean had been heard by everyone, and a lot of strong warriors from the middle area, especially those Late Divine Core warriors, were saying they wanted to defend the natural state of Inferno City.
They kept searching for Jiang Chen, they wanted Jiang Chen to pay the price for attacking the natural state of Inferno City.
But in fact, even an idiot knew that they wanting to ‘defend the natural state of Inferno City’, was just bullshit.
Inferno Hell was a place where no rules applied, a typical land where the strong preys on the weak.
The real motive behind those warriors from the middle area was all the treasures Jiang Chen had obtained.
Everyone knew how much Jiang Chen was worth right now, he was a true fat cat.
He had all the treasures that could be found in the outer perimeter of Inferno City.
Countless Mortal Restoration Pills, huge amounts of Earth Restoration Pills, numerous demon souls, devil souls, large amount of crystal cores, and limitless natural essences.
Not to mention the few hundred combat weapons that were all in his possession now.
This was an enormous amount of wealth which made these people envious.
Or, put it this way, Jiang Chen had done something that many people dreamt about doing, but lacked the courage to do.
Now, as long as they could find and kill Jiang Chen, they would be able to obtain an inestimable wealth.
Therefore, none of the Divine Core warriors would let go of this opportunity, they were all rushing around in search for Jiang Chen, scared someone else might find him first.
It was as if they were in the hunt for an easy prey.
With this, Inferno Hell had become even more chaotic.
Within a remote valley somewhere within Inferno Hell, Tian Yishan and a few other men who were suffering from some minor injuries were hiding.
During the past month, they had no courage to return to Inferno City.
After leaving the devil cave, they had been roaming Inferno Hell, passing time with constant slaughter.
“What a mess, Inferno Hell has become a complete mess!
Damn it!
Those men from the middle area of Inferno City are attacking, so we can’t even return to Inferno City!”
Wang Heng said with extreme anger.
“Fuck, those bastards are too much!
They say they want to defend the natural state of Inferno City, but in actuality, they’re all just look for chief Jiang’s wealth, they just don’t feel shame!”
“We can’t go back right now, once we return, those strong warriors from the middle area will definitely find us, and because of our relationship with chief Jiang, they certainly won’t let us go.”
“The thing is, we have no idea where chief Jiang is right now.
It has been one month, and there are still no news from him at all.
I’m really worried about him.”
All of them had worried expressions on their faces.
Their lives had been saved by Jiang Chen once, and back in the devil cave, Jiang Chen was the one who attracted the Evil Devils’ attention, giving them a chance to escape from danger.
If not, with their strength, they wouldn’t be able to leave the place even if they grouped together.
“Do you think chief Jiang was perhaps killed in the devil cave?
If not, he should have escaped from there by now.”
Yang Meng carefully said.
“Get lost!”
Guan Yiyun and Tian Yishan both forcefully slapped Yang Meng’s head.
“What bullshit!
Brother Jiang is an amazing man, he has the powerful flame that can restrain all Evil Devils; there is no way he could die in the devil cave.
Even if he bumped into some extra powerful Evil Devils that he couldn’t defeat, he would have no problem running away.”
Tian Yishan said.
“Junior disciple Jiang came here for the Earth Devil, and I’m sure he’s in the middle of searching for it.
There’s less than two months until the doorway to the outside world opens, and I’m sure junior disciple Jiang will definitely appear before that.
For the time being, let’s try our best not to bump into those men from Inferno City.
Said Guan Yiyun said.
Everyone nodded their heads in agreement.
Before the doorway opens, Jiang Chen would definitely appear.

Aside from those who had committed serious crimes in the outside world, those who came to cultivation in Inferno Hell wouldn’t let go of the chance to leave, because once they missed it, they would have to wait for one more year.
Soon, another month passed by.

In front of him, there was a spiraling disc that kept emitting rainbow colored lights, and buzzing sounds continuously sounded out from it.

This was the Spiraling Defense Mechanism that Big Yellow had spent two months making.

chapters.title: Chapter 236 - Final Juncture
paragraphs: The chaotic situation in Inferno Hell had gone on for two months, and it showed no signs of stopping. Jiang Chen, who was the most important person had disappeared, it was as if he had vanished in the mortal realm. Even with all the Late Divine Core warriors, none could find the slightest trace of Jiang Chen.

There was 25 days until the doorway to the outside world opened up, this period of time was the most chaotic during each year. But this year was the most chaotic year in history. Many warriors had left Inferno City, hoping to find the last pot of gold before they left Inferno Hell.

The furious roars of demons and devils sounded out throughout the entire Inferno Hell, and every single place within Inferno Hell resembled real burning hell. Battles broke out everywhere, and the entire sky above Inferno Hell was filled with the pungent smell of blood.

The more chaotic the situation in Inferno Hell became, the more dangerous it was. Therefore, many people just stayed within Inferno City, waiting for the opening of the doorway. As for those Late Divine Core warriors who were searching for Jiang Chen, some of them had actually stopped searching. They had come to the conclusion that if Jiang Chen was still alive, he would definitely appear before the doorway’s opening. At that point of time, he would have to face death.

Of course, many of them still didn’t want to give up, and they kept searching everywhere for a trace of Jiang Chen. They were worried that someone else might have found Jiang Chen before them. Everyone knew that Jiang Chen was basically a moving treasure chest right now, and the first one to find Jiang Chen would be the same as the first one to find a massive treasures and obtain an enormous amount of wealth.

Within a deeper area of a desolated mountain, a few men were standing together. They all looked to be in bad shapes, and each of them were severely injured. Two months of chaos and slaughter had made Guan Yiyun and the rest of the men feel extreme tired in both body and soul.

Right now, Guan Yiyun and a few other men all had expressions mixed with grief and anger. On the ground in front of them, two men were lying with blood all over their bodies. Obviously, both these men had died.
“Ahh! I can’t stand it anymore!”

Wang Heng let out a loud shot. One of his arms was bleeding nonstop, and it was a pretty bad injury. The men lying on the ground were their brothers who had gone through life and death together with them, and for the last two months, they had been running for their lives together and fought countless battles. Those warriors who had all their belongings robbed by Jiang Chen had become like mad dogs, and they had extreme hatred toward this group of men. Since they knew that many Late Divine Core warriors from the middle area of Inferno City were going to attack Jiang Chen, they came to the conclusion that Jiang Chen was doomed. Therefore, they had no more fear towards Guan Yiyun and the rest.

During the last two months, Guan Yiyun and the other men had constantly been tense. Although they kept hiding in different places, fights were still unavoidable. Demons, devils, crystal beasts, all sorts of intense battles. Also, when they bumped into those warriors from the outer perimeter, they would have to fight them with their lives on the line.
In the end, they had come to this quiet desolate mountain, but two of their men were dead due to severe injuries.
“In Inferno Hell, our lives don’t belong to us anymore. Both of them has gone ahead of us, I have no idea how long we can last.”

Tian Yishan said with an indifferent tone. Their current situation was really bad, enemies were everywhere, human warriors were trying to kill them, demons and devils were trying to eat them, and it was actually a miracle that they had been able to survive until now. But, none of them had any idea what they should do next.
“This damn Inferno Hell, if I am able to leave this place alive, I will never come to this shithole again!”
Yang Meng said in anger, his face covered with blood.
“Senior disciple Tian, let’s burn their bodies.”
Guan Yiyun said. When someone died in Inferno Hell, the most proper way of handling their bodies was to have someone burn it to ashes. If not, they might end up becoming food for demons and devils.

All these men had solemn expressions as they bowed toward the two dead bodies. Although they didn’t know each other before they came to Inferno Hell, after having spent such a long period of time and encountering many life and death situations together, they had actually developed strong bonds.
Guan Yiyun set the bodies on fire. All of them stood solemnly until both bodies were burned into ashes.
“Chief Tian, what should we do next?”
Wang Heng asked.

“All of us have suffered pretty bad injuries, and this location we’ve found is very desolate and remote. Also, there aren’t many monsters here either. For the time being, we’ll hide at this place and heal ourselves. After that, we’ll start paying attention to what’s happening outside. The doorway to the outside world will soon open, and I believe brother Jiang is going to appear.”
Tian Yishan said.

“What senior disciple Tian said is correct. With our current situation, hiding in this secret place is the best option. All of us are wounded, and we need to heal ourselves back to normal as quickly as possible.”
Guan Yiyun said.
“Fuck, this is so suffocating!”
Yang Meng felt really angry. All this time, they had been facing enemies no matter where they went.
Within the Poisonous Miasma Space!

The trio were all busy with their own matters, and none of them had any idea about what was going on outside. They didn’t know anything about the chaotic situation that was playing out right now. Time passed, day by day, both men and the dog had experienced huge transformations.
In the blink of an eye, two weeks had passed.
Ha!

All of a sudden, a loud shout could be heard from Wu Jiu. At the same time, a massive force was unleashed from his body, blasting all air aside. After two and a half months of restoration, Wu Jiu’s cultivation had finally returned to Early Divine Core realm. Compared to his previous dispirited state, he had transformed tremendously.

Wu Jiu stood up from where he said. His rugged body was full of pure yang energy, a pair of shining eyes made his rough face look extremely lively, and he was portraying a vigorous look and the aura of a supreme being. No one could relate the current him to the old man who looked to be way past his prime, he just looked extraordinary now.

“Although I’ve only restored my cultivation to the Divine Core realm, my vitality has been fully restored. I just need to leave this place, then it won’t take me long to fully restore my cultivation! Thank you heavens for sparing my, Lord Jiu’s life!”

Wu Jiu was laughing out heartily. He had the reason to be so happy, a man who had prepared to face death, but was then suddenly led out from despair and welcomed into a new life, he just couldn’t help but be excited.
Buzz...

Right at this moment, an ear-splitting buzzing sound could be heard. Wu Jiu turned around and looked at Big Yellow, and to his surprise, the disc shaped defense mechanism had been completely formed. It was spinning at high speed as well. After working relentlessly for two and a half months, Big Yellow had finally created the Spiraling Defense Mechanism. The buzzing sound was coming at the Spiraling Defense Mechanism that was spinning at high speed.
Plop!

Right after the Spiraling Defense Mechanism was completed, Big Yellow couldn’t endure any longer and fell onto the ground. Sweat could be seen all over his face, and his dog tongue rolled out of his mouth as he rapidly panted. Both his eyes looked really tired.
“Damn it, with this master dog’s current strength, creating this Spiraling Defense Mechanism by force is just the same as seeking death... this master dog is damn tired...”
Big Yellow murmured.
“Such an advanced and complicated defense mechanism! Big Yellow, you’re truly amazing, you have my respect!”
Wu Jiu cupped his fist toward Big Yellow. He was amazed and filled with admiration. It was rare for Wu Jiu to admire someone, let alone a dog.

“Old man, your speed of recovery is pretty fast. With your current Early Divine Core strength, you can now contribute some help in breaking this natural defense mechanism. I just wonder if this guy can break through to the Divine Core realm in time.”

Big Yellow gazed at Jiang Chen who was still in secluded cultivation, then he said, “The Spiraling Defense Mechanism can only last for three hours. If this guy doesn’t break through to the Divine Core realm in three hours, it will disappear by itself, and all our hard effort will go to waste.”
“Three hours, I hope brother Jiang can break through soon.”

Wu Jiu turned around and looked at the natural defense mechanism, then he said, “Big Yellow, with the help of the Spiraling Defense Mechanism, can we break the natural defense mechanism with my current strength?”

“No way. Although you are a Combat Soul warrior, you only have the strength of an Early Divine Core warrior right now. Besides, your foundation hasn’t been completely restored, and that limits the maximum amount of force you can unleash. In order the break this natural defense mechanism, we need at least the strength of a Late Divine Core warrior.”
Big Yellow shook his head.
Wu Jiu furrowed his brows. With his current condition, it was true that he couldn’t unleash the energy of a Late Divine Core warrior.
“But, even if brother Jiang breaks through to the Divine Core realm, he’ll only be at the early stage. I don’t think he will be able to unleash the energy of a Late Divine Core warrior.”
Wu Jiu looked at Jiang Chen who was sitting on the ground.
“Don’t underestimate this guy, once he breaks through to the Early Divine Core realm, perhaps even without your help, he alone will be able to break this natural defense mechanism.”
Big Yellow said. Wu Jiu didn’t know Jiang Chen well, but Big Yellow knew that Jiang Chen was an abnormal monster.
Wu Jiu took a deep breath, he was skeptical about Big Yellow’s words. No doubt, Jiang Chen was a genius, but without witnessing it himself, he still wouldn’t believe it.
Click click...

Clicking sounds kept sounding out from Jiang Chen’s bone and flesh, and the aura of the blood qi dragon above his head became stronger and stronger. At the same time, his energy became stronger and stronger with each passing second.
One hour, one and a half hours, two hours, two and a half hours.
Time just slipped away, but Jiang Chen still hadn’t opened his eyes. However, the crystal clear clicking sound coming from his body was sounding out more rapidly.
“Damn it, we only have half an hour left, if this guy doesn’t break through soon, all our efforts will have gone to waste.”

Big Yellow became worried. The Spiraling Defense Mechanism could only last for three hours, and now, there was only half an hour left. If Jiang Chen still couldn’t break through in this half hour, they would lose the chance to get out from this place, and all their hard efforts would go to waste. Once they missed this opportunity, they would have to wait another year before they had the chance to leave this place.
“We only have half an hour left, I don’t think he can make it, we have to try ourselves. Big Yellow, activate the Spiraling Defense Mechanism now; let me try to break the natural defense mechanism.”
Wu Jiu said.
“No.”
Big Yellow immediately rejected, “You can’t break the natural defense mechanism. I believe in Little Chen, he will definitely have a breakthrough in time.”

Big Yellow knew more about the natural defense mechanism and the Spiraling Defense Mechanism than Wu Jiu did. With Wu Jiu’s current strength, he wouldn’t be able to break the natural defense mechanism, even with the help of the Spiraling Defense Mechanism. Big Yellow had used up all his yuan energy and strength, so he couldn’t provide any help in break the natural defense mechanism.

Big Yellow knew that Jiang Chen would definitely break through to the Divine Core realm within this last half hour, because Jiang Chen wanted to leave this place more than anyone else. There were only ten days before the opening of the doorway, and they still had no news about the Earth Devil. Jiang Chen still had many things to do, and although it looked like he was in secluded cultivation, he knew everything better than anyone else.
Bang!
Right as Big Yellow’s words left his mouth, an enormous aura was unleashed from Jiang Chen’s body like a raging tsunami.

Compared to his previous dispirited state, he had transformed tremendously.
Wu Jiu stood up from where he said.
His rugged body was full of pure yang energy, a pair of shining eyes made his rough face look extremely lively, and he was portraying a vigorous look and the aura of a supreme being.
No one could relate the current him to the old man who looked to be way past his prime, he just looked extraordinary now.
“Although I’ve only restored my cultivation to the Divine Core realm, my vitality has been fully restored.
I just need to leave this place, then it won’t take me long to fully restore my cultivation!
Thank you heavens for sparing my, Lord Jiu’s life!”
Wu Jiu was laughing out heartily.
He had the reason to be so happy, a man who had prepared to face death, but was then suddenly led out from despair and welcomed into a new life, he just couldn’t help but be excited.
Buzz...
Right at this moment, an ear-splitting buzzing sound could be heard.
Wu Jiu turned around and looked at Big Yellow, and to his surprise, the disc shaped defense mechanism had been completely formed.
It was spinning at high speed as well.
After working relentlessly for two and a half months, Big Yellow had finally created the Spiraling Defense Mechanism.
The buzzing sound was coming at the Spiraling Defense Mechanism that was spinning at high speed.
Plop!
Right after the Spiraling Defense Mechanism was completed, Big Yellow couldn’t endure any longer and fell onto the ground.
Sweat could be seen all over his face, and his dog tongue rolled out of his mouth as he rapidly panted.
Both his eyes looked really tired.
“Damn it, with this master dog’s current strength, creating this Spiraling Defense Mechanism by force is just the same as seeking death... this master dog is damn tired...”
Big Yellow murmured.
“Such an advanced and complicated defense mechanism!
Big Yellow, you’re truly amazing, you have my respect!”
Wu Jiu cupped his fist toward Big Yellow.
He was amazed and filled with admiration.
It was rare for Wu Jiu to admire someone, let alone a dog.
“Old man, your speed of recovery is pretty fast.
With your current Early Divine Core strength, you can now contribute some help in breaking this natural defense mechanism.
I just wonder if this guy can break through to the Divine Core realm in time.”
Big Yellow gazed at Jiang Chen who was still in secluded cultivation, then he said, “The Spiraling Defense Mechanism can only last for three hours.
If this guy doesn’t break through to the Divine Core realm in three hours, it will disappear by itself, and all our hard effort will go to waste.”
“Three hours, I hope brother Jiang can break through soon.”

Wu Jiu turned around and looked at the natural defense mechanism, then he said, “Big Yellow, with the help of the Spiraling Defense Mechanism, can we break the natural defense mechanism with my current strength?”
“No way.
Although you are a Combat Soul warrior, you only have the strength of an Early Divine Core warrior right now.
Besides, your foundation hasn’t been completely restored, and that limits the maximum amount of force you can unleash.
In order the break this natural defense mechanism, we need at least the strength of a Late Divine Core warrior.”
Big Yellow shook his head.
Wu Jiu furrowed his brows.
With his current condition, it was true that he couldn’t unleash the energy of a Late Divine Core warrior.
“But, even if brother Jiang breaks through to the Divine Core realm, he’ll only be at the early stage.
I don’t think he will be able to unleash the energy of a Late Divine Core warrior.”
Wu Jiu looked at Jiang Chen who was sitting on the ground.
“Don’t underestimate this guy, once he breaks through to the Early Divine Core realm, perhaps even without your help, he alone will be able to break this natural defense mechanism.”
Big Yellow said.
Wu Jiu didn’t know Jiang Chen well, but Big Yellow knew that Jiang Chen was an abnormal monster.
Wu Jiu took a deep breath, he was skeptical about Big Yellow’s words.
No doubt, Jiang Chen was a genius, but without witnessing it himself, he still wouldn’t believe it.
Click click...
Clicking sounds kept sounding out from Jiang Chen’s bone and flesh, and the aura of the blood qi dragon above his head became stronger and stronger.
At the same time, his energy became stronger and stronger with each passing second.
One hour, one and a half hours, two hours, two and a half hours.
Time just slipped away, but Jiang Chen still hadn’t opened his eyes.
However, the crystal clear clicking sound coming from his body was sounding out more rapidly.
“Damn it, we only have half an hour left, if this guy doesn’t break through soon, all our efforts will have gone to waste.”
Big Yellow became worried.
The Spiraling Defense Mechanism could only last for three hours, and now, there was only half an hour left.
If Jiang Chen still couldn’t break through in this half hour, they would lose the chance to get out from this place, and all their hard efforts would go to waste.
Once they missed this opportunity, they would have to wait another year before they had the chance to leave this place.
“We only have half an hour left, I don’t think he can make it, we have to try ourselves.
Big Yellow, activate the Spiraling Defense Mechanism now; let me try to break the natural defense mechanism.”
Wu Jiu said.
“No.”
Big Yellow immediately rejected, “You can’t break the natural defense mechanism.
I believe in Little Chen, he will definitely have a breakthrough in time.”
Big Yellow knew more about the natural defense mechanism and the Spiraling Defense Mechanism than Wu Jiu did.
With Wu Jiu’s current strength, he wouldn’t be able to break the natural defense mechanism, even with the help of the Spiraling Defense Mechanism.
Big Yellow had used up all his yuan energy and strength, so he couldn’t provide any help in break the natural defense mechanism.
Big Yellow knew that Jiang Chen would definitely break through to the Divine Core realm within this last half hour, because Jiang Chen wanted to leave this place more than anyone else.
There were only ten days before the opening of the doorway, and they still had no news about the Earth Devil.
Jiang Chen still had many things to do, and although it looked like he was in secluded cultivation, he knew everything better than anyone else.
Bang!
Right as Big Yellow’s words left his mouth, an enormous aura was unleashed from Jiang Chen’s body like a raging tsunami.

chapters.title: Chapter 237 - Delivered from Oppression
paragraphs: The aura was getting stronger and stronger, Jiang Chen was completely covered in a golden light, which made him shine like a brilliant sun, forcing people to take they eyes away from him. In the end, even Wu Jiu was shocked by him.
“Kaka, I told you this guy was going to make it!”
Big Yellow was laughing out loudly. The worry on his face had finally disappeared.

“He is only breaking through to the Divine Core realm, but he is unleashing such a powerful aura! I wouldn’t believe it if I hadn’t witnessed it myself! Brother Jiang is indeed an incredible peerless genius, his future achievements are going to be limitless!”

Wu Jiu had seen all kinds of geniuses, each and every single one of them were amazing, but when those amazing geniuses were compared to the young man in front of him, the gap between them was not small. Wu Jiu himself was also a peerless genius. If he wasn’t, then he wouldn’t have gotten so far. When he broke through to the Divine Core realm, his aura wasn’t even ten percent as strong as the aura Jiang Chen was unleashing right now.
“No wonder Big Yellow has such high confidence in brother Jiang, his current aura is more than enough to compare with those Late Divine Core warriors.”
Wu Jiu pressed down the excitement in his heart as he stared at Jiang Chen.

At this moment, the Heavenly Core in Jiang Chen’s Qi Sea had completely transformed. Numerous mystical patterns appeared on it, and it was covered by countless blood red Dragon Marks. It looked like a myriad of stars surrounding the moon.

Eight hundred Dragon Marks had been completely formed, Jiang Chen had broken through to the Divine Core realm, reaching a higher realm and altitude. Besides this, Jiang Chen’s potential had once again been stimulated, and his foundation was much more solid and richer now. Therefore, Jiang Chen didn’t exit his secluded cultivation, but instead began absorbing a huge amount of demon souls.
“What is he doing now?”
Wu Jiu was shocked.
“He is going for more powerful combat strength.”

Big Yellow said with a smile. With his experience, he could easily understand Jiang Chen’s current condition. After breaking through to the Divine Core realm, 800 Dragon Marks could no longer satisfy Jiang Chen. At this moment, Jiang Chen was absorbing huge amounts of energies and forming new Dragon Marks, increasing his combat strength.

Jiang Chen had 800 Dragon Marks right now, and an Early Divine Core. If he wanted to break through to the Mid Divine Core realm, he would need to double his amount of Dragon Marks, a total of 1600 Dragon Marks. Only then would he be able to break through to the Mid Divine Core realm.

Jiang Chen had a huge amount of demon souls and devil souls, as well as a lot of crystal cores. However, although the quantity was huge, Jiang Chen’s demand was massive at the same time. Cultivating the Dragon Transformation skill required consumed enormous amounts of energies, and as Jiang Chen’s cultivation advanced, the required energy to form new Dragon Marks would be more and more. Now, forming a new Dragon Mark would require ten times the energy compared to before.
“Let’s not worry about that now. After all, my foundation is extremely strong and solid now, I can temporarily absorb a large amount of souls to form new dragon marks.”

Jiang Chen thought to himself. After that, without hesitation, he began transforming all the demon souls, devil souls and crystal cores in the purest energy with the help of the Dragon Transformation skill and absorbing it.

In just 20 minutes, Jiang Chen had utilized the massive amount of energies and formed another 200 Dragon Marks, which gave him a total of 1000 Dragon Marks. But, these newly formed Dragon Marks had consumed a lot of energies, and he had used up nearly half of his demon and devil souls. The rest of them could at most give him another 200 Dragon Marks, and he would need a lot more in order to break through to the Mid Divine Core realm.

“The level of souls I have are too low, most of them are Early Divine Core souls and Heavenly Core souls, some of them are Mid Divine Core souls, and there are only 2 Late Divine Core souls. With my current condition, those Heavenly Core souls are worthless to me. Looks like I’ll need to find more mid and Late Divine Core souls. Although this method allows me to quickly increase my strength, I’ll have to be careful. Two hundred new Dragon Marks are actually quite a lot, and I’ll need to take some time to settle them down.”

Jiang Chen thought to himself. This method of levelling up was extremely brutal, and even Jiang Chen himself dared not use it without restrictions. After breaking through, he definitely needed to take some time to digest the energy properly and stabilize his cultivation.
“Damn it, buddy, we only have ten minutes left, hurry up and finish your cultivation!”
Big Yellow kept pushing.
Swoosh!
Right after Big Yellow’s words left his mouth, Jiang Chen immediately opened up his eyes. His gaze was fierce, pretty terrifying.

“Perfect, Big Yellow, you’ve done great. Not only have I broken through to the Early Divine Core realm, my cultivation base has complete stabilized, not like those rookies after having just broken through to the Divine Core realm. Let’s delay no longer, activate the Spiraling Defense Mechanism and make it repel with the natural defense mechanism, I’ll attack its weak spot.”

Jiang Chen instantly stood up from where he stood, the combat strength of 1,000 Dragon Marks had separated him from those rookies who had just broken through to the Early Divine Core realm. With his current combat strength, not only Mid Divine Core warriors, he could even kill Late Divine Core warriors with a single strike. A peak Divine Core warrior like Daoist Black was no match for Jiang Chen at all.
“Alright.”
Big Yellow’s ears stood up. Using his head, he pushed the Spiraling Defense Mechanism and walked step by step toward the natural defense mechanism.
“Brother Jiang, you had such an incredible aura even though you were just breaking through to the Divine Core realm, astonishing! If I hadn’t witnessed it myself, I wouldn’t have believed it!”
Wu Jiu patted Jiang Chen’s shoulder, he couldn’t help but praise Jiang Chen.
“Brother Jiu, you seem much younger.”
Jiang Chen said with a smile. Wu Jiu had become completely different compared to his previous dying state, he was brimming with energy now, and was full of vigor.

“Cut the chitchat, the Spiraling Defense Mechanism can only attract the natural defense mechanism’s force temporarily. Buddy, you’ll have to carefully sense the weak spot of this natural defense mechanism, we only have one chance.”

Big Yellow seriously reminded. Both Jiang Chen and Wu Jiu’s expressions became tense, especially Wu Jiu’s. He was the most nervous person here. Being trapped here for ten years; he wanted to leave this shithole more than anyone else.
Buzz buzz...
Big Yellow pushed his head against the disc shaped Spiraling Defense Mechanism that was emitting rainbow colored lights. Slowly, he pushed it toward the center of the natural defense mechanism.
Bang!
Right as the Spiraling Defense Mechanism touched the natural defense mechanism, a massive repelling force was unleashed, and Big Yellow was pushed back by this massive force.”
“Damn it! This master dog is going to fucking...”
When Big Yellow was pushed back, he felt like he was the most miserable dog in the world. Why did he always have to meet with all the unlucky matters?

In front of the natural defense mechanism, Jiang Chen was unleashing the Great Soul Derivation skill, raising his senses to the most sensitive level. The Spiraling Defense Mechanism had caused the natural defense mechanism to focus all its force on one point, and that was the massive force that had pushed Big Yellow away.

At this moment, Jiang Chen had sensed a weak spot below the natural defense mechanism with his senses. Without any hesitation, he punched the weak spot with all his strength. At the same time, Wu Jiu also punched the same time, helping Jiang Chen.
Bang!
A violent impact! A tsunami like repelling force pushed Jiang Chen and Wu Jiu back a couple of steps.
Crack!
Jiang Chen had smashed the weak spot on the natural defense mechanism, causing a huge crack on it to appear. Also, the Spiraling Defense Mechanism had disappeared.
“Big Yellow, hurry up, this natural defense mechanism can heal itself!”
Jiang Chen pulled Big Yellow’s ear, and with extremely fast speed, he dashed into the crack on the natural defense mechanism. Wu Jiu followed closely behind.
Right after they had left the space, the crack on the defense mechanism had started slowly recovering.
“Fuck, we were almost trapped in there forever! Big Yellow, you’ve done a good job this time, beautifully done!”
Jiang Chen pressed on Big Yellow’s head with both hands. Using a different kind of method to praise Big Yellow for his excellent work.
“Get lost, daddy is feeling real tired in both body and soul, don’t touch me.”
Big Yellow struggled hard and pushed away Jiang Chen’s big hand as he gazed at Jiang Chen with a pair of angry eyes.
“HAHAHA, DADDY IS OUT! FINALLY!! DADDY HAS LEFT THAT SHITHOLE!!!”

Wu Jiu extended both his arms sideways and let out long cries toward the skies. He kept laughing out loud without stop, with tears in both eyes. Jiang Chen and Big Yellow stared at the hectic Wu Jiu, both of them had relieved expressions on their faces. They could really relate to Wu Jiu’s emotions right now. They had been trapped in the Poisonous Miasma Space for two and a half months, and they knew very well hos terrifying the place was. But Wu Jiu, he had been trapped there for ten years, and finally, he was able to see the outside world again. There was no way he wouldn’t be happy.
After some time, Wu Jiu finally finished his laughing. With big steps, he walked in front of Jiang Chen and Big Yellow. Without any hesitation, he bowed deeply toward both of them.
“Brother Jiang, Big Yellow, Wu Jiu wants to thank you for saving my life! This great kindness will exist in Wu Jiu’s heart for all of eternity!”
Wu Jiu said with utmost sincerity. In the entire Martial Saint Dynasty, there were only a handful of people whom deserved a bow from Wu Jiu.
“Brother Jiu, we’re brothers, cut those formalities, I don’t like them.”
Jiang Chen said. Both men looked at each other and laughed.
“Alright, hurry up and check, where are we right now?”
Big Yellow reminded.
Only now did both men react. They found that they were in a wilderness, not the devil cave where they originally came from. Demon roars could be heard from far.
“This should be some place within Inferno Hell... There are only ten days until the doorway to the outside world opens up; I think we should go back to Inferno City.”
Wu Jiu said.
“Only ten days?”
Jiang Chen felt anxious. Ten days was too short, and up until now, he still had no idea where the Earth Devil was.
“Buddy, give me something to eat, I need to replenish my energy.”
Big Yellow said.

Without saying anything, Jiang Chen simply threw a storage ring fully filled with natural essences toward Big Yellow. Big Yellow had done an excellent job this time, and he had used up a huge amount of his energies. He deserved the reward.

Looking at the storage ring, Big Yellow instantly became happy. He took out all the natural essences and begun his big feast. All of this were great tonics for him, and it was exactly what he needed right now.
“Brother Jiu, do you know where can I find the Earth Devil?”
Jiang Chen asked.
“Earth Devil? Why is brother Jiang looking for it?”
Wu Jiu looked at Jiang Chen and asked.

“Let me be frank, the reason I came to Inferno Hell was to look for the Earth Devil. One of my brothers is in a life endangering situation, and only the Earth Devil’s devil soul can save his life. I’m here to find the Earth Devil and kill it. I hadn’t expected that three months would flash by without me having any idea where to find it.”
Jiang Chen explained.
“I know where the Earth Devil is.”
Wu Jiu said

chapters.title: Chapter 238 - The Qi Province’s Upheaval Begins
paragraphs: Hearing what Wu Jiu said, Jiang Chen’s eyes immediately lit up.
“Brother Jiu, where can I find that Earth Devil?”
Jiang Chen hurriedly asked.

“According to what I know, there is an Earth Devil Mountain in the center of Inferno Hell, and that’s where the Earth Devil resides. I heard about the Earth Devil many years ago, and I was planning on fighting it and turning it into my mount, but I never thought that before I could reach the Earth Devil Mountain, I would be trapped in the Poisonous Miasma Space for ten years.”
Wu Jiu said with a bitter and self-mocking expression.
“Earth Devil Mountain?”
Jiang Chen had mixed emotions in his heart. It was actually located in the deepest area of Inferno Hell, there was no doubts it would be a terrifying place.

“But, that Earth Devil was an Early Combat Soul monster ten years ago. Now, ten years have passed, and I’m sure it has definitely become stronger, perhaps it hasn’t reached the Mid Combat Soul realm yet, but it must have at least reached the peak Early Combat Soul realm. If I was at my peak, I would have no problem defeating this Earth Devil, but now, there are only ten days until the doorway to the outside world opens up, and it seems unrealistic for brother Jiang to kill this Earth Devil.”
Wu Jiu said. With their current strength, the gap between them and the Earth Devil was not small, and it was tougher to kill it and take its devil soul than reaching the top of the heavens.
“I have to get the Earth Devil’s devil soul no matter what, this is the most important reason for why I came to Inferno Hell. Does brother Jiu know how we can get to the Earth Devil Mountain?”
Jiang Chen looked at Wu Jiu and asked.

“The Earth Devil is a supreme specie amongst all devil species, it will certainly stay in the place where the most devilish energy can be found. If my guess is correct, it should be connected to the devil cave. If we travel across the devil cave, we will be able to reach the Earth Devil Mountain. However, once we enter the devil cave, those Evil Devils will definitely storm at us. As long as we can kill all the Combat Soul Evil Devils in the devil cave, I believe that the Earth Devil will come to us.”
Wu Jiu said.
“Kill all Combat Soul Evil Devils...”

Jiang Chen furrowed his brows. This was something impossible for him. Those Combat Soul existences had formed a Combat Soul in their bodies, which was equal to the Nascent Soul of a cultivator. As long as the Combat Soul wasn’t destroyed; one would have the opportunity to be reincarnated.

There was a huge gap between the Divine Core realm and the Combat Soul realm, the gap between the strengths was simply incomparable. Therefore, although Jiang Chen had broken through to the Divine Core realm, had 1,000 Dragon Marks, and could fight any Late Divine Core warrior, he was still not a match for a Combat Soul warrior. With his current cultivation, he would still have to run away when facing a Combat Soul Evil Devil in the devil cave.

“We only have a little time left, and it’s impossible for you to reach a level where you can kill that Earth Devil. As for me, I’ll need at least a few months in order to restore my cultivation to the Combat Soul realm. Judging from the current situation, if brother Jiang insists in killing that Earth Devil, I’m afraid there is only one way left, and it’s an uncertain method.”
Wu Jiu said.
Jiang Chen’s eyes lit up, then he asked, “What method is that?”
“Does brother Jiang know why all those demons and devils doesn’t dare attack Inferno City?”
Wu Jiu asked.
“I guess there’s something in Inferno City that those demons and devils are afraid of. If not, the entire city would have long ago been conquered by them.”

Jiang Chen said. Big Yellow had sensed that there was a treasure hidden somewhere within Inferno City when they arrived at the place. A treasure that could be sensed by Big Yellow must be something extraordinary, and the reason why those monsters didn’t dare attack Inferno City must have something to do with that treasure.

“You’re right, there is indeed a treasure that exists within Inferno City, and it is because of that treasure’s protection that Inferno City has become the safest place for humans to rest in Inferno Hell. No demons or devils can even come to disturb.”
Wu Jiu said. The first thing he did when he arrived in Inferno Hell many years ago was to find out about the secret of Inferno City.
“Does brother Jiu know what kind of treasure it is?”
Jiang Chen asked.

“I have no idea, I have never seen it before. I did try to search for it, but it was to no avail. But, I’m sure the treasure exists, and my guess is that it requires a great fate to be able to locate and obtain this treasure. My fate isn’t great enough, and that’s why I couldn’t find it. But, if brother Jiang is fortunate enough, you can try to enter the center of Inferno City and give it a try, you might be able to find the treasure. With its restraining ability towards all demons and devils, we’ll have a chance to kill the Combat Soul Evil Devils, and even the Earth Devil.”
Wu Jiu said.
When mentioning treasure, Big Yellow was currently feasting next to them became high spirited.
“As long as we can enter the center of Inferno City, this master dog will be able to find that treasure.”
Big Yellow said.
“He’s right. In this world, there are no treasures Big Yellow can’t find. If this is the case, let’s leave this place and proceed to Inferno City.”
Jiang Chen said in a hurry. Their time was tight right now, and he didn’t want to delay any longer.
“Alright.”
Wu Jiu nodded his head, then the trio started flying towards Inferno City.
Qi Province, Burning Sky Pavilion. The entire sky was clear, and a rich energy filled the atmosphere.
Bang!

All of a sudden, a groundbreaking explosion sound could be heard from the palace located in the deepest area of the Burning Sky Pavilion. A golden light beam shot up into the sky with amazing force, and a strong king’s aura could be sensed from the light beam, causing people to feel it came from a supreme person. They couldn’t help but admire and worship it in their minds.
“What an amazing aura, it belongs to senior disciple Nanbei, he has broken through again.”

“This is terrifying, senior disciple Nanbei is indeed a peerless genius that can’t be found even in a thousand years! His progress is simply astonishing! Besides, his Mid Divine Core aura is much stronger than the chief’s aura.”
“I heard that senior disciple Nanbei was born from an Immortal Rock, I wonder if that’s true.”

“Someone said that in the Divine Continent far away from here, there was an extraordinary Saint, and with his sword, he fought the heavens and cut open the gate to the Realm of Immortal a hundred years ago. Many people were discussing with soft voices. But, this was only an urban legend, and no one really knew the origin of Nanbei Chao.
“I heard that after senior disciple Nanbei finishes his secluded cultivation, he is going to attack the other three big sects and rule the entire Qi Province.”

“Hahaha, the time for the Burning Sky Pavilion to rule the entire Qi Province is finally here, the structure of the Qi Province is going to completely change! That guy from the Black Sect, Jiang Chen, has challenged senior disciple’s dignity, he has no idea what the consequences will be!”
“That’s right, who gave that brat the audacity to challenge senior disciple Nanbei to a fight in one year? Sooner or later, senior disciple Nanbei will crush him under his foot, just like an ant!”

In the Burning Sky Pavilion, Nanbei Chao had more supporters, and received more respect than the chief. Not only the ordinary disciples; even all the Sect Elders who sat in high positions showed Nanbei Chao respect.

Within the palace, Nanbei Chao who was wearing a golden robe was filled with powerful energy. After breaking through to the Mid Divine Core realm, his energy had reached an incredible level, and even Zhao Chongyang who was standing next to him was shocked.
“What powerful energy! Nanbei, you have successfully broken through!”
Zhao Chongyang said.
“That’s right, chief, I have broken through to the Mid Divine Core realm. Now is the time to strike the other three big sects. Let’s begin with the Heavenly Sword Sect.”
Nanbei Chao said.
“Fine, I’ll gather all the men and initiate an attack at the Heavenly Sword Sect.”

Zhao Chongyang unleashed his aura, he showed the utmost support in the decision of attacking the other three big sects. He had put in a lot of effort to do so, because he knew Nanbei Chao really well, Nanbei Chao was going after the entire world, and the little Qi Province was just his stepping stone. Once the Burning Sky Pavilion rules the entire Qi Province, Nanbei Chao would leave the place and proceed to the Martial Palace, and at that point of time, the entire Qi Province would belong to Zhao Chongyang.

“You don’t have to, just send an order to the Heavenly Sword Sect, ask all the Divine Core realm warriors to come submit to me within three days, and the Heavenly Sword Sect will have to merge with the Burning Sky Pavilion, becoming our subordinates. If they don’t come here, once three days have passed, I’ll personally attack and destroy the entire Heavenly Sword Sect.”
Nanbei Chao said, word by word.
“With Duan Jianhong’s attitude, I’m sure he won’t easily surrender, and that means they will have three days to prepare.”
Zhao Chongyang said as he furrowed his brows.
“Just give them the time to prepare then. If that Duan Jianhong doesn’t want to surrender, I’ll kill him myself. I want to destroy all three big sects openly.”
Nanbei Chao was extremely prideful, his arrogance could even reach the heavens.
Roar... roar... roar...
In Inferno Hell, wild roars and energy ripples from combat could be found everywhere.
“Why has Inferno Hell become so chaotic?”
Jiang Chen furrowed his brows.

“Every time the doorway to the outside world is about to open, Inferno Hell will enter a chaotic state. But, the degree of chaos this time seems to be more serious in history, as if something big has happened.”
Wu Jiu said.
Aowuu!
All of a sudden, a gigantic Nine Life Crystal Beast appeared in front of the trio. This crystal beast was unleash pure and powerful energy from its body as it roared at the trio.
“A Late Divine Core crystal beast.”
Wu Jiu had a slight change in expression. If he was still at his peak, he could just kill this Nine Life Crystal Beast with a single breath, but now, he couldn’t even defeat it.
“Perfect, time to test my combat strength.”
Jiang Chen took a step forwards, then he suddenly unleashed the True Dragon Palm, which struck toward the crystal beast.
Roar!
The crystal beast let out a furious roar. With its gigantic hand shining like pure crystal, it forcefully slapped at the True Dragon Palm.
Bang!

The earth quaked, and the mountains shook. The gigantic Nine Life Crystal Beast was sent flying away by the massive True Dragon Palm’s force, and it broke quite a number of huge trees along its way before it was finally thrown onto the ground.
“Amazing!”

Wu Jiu praised. The way he looked at Jiang Chen had changed. With just his Early Divine Core cultivation base, Jiang Chen had actually just forced away a Late Divine Core crystal beast with just a single strike. Combat strength like this was simply astonishing.
“Aowuu!”
Being pushed away with just a single strike, the Nine Life Crystal Beast had become completely enraged. Once again, it crazily dashed toward Jiang Chen.
“A Late Divine Core crystal beast’s crystal core, I can’t let it go to waste.”
Jiang Chen’s lip curved upwards, a grin filled his face.

chapters.title: Chapter 239 - The Hunter Becomes the Hunted
paragraphs: Looking at the crystal beast dashing toward him, Jiang Chen’s didn’t hesitate to unleash another True Dragon Palm. The blood red dragon claw crashed into the crystal beast, once again sending it away.
“Buddy, don’t waste time, this monster has nine lives. If you keep attacking it like this, when are you going to kill it?”
Big Yellow said.
Fine.”

Jiang Chen moved his body, transforming into an elusive figure that appeared right in front of the crystal beast within the next second. Before it could climb back up from the ground, Jiang Chen had immediately chopped it in half with his battle axe. Of course, the True Dragon Palm was very powerful, but since this Nine Life Crystal Beast had an extra stronger body, especially this one since it was a Late Divine Core monster, it would take a few strikes before Jiang Chen could kill it. But what Big Yellow said was correct, the Nine Life Crystal Beast was different from those ordinary demons and devils, it had nine lives, and the method he was using now was too slow.
The Nine Life Crystal Beast who was chopped in half was restored in an instant. Once again, it leapt towards Jiang Chen and tried to attack.
Jiang Chen knew this was going to happen, as he had dealt with a lot of crystal beasts before, therefore he showed no signs of panicking.
Haha...

Jiang Chen was acting in an incomparably imposing manner, and while laughing out loud, he kept attacking with both True Dragon Palm and the battle axe in his hand. In just two minutes, he had killed the Late Divine Core crystal beast. A crystal core that looked like a pure crystal jumped into Jiang Chen’s hand.
“Good stuff, it would be nice if we could bump into more of these.”
Jiang Chen put away the crystal core while laughing.

“Brother Jiang, you’ve really widened my horizons! Ordinary Divine Core warriors, even the Late Divine Core ones, the scariest thing for them while travelling in Inferno Hell is bumping into Late Divine Core crystal beasts. But you, not only are not scared of them, but you’re actually hoping to bump into more! Your combat strength is unbelievable!”

Wu Jiu caressed his beard while speaking. Although he had witnessed how extraordinary Jiang Chen was, the method Jiang Chen used to kill the crystal beast still made him feel shocked. Jiang Chen was only an Early Divine Core warrior, and if he broke through to the mid, or even the Late Divine Core realm, it would be even more terrifying.
“Brother Jiu, let’s go, we need to reach Inferno City and find that hidden treasure as quickly as possible, so we can fight that Earth Devil.”
Jiang Chen said.
The trio flew at full speed within a mountain range, trying to reach Inferno City as quickly as possible.

Within the mountain range in front of them, a man was slowly walking around. The old man looked to be in his fifties, he had a fat body and a chubby face, and judging from the aura leaking from his body, he was obviously a Late Divine Core warrior.

The old fat man kept looked around, and he was unable to bear his boredom and said, “Damn it, after searching for so long, I haven’t even found a single trace of Jiang Chen. Don’t tell me that guy is dead, that would be too pitiful! He has such a massive wealth with him, it would be a big waste if he dies just like that.”

Just when the fat old man was feeling bored, three figures flew in from afar. When the fat old man looked into the direction, his eyes instantly lit up, as he saw young man in white clothes and a dog following him.

“Jiang Chen, wears white clothes, and is about 15-16 years old, and he has a handsome and delicate face. That guy matches the description of those men in the outer perimeter exactly! Also, a majestic big yellow dog following him! Haha, he isn’t death, I’ve struck gold; daddy is going to be rich!”

The fat old man excitedly burst into laughter, as if he had just seen the most precious treasure in this world. Just by looking at Jiang Chen and Big Yellow, he had become extremely excited. Therefore, he didn’t notice Wu Jiu who was flying next to Jiang Chen.

The description of Jiang Chen’s look and clothing had been widespread these last few days, and the most iconic description was of the big yellow dog who was following him. Therefore, this old man could instantly determine that the man and dog were Jiang Chen and Big Yellow, who had disappeared for two and a half months.
“Stop right there!”
The fat old man let out a loud shout, and with a move of his body, he appeared in front of Jiang Chen and Big Yellow.
“Get lost, don’t try to provoke me.”
Jiang Chen said in a cruel manner. He could sense foul intentions from the old man, so he wasn’t polite with him.
“Old man, move aside quickly, don’t delay this master dog’s journey.”
Big Yellow said in a threatening manner.

“Haha, Jiang Chen, you’ve really made me suffer by looking for you! I’ve spent two months searching for your trace, and I thought you were death! But, not only are you not dead, but you are now in front of me, this is perfect, this is a great fortune for me, Liu Peng! So many people are looking for you, but now, you’re in my grip!”
Liu Peng burst out into laughter. He completely considered Jiang Chen his prey, he was a hunter who had finally found the prey he had been hunting for.
“Oh? Why are you looking for me? Who else are searching for me?”

Jiang Chen asked with a frown on his face. His original intention was to just attack and get rid of this old man, but after hearing what the old man said, it looked like there were a lot of things that had happened during his disappearance. Many people were actually searching for him.

“Jiang Chen, don’t tell me you don’t know? The reason behind the chaotic state of Inferno Hell right now is all because of you! You robbed everyone in the outer perimeter of Inferno City, and those who lost all their belongings were forced to do anything they could in order to survive, and that caused a huge turmoil. Besides that, your behavior has attracted the attention of all powers and alliances in the middle area of Inferno City, many Late Divine Core warriors are looking for you, they want to kill you in order to defend the natural state of Inferno City. Jiang Chen, you are now in my hands, and this can be considered your fortune. As long as you hand all your belongings over to me, I’ll spare your life.”
Liu Peng loudly said.

Jiang Chen and Big Yellow looked at each other, both of them finally saw the light. It was them who had caused the chaotic situation in Inferno Hell to arise. As for why those Late Divine Core warriors form the middle area were hunting for him, the reason was pretty obvious, and this Liu Peng in front of them was a good example.
“Haha, defending the natural state of Inferno City? What a bullshit reason! Why don’t you just say you’re going after the wealth I got?”
Jiang Chen burst out into laughter. He had taken away all the wealth in the outer perimeter by force, there was no surprise that so many people were eyeing him right now.

“That’s right, the real motive is the enormous wealth you possess. Jiang Chen, don’t waste all your struggle so far, you are no match for me with your cultivation base, hurry up and hand over all your belongings, then I’ll spare your life.”
Liu Peng’s expression became stern, and spoke in a threatening manner.
Hearing this boring and threatening speech, Jiang Chen almost burst out into laughter. But when he turned to Big Yellow and Wu Jiu, he immediately saw the two were actually laughing.
“What are you guys laughing about?!”
Liu Peng shouted.
“We are laughing at you, idiot! You’re going to die, but you’re still trying to act like an overbearing man. Does your family members even know that you are here?
Big Yellow teased the old man while laughing, his saliva dripping all over the place.
“Old man, hand over all your belongings, then I’ll spare your life.”
Jiang Chen returned Liu Peng’s words back to him.
What? Is he robbing me?
Liu Peng was startled. He was here to rob Jiang Chen, but now his target had turned the tables, and was trying to rob him. Something must be wrong with their minds.
“I hope you can listen to what he said, hurry up and hand over all your belongings, perhaps you can still keep your life.”
Wu Jiu warned. He spoke with good intentions.
“Jiang Chen, I am rapidly losing my patience.”
Liu Peng became angry. Damn it! Who was the hunter, and who was being hunted?
“I’m losing my patience as well. I’ll count to three.”
After saying that, Jiang Chen began counting, “One, two, three.”
“You’re seeking death!”

Liu Peng was furious. He waved his hand and unleashed a rainbow colored energy attack, then he threw it toward Jiang Chen. He was a Late Divine Core warrior, and his initial plan was to scare his target and make him willingly hand over all his belongings. By doing this, he would be able to show off his mightiness as well. But, he never thought that the guy would actually turn the tables and try to rob him. This simply made him ashamed, and he couldn’t bear it any longer.
Hmph!

Jiang Chen let out a cold snort, then he extended his hand towards the sky. In an instant, the True Dragon Palm started crashing down from the sky, easily destroy the energy attack unleashed by Liu Peng.
Bang!
The gigantic dragon claw pressed down from the sky above like a huge mountain. It turned into a solid jail, trapping Liu Peng within.
“Break open for me!”
Liu Peng was shocked, and he struggle with all his strength. But too bad, his strength was far from enough to free him from the dragon claw, not to mention escaping from the attack.

“You’re just an old fool who has just broken through to the Late Divine Core realm, your combat strength can’t compare with those Nine Life Crystal Beasts. Trying to fight me is the same as seeking death.”
Jiang Chen said with an extremely cruel voice.

“Impossible, this can’t be happening, you’ve actually broken through to the Divine Core realm! But even if you really are a Divine Core warrior, there is now way you can be so strong! I am a Late Divine Core warrior, why am I not your match?”

Liu Peng was extreme terrified, this was a miserable outcome. He had spent two relentless months searching for Jiang Chen, but in the end, the hunter had become the hunted; the prey turned the table and became the hunter. What a ridiculous moment.
“Old fool, hurry up and hand over all your belongings, including all the clothes you’re wearing. This master dog is going to rob you cleanly!”
Big Yellow arrived in front Liu Peng and started showing off his mightiness.
Hearing that, Liu Peng almost threw up some blood because of anger. If he was robbed clean, even losing all his clothes, how was he going to live in the future?
“Jiang Chen, there is no hatred between us. I apologize for what I did just now, and I hope you can forgive my wrongdoing and spare my life. I, Liu Peng, promise I won’t challenge you in the future.”
Liu Peng looked at Jiang Chen and said, slowly.
“What a load of crap.”

Jiang Chen sneered. In an instant, he made the True Dragon Palm squeeze with tremendous force, crushing and Liu Peng and causing him to explode into a blood mist. He was killed on the spot. Then, Jiang Chen extended his hand and grabbed Liu Peng’s storage ring.
“I do not attack unless I am attacked. Those who try to attack me, they will die!”

A cruel expression filled Jiang Chen’s face. He had always used the most terrifying approaches when handling his enemy, never showing any mercy. Asking for forgiveness was useless, because Jiang Chen understood a fact; if he was weaker and was caught by his enemy, the outcome would be devastating.
“What a strong mind, killing someone without hesitation, this young man is going to be someone great in the future!”
Wu Jiu’s eyes lit up, and he inwardly praised Jiang Chen.
“Little Chen, since so many people from the middle area are hunting for you, there will be a lot of trouble if we return now.”
Big Yellow said.

“Since they consider me their prey, I’ll let them know who the real prey is. I have robbed the entire outer perimeter, and I don’t mind doing the same t the middle area. If I make it, I’m sure my wealth is going to be even bigger.”
A smile emerged on Jiang Chen’s face.

sentences.text: Looking at the crystal beast dashing toward him, Jiang Chen’s didn’t hesitate to unleash another True Dragon Palm.
The blood red dragon claw crashed into the crystal beast, once again sending it away.
“Buddy, don’t waste time, this monster has nine lives.
If you keep attacking it like this, when are you going to kill it?”
Big Yellow said.
Fine.”
Jiang Chen moved his body, transforming into an elusive figure that appeared right in front of the crystal beast within the next second.
Before it could climb back up from the ground, Jiang Chen had immediately chopped it in half with his battle axe.

Of course, the True Dragon Palm was very powerful, but since this Nine Life Crystal Beast had an extra stronger body, especially this one since it was a Late Divine Core monster, it would take a few strikes before Jiang Chen could kill it.
But what Big Yellow said was correct, the Nine Life Crystal Beast was different from those ordinary demons and devils, it had nine lives, and the method he was using now was too slow.
The Nine Life Crystal Beast who was chopped in half was restored in an instant.
Once again, it leapt towards Jiang Chen and tried to attack.
Jiang Chen knew this was going to happen, as he had dealt with a lot of crystal beasts before, therefore he showed no signs of panicking.
Haha...
Jiang Chen was acting in an incomparably imposing manner, and while laughing out loud, he kept attacking with both True Dragon Palm and the battle axe in his hand.
In just two minutes, he had killed the Late Divine Core crystal beast.
A crystal core that looked like a pure crystal jumped into Jiang Chen’s hand.
“Good stuff, it would be nice if we could bump into more of these.”
Jiang Chen put away the crystal core while laughing.
“Brother Jiang, you’ve really widened my horizons!
Ordinary Divine Core warriors, even the Late Divine Core ones, the scariest thing for them while travelling in Inferno Hell is bumping into Late Divine Core crystal beasts.
But you, not only are not scared of them, but you’re actually hoping to bump into more!
Your combat strength is unbelievable!”
Wu Jiu caressed his beard while speaking.
Although he had witnessed how extraordinary Jiang Chen was, the method Jiang Chen used to kill the crystal beast still made him feel shocked.
Jiang Chen was only an Early Divine Core warrior, and if he broke through to the mid, or even the Late Divine Core realm, it would be even more terrifying.
“Brother Jiu, let’s go, we need to reach Inferno City and find that hidden treasure as quickly as possible, so we can fight that Earth Devil.”
Jiang Chen said.
The trio flew at full speed within a mountain range, trying to reach Inferno City as quickly as possible.
Within the mountain range in front of them, a man was slowly walking around.
The old man looked to be in his fifties, he had a fat body and a chubby face, and judging from the aura leaking from his body, he was obviously a Late Divine Core warrior.
The old fat man kept looked around, and he was unable to bear his boredom and said, “Damn it, after searching for so long, I haven’t even found a single trace of Jiang Chen.
Don’t tell me that guy is dead, that would be too pitiful!
He has such a massive wealth with him, it would be a big waste if he dies just like that.”
Just when the fat old man was feeling bored, three figures flew in from afar.
When the fat old man looked into the direction, his eyes instantly lit up, as he saw young man in white clothes and a dog following him.
“Jiang Chen, wears white clothes, and is about 15-16 years old, and he has a handsome and delicate face.
That guy matches the description of those men in the outer perimeter exactly!
Also, a majestic big yellow dog following him!
Haha, he isn’t death, I’ve struck gold; daddy is going to be rich!”
The fat old man excitedly burst into laughter, as if he had just seen the most precious treasure in this world.
Just by looking at Jiang Chen and Big Yellow, he had become extremely excited.
Therefore, he didn’t notice Wu Jiu who was flying next to Jiang Chen.
The description of Jiang Chen’s look and clothing had been widespread these last few days, and the most iconic description was of the big yellow dog who was following him.
Therefore, this old man could instantly determine that the man and dog were Jiang Chen and Big Yellow, who had disappeared for two and a half months.
“Stop right there!”
The fat old man let out a loud shout, and with a move of his body, he appeared in front of Jiang Chen and Big Yellow.
“Get lost, don’t try to provoke me.”
Jiang Chen said in a cruel manner.
He could sense foul intentions from the old man, so he wasn’t polite with him.
“Old man, move aside quickly, don’t delay this master dog’s journey.”
Big Yellow said in a threatening manner.
“Haha, Jiang Chen, you’ve really made me suffer by looking for you!
I’ve spent two months searching for your trace, and I thought you were death!
But, not only are you not dead, but you are now in front of me, this is perfect, this is a great fortune for me, Liu Peng!
So many people are looking for you, but now, you’re in my grip!”
Liu Peng burst out into laughter.
He completely considered Jiang Chen his prey, he was a hunter who had finally found the prey he had been hunting for.
“Oh?
Why are you looking for me?
Who else are searching for me?”
Jiang Chen asked with a frown on his face.
His original intention was to just attack and get rid of this old man, but after hearing what the old man said, it looked like there were a lot of things that had happened during his disappearance.
Many people were actually searching for him.
“Jiang Chen, don’t tell me you don’t know?
The reason behind the chaotic state of Inferno Hell right now is all because of you!
You robbed everyone in the outer perimeter of Inferno City, and those who lost all their belongings were forced to do anything they could in order to survive, and that caused a huge turmoil.

Besides that, your behavior has attracted the attention of all powers and alliances in the middle area of Inferno City, many Late Divine Core warriors are looking for you, they want to kill you in order to defend the natural state of Inferno City.
Jiang Chen, you are now in my hands, and this can be considered your fortune.
As long as you hand all your belongings over to me, I’ll spare your life.”
Liu Peng loudly said.
Jiang Chen and Big Yellow looked at each other, both of them finally saw the light.
It was them who had caused the chaotic situation in Inferno Hell to arise.
As for why those Late Divine Core warriors form the middle area were hunting for him, the reason was pretty obvious, and this Liu Peng in front of them was a good example.
“Haha, defending the natural state of Inferno City?
What a bullshit reason!
Why don’t you just say you’re going after the wealth I got?”
Jiang Chen burst out into laughter.
He had taken away all the wealth in the outer perimeter by force, there was no surprise that so many people were eyeing him right now.
“That’s right, the real motive is the enormous wealth you possess.
Jiang Chen, don’t waste all your struggle so far, you are no match for me with your cultivation base, hurry up and hand over all your belongings, then I’ll spare your life.”
Liu Peng’s expression became stern, and spoke in a threatening manner.
Hearing this boring and threatening speech, Jiang Chen almost burst out into laughter.
But when he turned to Big Yellow and Wu Jiu, he immediately saw the two were actually laughing.
“What are you guys laughing about?!”
Liu Peng shouted.
“We are laughing at you, idiot!
You’re going to die, but you’re still trying to act like an overbearing man.
Does your family members even know that you are here?
Big Yellow teased the old man while laughing, his saliva dripping all over the place.
“Old man, hand over all your belongings, then I’ll spare your life.”
Jiang Chen returned Liu Peng’s words back to him.
What?
Is he robbing me?
Liu Peng was startled.
He was here to rob Jiang Chen, but now his target had turned the tables, and was trying to rob him.
Something must be wrong with their minds.
“I hope you can listen to what he said, hurry up and hand over all your belongings, perhaps you can still keep your life.”
Wu Jiu warned.
He spoke with good intentions.
“Jiang Chen, I am rapidly losing my patience.”

Damn it!
Who was the hunter, and who was being hunted?
“I’m losing my patience as well.
I’ll count to three.”
After saying that, Jiang Chen began counting, “One, two, three.”
“You’re seeking death!”

By doing this, he would be able to show off his mightiness as well.

This simply made him ashamed, and he couldn’t bear it any longer.
Hmph!
