I’m from the Shangguan family, you can’t kill me.”
Shangguan Wei had no choice but to bet on his background, he wanted to make Jiang Chen feel afraid, and then let him go.
“Shangguan family.”
Jiang Chen still smiled faintly.
He didn’t slow down, he just kept walking firmly toward Shangguan Wei, as if he was an emperor going to sentence a criminal.
“Do you guys think Jiang Chen will really kill Shangguan Wei?
He is an elder from the Shangguan family, and the family is a massive power in the Jian Province, an existence that even the Martial Saint Dynasty has to take seriously.
I know they have quite a number of Combat Soul warriors.”
“Although this Shangguan Wei isn’t someone important in the Shangguan family, but if he is killed by some outsider, I’m sure the Shangguan family will be provoked.
This had something to do with their dignity, and they won’t allow any outsider to challenge it.
My guess is, Jiang Chen won’t kill him.”
“It’s hard to tell, Jiang Chen has already killed so many men, and all of them were from different powers in the Eastern Continent.
It could be said that he has provoked countless powers, both big and small.
This man is extremely brutal and ruthless, he never shows his enemies any mercy.
And don’t forget, he also killed Yang Shuo from the Myriad Sword Sect.”
Everyone viewed the scene with anticipation, they really wanted to know whether or not Jiang Chen would kill Shangguan Wei.
Since Shangguan Wei wasn’t an outsider, killing him was equal to challenging the dignity of the Shangguan family.
If he was killed by an outsider, the family would definitely find out how and why he died.
Jiang Chen showed all the spectators his decision with his action.
He waved his hand and unleashed the True Dragon Palm, and in an instant, the blood red dragon claw completely covered Shangguan Wei.
Although Shangguan Wei was a peak Divine Core warrior, since he was seriously injured, there was no way he could resist Jiang Chen’s attack.
He was trapped by the True Dragon Palm, and he couldn’t move at all.
“Jiang Chen, you really want to kill me?”
Shangguan Wei could feel the cold killing intent, and he immediately let out a loud scream.
“You were determined to kill me and take over all my wealth, that’s why I can’t let you go.
It’s better for your family not to challenge me, because if they do, it will be the Shangguan family’s greatest misfortune.
Now, die.”
Like an angel of death, Jiang Chen squeezed the dragon claw with a tremendous amount of force, causing bone cracking sounds to come from Shangguan Wei’s body, and blood to burst out from his mouth.
“Oh heavens!
He really is going to kill Shangguan Wei!”
“Is he really not afraid of the Shangguan family taking revenge?”
Many people were instantly shocked.
Jiang Chen was like a mighty demon lord, and there was nothing that could cause him to feel fear.
“Stop right there!”
Right at this moment, a loud shout sounded out from within Inferno City.
After that, a ghostly figure suddenly appeared in the sky.
It was a man who looked to be in his forties, and he wore a bronze colored robe.
From his expression, one could tell he was an overbearing man.
He had a pair of bright eyes, like an eagle, causing anyone who looked into his eyes to feel fear from the bottom of their heart.
The middle-aged man had his gray hair tied up in a bun, and he moved in a ruthless manner.
He was actually a Combat Soul warrior.
“He is the Combat Soul warrior in the center of Inferno City, I’ve always heard about him, and he is finally here.”
“So that’s him.
I heard he has been staying in Inferno City for many years, but I have never seen him shown himself.”
The arrival of the Combat Soul warrior caused the situation to become even tenser.
When the depressed Shangguan Wei saw the arrival of this Combat Soul warrior, he immediately shouted for help, “Senior, please save me!”
Jiang Chen’s face darkened.
The once thing he didn’t wish for to happen after returning to Inferno City was developing an offensive relationship with this Combat Soul warrior.
Because, in order to hunt for the treasure in the center of Inferno City, he needed to maintain a good relationship with this man.
But Jiang Chen really hates it when someone tries to threaten him, and this Shangguan Wei was someone he must kill.
“I asked you to stop, can’t you hear me?”
The middle-aged man sounded angry.
He had unleashed his aura, and he was getting ready to pressure Jiang Chen.
“Xuan Ye.”
Right at this moment, a deep voice sounded out from the scene.
Hearing someone calling his name, the middle-aged man had a change in expression, and he immediately turned toward the source.
When he saw Wu Jiu, his mouth opened widely with shock, and in the next second, an extreme joyful expression emerged on his face.
Swoosh!
The middle-aged man moved and arrived in front of Wu Jiu in an instant.
He didn’t even care about Shangguan Wei and Jiang Chen anymore.
“Jiu...
Lord Jiu!”
When Xuan Ye shouted out the first word, he saw Wu Jiu signaling him with his eyes.
He immediately changed the way he was going to address Wu Jiu.
“Xuan Ye, I never thought I’d see you here.”
Wu Jiu said with a smile, he too felt happy when seeing the middle aged man.
This was his most loyal servant, and it had been ten years since they last saw each other.
Of course he would feel joyful when seeing a familiar man.
“Lord Jiu, it has been ten years!
Finally, I’ve found you!
Xuan Ye came to Inferno Hell seven years ago, and I’ve traveled all over the place, but I just couldn’t find any traces of Lord Jiu!”
Xuan Ye bowed deeply toward Wu Jiu.
His eyes turned red, and he was almost in tears.
It had been seven years, and the main reason why he came to Inferno Hell was to find Wu Jiu.
Just as he had almost given up, he had finally found Wu Jiu.
“Oh heavens, who is that old man?
Even a Combat Soul warrior has to bow to him!”
“Where did he come from?
I think he’s with Jiang Chen...
Now, no one can save Shangguan Wei anymore.”
Everyone were shocked.
They were all trying to guess who this Wu Jiu was, and why a Combat Soul warriors was bowing to him.
Guan Yiyun and Tian Yishan’s mouths were wide open with shock, and their faces carried expressions of disbelief.
It looked like Wu Jiu letting them address him as Lord Jiu was actually a great honor, as even a Combat Soul warrior had to address him as Lord Jiu, let alone other people.
Jiang Chen felt relaxed now.
He had long ago guessed that Wu Jiu came from an extraordinary background, but now it seemed more incredible than what he had expected.
It looks like his decision to save Wu Jiu was spot on.
Without Wu Jiu, he wouldn’t be able to find the Earth Devil’s location, and he would have to fight this Combat Soul warrior.
Shangguan Wei had completely lost all hope.
He thought his savior was here, and he could finally keep his life.
But now, his savior had switched side and become his enemy.

chapters.title: Chapter 245 - Duan Jianhong’s Stratagem
paragraphs: “Lord Jiu, what happened to your cultivation?”
When Xuan Ye sensed Wu Jiu’s cultivation, his expression immediately changed.

“Don’t worry, my cultivation will recover in time. I was trapped in an isolated space for ten years, and when I was about to die, brother Jiang Chen saved my life. Without him, I would now be a dead body.”
Wu Jiu said.
“I see. Luckily, Lord Jiu is alright. I really have to thank brother Jiang!”

Hearing what Wu Jiu said, Xuan Ye’s attitude toward Jiang Chen immediately changed. Since Jiang Chen was Wu Jiu’s savior, that man he was also Xuan Ye’s savoir. Because in Xuan Ye’s mind, Wu Jiu’s life was hundreds of times more precious than his own.
Now, Shangguan Wei had offended Jiang Chen. If Jiang Chen didn’t kill him, Xuan Ye would kill Shangguan Wei instead.
“Senior, please save me!”

Shangguan Wei’s face had become red, and he kept shouting at Xuan Ye with a shrill voice. His voice had become hoarse become of the screaming. The gigantic dragon claw was crushing him like a gigantic mountain, and it was coming from all directions.
“Shangguan Wei, since you have made a mistake, you’ll have to bear the consequences yourself. It’s up to brother Jiang to decide what to do with you, I’m not involved in this matter.”
Xuan Ye said in a stiff manner. However, his words were like a death sentence for Shangguan Wei.
Ahh!!

Just as Xuan Ye finished his words, Shangguan Wei immediately let out a mournful blood-curdling screech. He had been killed by the True Dragon Palm in a miserable way. At this point of time, over 20 Late Divine Core warriors had died, and the entire scene was filled with pungent smell of blood. Broken limbs and dead bodies were scattered all over the place; it was a bloody and cruel scene.

What happened today would definitely be remembered by everyone at the scene. Jiang Chen’s ferocious reputation would also be heard by generation to come. Compared to those wild demons and devils, Jiang Chen was the true bloodthirsty demon lord.
The death of all these Late Divine Core warriors didn’t mean the end of this battle. After Jiang Chen killed Shangguan Wei, he turned his sight to the nearly 20 remaining Mid Divine Core warriors.

The expressions of these men changed dramatically; their faces paled in an instant, and some were even trembling because of fear. Just a look from Jiang Chen had caused to them to see the gates leading to hell.
“Lord Jiu, he has killed a lot of men, and if we let him continue, more than half the warriors in Inferno City will have been killed by him.”

Xuan Ye whispered to Wu Jiu. He had stayed in Inferno City for seven years, and although there were constant conflicts and fights, making it seem like human lives were worthless in this place; slaughtering so many people along, like Jiang Chen did, it was the first time something like this had ever happened in Inferno City.
“So what? They deserve it.”
Wu Jiu stared blankly at Xuan Ye.
“Understood.”
Xuan Ye immediately bowed toward Wu Jiu; he dared not neglect Wu Jiu’s words. In the entire Martial Saint Dynasty, there weren’t really anyone who dared neglect Wu Jiu’s words.
“Chief Jiang, please spare my life, I’m willing to hand over all my belongings!”
“Me too! I was blind to offend chief Jiang, I hope chief Jiang can forgive me and let me go! I’ll give you all my belongings!”
“Right, we will hand over everything we got, we won’t even leave behind a single pill, it will all belong to chief Jiang!”

There were few who truly didn’t fear death. The more fiendish a man was, the more scared of death he was. When the shadow of death was cast above the head, whatever wealth a man possessed become worthless, and the most important thing was to keep living. There was always an opportunity to find more wealth, but a man only lived once, and once life ended, it was completely gone.
“Hand over all your belongings, then each of you cut off one arm.”
Jiang Chen said with an indifferent tone.
“What?! Cut off my arm?”
Someone exclaimed. But, his ending was similar to that of the previous man. Right as his words left his mouth, he was slashed in half by a single sword strike.

“I do not show mercy upon those who have tried to kill me. Asking for one arm is the lightest punishment I can bestow upon you. I’ll count to three, those who are not willing to do it, die. Don’t think I’m joking, none of you are qualified for my jokes.”
Jiang Chen gazed at all the men from left to right. His gaze was like razor sharp edge scratching their faces, causing the fear in their minds to increase.
“Damn it, I’ll do it, it’s just one arm; it is worth less than my life!”

Many men made up their minds. With combat weapon in hand, they cut off one of their arms while gritting their teeth. No one thought Jiang Chen was joking, he was not someone who joked a lot. So many Late Divine Core warriors were killed by him, even Shangguan Wei was killed by him. If Jiang Chen wanted to kill them, it wouldn’t take him too much effort.

Before Jiang Chen started counting, all the men sliced off their own arm. After that, they handed all their belongings over to Jiang Chen in a respectful manner, including the combat weapon in their hands.

For these Mid Divine Core warriors, losing an arm wasn’t really a serious injury. If they could obtain good treatment in time, although they still wouldn’t be able to get their arms back; losing an arm wouldn’t really affect their cultivation.

Jiang Chen took all the storage rings and combat weapons, then he stored it all in his storage ring. At the same time, Big Yellow came up to Jiang Chen while bouncing around excitedly, then he handed all his harvest over to Jiang Chen.

“Kaka, buddy, we’re rich now! The wealth we obtained in the outer perimeter can’t compare with what these men possessed! Buddy, you’re an enormous treasure vault right now, in the future, when daddy wants to eat natural essences, you’ll have to give me!”
Big Yellow said as his tail wagged back and forth.
“No problem.”
Jiang Chen patted the dog’s head. As long as he had it, he would give Big Yellow anything he wanted without hesitation.
After that, Jiang Chen and Big Yellow turned around and went to Wu Jiu.
“Chief Jiang, you’re such a mighty man!”

Wang Heng stared at Jiang Chen while blinking his eyes; he absolutely worshipped Jiang Chen. Even Guan Yiyun and Tian Yishan worshiped him. The gap between them and Jiang Chen was not small. As haughty men, if they could accomplish what Jiang Chen had, that would be enough glory for a lifetime to them.
“Brother Jiang, thank you for saving Lord Jiu’s life! Please accept my gratitude.”
Xuan Ye cupped his fist toward Jiang Chen and bowed deeply.

Looking at this, Jiang Chen immediately extended his hand and stopped Xuan Ye from bowing, “Brother Xuan, no need to be so polite. I felt like I was meeting an old friend when I first saw brother Jiu, of course I would save my old friend.”

Jiang Chen was being polite while talking to Xuan Ye. Firstly, Xuan Ye was Wu Jiu’s friend, and that also meant he was one of them. Secondly, Xuan Ye had stayed in Inferno City for seven years, he was surely familiar with everything here, and he might be able to provide great help with hunting for the treasure. He could perhaps even help later on when fighting the Earth Devil. Xuan Ye was after all a Combat Soul warrior.
“Brother Jiang, let me introduce, Xuan Ye is my friend. All these years, he has willingly stayed in the harsh Inferno Hell, just because he was searching for me.”
Wu Jiu said as he patted Xuan Ye’s shoulder. He felt glad because of Xuan Ye’s loyalty.
“It is really good for brother Jiu to have such a good friend.”

Jiang Chen praised. A man willing to stay in this harsh environment just because he wanted to searching for his friend, just the determination and purpose alone was enough to deserve respect from everyone.
“Alright, brother Jiang, we should continue our business.”
Wu Jiu said.
“Lord Jiu, what business do you have?”
Xuan Ye asked.
“Let’s go, we’ll talk in the center of Inferno City.”
Jiang Chen said.
“Fine, please follow me.”

Xuan Ye turned around and started flying toward Inferno City. Jiang Chen, Wu Jiu and the rest of them followed closely behind. It had been seven years, and Xuan Ye could basically be considered the master of Inferno City. He would walk around in the city like it was his own backyard.
Qi Province, Heavenly Sword Sect!

Within a grand palace located in the heart of the Heavenly Sword Sect, a couple of men were sitting on both sides of a hall, and a middle-aged man was sitting in a grand chair right in front of everyone. The man was quite fat, and he had a greasy face, giving everyone an impression that he was on a hefty diet. But, he had a pair of bright eyes that caused anyone who stared into them to lose themselves, as well as a natural dignity and a face that portrayed great power.

This man was the Heavenly Sword Sect’s Sect Chief, Duan Jianhong. Right now, a gloomy and heavy hearted expression could be seen on his face. All these men were the Divine Core Sect Elders of the Heavenly Sword Sect, and they too had worried expressions.
“Hmph! This is going too far, who does that Nanbei Chao think he is? Who gave him the audacity to ask us to submit to him in three days; what a joke!”
One of the Sect Elders let out a cold snort.
“That Nanbei Chao has merely broken through to the Mid Divine Core realm, but it has caused him to become so presumptuous, this is ridiculous!”
“You’re right! No matter how much of a genius he is, he’s still only a Mid Divine Core warrior, he’s no match for Sect Chief!”

All Sect Elders were burning with rage. No matter what, the Heavenly Sword Sect was one of the biggest sects in the Qi Province, and now, someone had placed a knife on their throat. Of course they wouldn’t accept it.
“Sect Chief, what should we do?”
Everyone looked at Duan Jianhong.
“Don’t underestimate Nanbei Chao, he is a man with great talent, and he’s a peerless genius. Since he has the courage to make such an arrogant statement, I’m sure he has some powerful approaches.”
Duan Jianhong squinted his eyes and said indifferently. A look of intelligence could be seen in his eyes.
“So, what does Sect Chief want us to do?”
Someone asked.
“What I want is simple, we’ll surrender to Nanbei Chao.”
Duan Jianhong said.
“What? Surrender? Sect Chief, Nanbei Chao is merely a Mid Divine Core warrior who has just broken through, I don’t think he’s that strong, so why should we surrender?”
“I agree! No matter what, the Heavenly Sword Sect is one of the biggest sects in the Qi Province, we can’t surrender just like that.”
None of the Sect Elders agreed with the decision. Surrendering even before the fighting began? This was just hopelessly stupid!
“You guys know nothing; a little impatience spoils great plans. Do you think I am a man who is willing to surrender? Can’t you guys just use your brains?”
Duan Jianhong gazed at all the Sect Elders.
“Does Sect Chief have a strategy?”
Someone asked.

“Of course! Nanbei Chao and Zhao Chongyang are trying to rule the entire Qi Province. I, Duan Jianhong want to rule the entire Qi Province as well. Amongst all four big sects, with the exception of the Valley of Happiness, all of us have the same dream, but we haven’t had the opportunity to accomplish this. Now, a perfect opportunity has presented itself to us, the Heavenly Sword Sect is going to rule the entire Qi Province!”
A grin emerged on Duan Jianhong’s face.
“Sect Chief, please enlighten us.”
A Sect Elder said.

“I told you before; since Nanbei Chao has the courage to ask us to submit to him, I’m sure he has a strategy. But, it’s just like you said, none of the four big sects in the Qi Province is an easy target. Therefore, I’ll pretend to surrender to the Burning Sky Pavilion, and with this, we’ll be able to preserve our full strength. With Nanbei Chao and Zhao Chongyang’s character, I’m sure they will attack the Black Sect and Valley of Happiness. At that point of time, we’ll be able to witness Nanbei Chao’s strategy and approaches. Their battle will certainly cause damage to all parties, and that will be the perfect time for the Heavenly Sword Sect to reap the harvest!”
Duan Jianhong’s eyes blinking. He was a brilliant man who had the ability to give thorough thought on anything he was going to do.

A grin emerged on Duan Jianhong’s face.
“Sect Chief, please enlighten us.”
A Sect Elder said.
“I told you before; since Nanbei Chao has the courage to ask us to submit to him, I’m sure he has a strategy.
But, it’s just like you said, none of the four big sects in the Qi Province is an easy target.
Therefore, I’ll pretend to surrender to the Burning Sky Pavilion, and with this, we’ll be able to preserve our full strength.
With Nanbei Chao and Zhao Chongyang’s character, I’m sure they will attack the Black Sect and Valley of Happiness.
At that point of time, we’ll be able to witness Nanbei Chao’s strategy and approaches.
Their battle will certainly cause damage to all parties, and that will be the perfect time for the Heavenly Sword Sect to reap the harvest!”
Duan Jianhong’s eyes blinking.
He was a brilliant man who had the ability to give thorough thought on anything he was going to do.

Chapter 246 - Blood Red Dragon Statue on the Ancient Stone Door

This was Duan Jianhong’s wishful plan. In his opinion, Nanbei Chao’s threat toward the Heavenly Sword Sect was actually the perfect opportunity for the Heavenly Sword Sect to rule the entire Qi Province.
“Sect Chief, if we really surrender to Nanbei Chao, the Heavenly Sword Sect’s reputation is going to be greatly affected.”
One of the noble Sect Elders said.

“Reputation? This is a world where absolute powers rules; the winner gets to write the history! As long as we come out victorious to rule the entire Qi Province, who will care about what happened before? At that moment, we will be the only power in the Qi Province, and we might even get the Martial Saint Dynasty’s attention!”
Duan Jianhong’s eyes were flickering with intelligence.

“What Sect Chief said is right, this is the perfect opportunity for the Heavenly Sword Sect, and if we miss it, we won’t have the same opportunity again. All of the four big sects are very powerful, and in order to destroy one sect, the opponent will have to pay a heavy price, allowing yet another sect to sweep in and harvest the fruits of labor. Therefore, no one really dares initiate a war, and this is the reason why the Qi Province has always maintained the same structured. But now, Nanbei Chao is going to break this structure, and rule the entire Qi Province. This is definitely a tough mission. If Nanbei Chao, the Burning Sky Pavilion, the Black Sect, and the Valley of Happiness are all weakened by the war, the Heavenly Sword Sect will be the biggest winner. Therefore, surrendering to Nanbei Chao and the Burning Sky Pavilion is actually a really good choice right now.”
Someone said. He really admired Duan Jianhong’s strategy.
“In that case, although the Heavenly Sword Sect’s reputation will be affected, this is indeed a rare opportunity for us.”

Many people nodded their heads. They agreed that Duan Jianhong’s strategy made sense. With this, not only could they preserve their strength, it would also create a once in a lifetime opportunity for them. Most importantly, the Heavenly Sword Sect couldn’t be the first one to fight the Burning Sky Pavilion, because if they did, the Black Sect would benefit the most.
“But, if the Black Sect and Valley of Happiness also decide to surrender to Nanbei Chao, our plan won’t work.”
A Sect Elder worriedly said.

“You don’t have to worry about that. I know Daoist Black’s character really well, he is a stubborn man, and he would rather fight than surrender to Nanbei Chao. There is absolutely no way Daoist Black will surrender to Nanbei Chao and the Burning Sky Pavilion, there will definitely be a war between them. As for the Valley of Happiness, they all carry evil influences, so you can actually call them an evil clan. Their Chief, Granny Feng is a person with a unique and independent character, she would never let anyone restrict her. Therefore, the Valley of Happiness won’t surrender either. After we surrender, Granny Feng and Daoist Black will look down on me from the bottom of their hearts, but that’s nothing. I, Duan Jianhong am a man who will achieve big things, I won’t be bothered by these personal opinions.”

Duan Jianhong said with a grin. His intelligence was higher than his height, he had a clear view on the overall situation of the Qi Province, as well as a detailed understanding of his enemies. A man like him would definitely live longer than anyone else.
In the center of Inferno City, there stood a tall black palace. Layers of fog hovered around the palace, giving it a sense of ancientness. Under Xuan Ye’s lead, the few men entered the palace.

“This is the center of Inferno City, but within a hundred mile radius, no one except me can come here with ease unless I’m hosting a trading event. But, since all the warriors in Inferno City have been robbed by brother Jiang, I don’t think it’s necessary to host a trading event any more...”
Xuan Ye said with a smile on his face. He had now finally found Wu Jiu; 7 years of relentless searching had finally come to a happy end. He couldn’t help but feel happy and relaxed.
“Let’s get back to topic. Xuan Ye, do you know about any treasures that exist in the center of Inferno City?”
Wu Jiu asked.

“I’m sure there is a treasure here, and it’s restraining those demons and devils. If not, Inferno City would long ago have been destroyed. However, I haven’t found it in these seven years I’ve been here.”
Xuan Ye said as he furrowed his brows.
“The treasure is hidden within this palace, I can sense it now.”
Big Yellow said as his ears stood up.

Wu Jiu and Xuan Ye threw their eyes toward Big Yellow at the same time. Both of them were surprised. Although this dog seemed pretty amazing, he was only an Early Divine Core demon beast. A treasure that even they, Combat Soul warriors couldn’t sense... how could Big Yellow sense it?

“Big Yellow has a special treasure hunting ability. The more precious a treasure is, the clearer he is able to sense it. Since he sensed it just now, I’m sure the treasure is hidden somewhere within this palace.
Jiang Chen’s eyes lit up. His purpose when coming here was mainly to find this treasure. Only with the treasure could he possibly defeat the Earth Devil.
“Big Yellow, can you sense exactly where the treasure is located?”
Jiang Chen looked at Big Yellow and asked.
“The treasure’s aura is pretty weak, let me try again.”

After saying that, Big Yellow closed his eyes. All the men held their breath, and dared not speak a word. After three minutes, Big Yellow suddenly opened his eyes, then he turned around and gazed at the inner part of the palace.
“There it is.”
Under Big Yellow’s lead, everyone walked in the direction he looked, then they came in front of a wall that seemed ordinary.
“This is just a normal wall, there is nothing special about it.”
Guan Yiyun said.
“Little Chen, scrape the outer layer stone.”
Big Yellow said.
Jiang Chen drew out the Bloodthirsty Sword, and with a swing he scraped away the surface of the wall, revealing an ancient stone door.
“There is a hidden door behind the wall! How come I never discovered this?”
The surprised Xuan Ye stared at the wall with wide eyes.

Jiang Chen squinted his eyes. It was perfectly normal that Xuan Ye didn’t discover this. It would be amazing if could discover it. The door was hidden behind a wall, and even he, the once greatest Saint in the world wouldn’t pay any attention to a wall. Only Big Yellow who had sensitive senses toward treasure could find it.
“There’s a carving on the stone door, it looks like a dragon.”
Tian Yishan said.

All the men looked at the stone door; there was a blood red dragon statue carved on the door. It was a mighty dragon statue. Although it was unknown when this dragon had been carved, it still gave these men a feeling that it was a live. The blood red dragon’s body was leaned forwards, and its mouth was wide open, as if it was letting out a furious roar towards the heavens.
The blood red dragon’s posture was overbearing and prideful, as if it was the only supreme existence in the world.

“The legendary True Dragon, they only exist in the higher realms. The dragon is just a legendary creature in the Saint Origin realm. Rumors say that in ancient times, a powerful flood dragon cultivated into a true dragon, but that’s just a myth.”

Wu Jiu said. None of these men could hold themselves from looking at Jiang Chen. All of them had witnessed Jiang Chen unleash the True Dragon Palm; the dragon claw he unleashed look real and mystical.
“Why is there a carving of a true dragon here?”
Big Yellow was puzzled. He possessed the Dragon Horse bloodline that had been passed down since the ancient era, and he had dragon’s essence in his body.
“Let’s not focus on that for now. The treasure should be behind this stone door, let’s open it up.”
Wu Jiu said.
“Let me do it.”
Guan Yiyun took a step forward, then he placed both hands on the stone door and pushed with all his strength. But, nothing seemed to happen.
“This stone door is really heavy, I can’t push it open with my raw strength. Looks like I have to use my yuan energy.”

A terrified expression emerged onto Guan Yiyun’s face. In an instant, he circulated his yuan energy to his palm, causing the palm to start emitting a bright light. After that, with a tremendous amount of force, he pushed toward the stone door.
Crack crack!

Finally, cracking sound could be heard from the stone door that hadn’t been opened for an unknown amount of years. But, with Guan Yiyun’s strength, he could only make the door produce some cracking sounds. Just as he was going to continue pushing, beams of blood red light suddenly shot out from behind the stone door.
Bang! Ahh!
Guan Yiyun let out a miserable cry as he was suddenly knocked back. With sharp eyes and quick movement, Jiang Chen immediately pulled Guan Yiyun back.
Puh!
A mouthful of blood left Guan Yiyun’s mouth, and his body was trembling.
“What a powerful red light!”
Guan Yiyun said in shock.
“Looks like the treasure is hidden behind this stone door, let me give it a try.”

Xuan Ye took a step forward and arrived in front of the stone door. Everyone back off and cleared the area for him. A serious expression emerged on their faces; this stone door was really mystical, it could attack by itself, and even a Divine Core warrior couldn’t open it.
Ha!
Xuan Ye let out a loud shout, then he pushed his bright golden palm onto the stone door.
Bang...
Xuan Ye’s strength kept coming from his body in a spectacular manner. It was not something Guan Yiyun could compare with. But, in the next second, more blood red lights shot out from the stone door.
Bang!
Just like Guan Yiyun, the powerful Xuan Ye was knocked back by the blood red light as well. His body was slammed into the opposite wall, and blood could be seen dripping down from his lips.
“Terrifying! If I had reacted a little bit slower, perhaps I would have suffered from a deadly injury just now!”

Xuan Ye showed a frightened expression. The blood red lights were like the most ferocious wild beasts; they attacked with mighty momentum, and even a Combat Soul warrior couldn’t withstand the attack.
“How can this happen?”
Wu Jiu furrowed his brows.
“Even a Combat Soul warrior can’t open this stone door. This means there is no way we can get hold of the treasure behind it.”
Tian Yishan was extremely shocked.
“This is terrible! What’s actually hidden behind the door? Even a Combat Soul warrior can’t touch, no wonder why no monsters dare come close to Inferno City.”
“What should we do now?”
All of them had ghastly expressions. Jiang Chen was also furrowing his brows. He didn’t think this was the situation they were going to face.
“I too have no idea how to open this stone door.”
Big Yellow shook his head. Although he could sense the existence of the treasure, he had no idea how to actually open the door.
Buzz buzz!

Right at this moment, buzzing sounds could be heard from the stone door. After that, beams of blood red light shot out from the blood red dragon statue. The scene frightened everyone, and they all fell back quickly. However, Jiang Chen wasn’t moving.
The blood red light’s target wasn’t them, it was Jiang Chen. When the blood red lights came out, they directly covered Jiang Chen, but they didn’t show any sign of attacking him.
“Look, those blood red lights didn’t hurt chief Jiang!”
Wang Heng exclaimed.
“Those blood red lights are really powerful, but why didn’t they hurt brother Jiang? This is unbelievable!”
Xuan Ye was astounded with eyes wide open.

“All the treasure that have sentience can only be obtained by those who were born with great destiny. Brother Jiang is a man with a great destiny, so I guess only brother Jiang can open this stone door.”
Wu Jiu said. The blood red lights didn’t hurt Jiang Chen, and that was the best proof for his explanation.

chapters.title: Chapter 247 - Mysterious Blood Talisman
paragraphs: Wu Jiu, Xuan Ye and all the other people were stunned. They kept staring at Jiang Chen who was covered by the blood red lights. They couldn’t believe what they were looking at, especially Xuan Ye and Guan Yiyun. Both of them were assaulted by these blood red lights, and they knew how terrifying it was. But, Jiang Chen seemed like he was unharmed, even though he was completely covered by them.
“The blood red light has accepted Little Chen!”
Big Yellow’s eyes lit up.

Right at this moment, Jiang Chen was completely covered by the blood red lights. Not only did he feel no fear or threat, he felt like he was showering in the warmest sunlight; it was extremely comfortable. The blood red lights were gently rubbing themselves on his body, expressing their intimacy with Jiang Chen.

“It looks like these blood red lights have sentience, but why do they show their intimacy to me? I’ve never seen anything like this before, and it’s also the first time I’ve seen that blood red dragon carving on the stone door.”

Jiang Chen was surprised, he never thought that this could happen. After seeing how Xuan Ye and Guan Yiyun were injured by these blood red lights, he thought he wouldn’t be able to get the treasure anymore. He had never thought that these blood red lights would come to him by themselves.
“Regardless of why this is happening, I’ll have to go behind the stone door and get the treasure, then I’ll use it to deal with the Earth Devil.”
Jiang Chen had the ability to remain calm under any emergency. And since the blood red lights didn’t harm him, it was actually good news.

“Buddy, try and push the stone door and see if you can open it. Those blood red lights have accepted you; that means only you can open the stone door. If you fail, we’ll never be able to get the treasure behind the door.
Big Yellow said.
“Alright.”

Jiang Chen nodded his head. Walking with big steps, he arrived in front of the stone door. He slowly extended both hands and place them on the door, then he started pushing with tremendous force. However, the door was still not moving, and there were more blood red lights shooting out from. Although the lights didn’t attacked him, and showed the same intimacy as before, they still showed no sign of moving aside and letting the door open.
“Since these blood red lights have accepted me, why can I still not open the door? I’ll try with my yuan energy.”

After that, Jiang Chen began circulating the Dragon Transformation skill. Just as he began to circulate it in order to open the door, clicking sounds immediately from the stone door. It had opened up by itself. At the same time, the blood red lights were wildly bouncing around, as if they were filled with joy and excitement.
“Look, the stone door is slowly opening, chief Jiang isn’t being attacked by those blood red lights!”
Wang Heng said in a surprised manner.
Pop!

The stone door was completely opened, and a deep popping sound could be heard after. Then, countless dazzling blood red lights shot out from behind the door. They were so bright that everyone were forced to close their eyes.

Finally, everyone opened their eyes when the lights started dimming down. They immediately looked at the scene behind the stone door. It was a completely sealed secret chamber, and there was nothing there except for a blood red talisman hovering in the center. Aside from the talisman, nothing else could be found. All those blood red lights were actually unleashed by this blood red talisman.
“Look, it’s a blood talisman!”
Guan Yiyun said.
Buzz...

The mysterious blood talisman was hovering in middle of the air, and it kept producing buzzing sounds. At the same time, a divine and ancient aura was constantly leaking out from it. It was so dazzling that it was difficult to stare right at it. On the surface of this blood talisman, mysterious carved patterns could be seen, and even Jiang Chen couldn’t understand the meaning of these patterns.
“What is this blood talisman? I can actually feel that it’s sentient!”
Xuan Ye was really astonished by it.
“A supreme aura! It looks like this talisman represented something mighty, an existence even I can’t tell what is.”

Wu Jiu was shocked as well. It was just a talisman, but it had given them a rare feeling, as if they were looking at a supreme lord standing in front of them, and causing them to want to worship it from the bottom of their hearts.
“I don’t know why, but when looking at this blood talisman, my bloodline began fluctuating. I’m sure this blood talisman is the reason why those demons and devils haven’t dared attack Inferno City.”
Big Yellow kept staring at the blood talisman with bright eyes. He had a rarely seen serious expression on his face.

Jiang Chen took two steps forward and entered the secret chamber. He looked up at the blood talisman, then a puzzled look emerged in his eyes. For an unknown reason, he actually felt a brief kinship toward the blood talisman.

This was an absurd feeling. Past life and current life, Jiang Chen was pretty sure he had never seen this blood talisman before, and he had no relation with this blood talisman. However, the feeling of kinship came from his soul, it was an uncertain feeling that really existed.

Jiang Chen extended his hand, then, as if the blood talisman could sense Jiang Chen’s movement, it jumped into his palm by itself. The palm-sized blood talisman was violently pulsating as it fell into Jiang Chen’s palm. Jiang Chen could clearly feel the blood talisman’s excitement. This was just a talisman, not a living creature, but it actually had its own mind.

When Jiang Chen stroked the blood talisman, his Dragon Transformation skill began circulating without his control. Jiang Chen was startled by this change. Ever since he had begun cultivating this skill, this was the first time something like this had happened. It was just a skill, but why was it circulating itself without its master’s control? This was bizarre!

As the Dragon Transformation’s skill circulation became faster and faster, the intimate feeling between the blood talisman and Jiang Chen’s soul was getting stronger and stronger, giving Jiang Chen a feeling that he and this blood talisman was actually just one entity.
“What’s happening? Why do I have such a strong feeling of kinship toward it? Perhaps this blood talisman is related to the Dragon Transformation skill?”

Jiang Chen was truly shocked. Even with his strong mind, he still felt that this was really crazing. He had lived two lives, and was once the greatest Saint in the world. He had gone through death and come back to life; his experiences had given him a strong mind that no one else could compare with. However, what was happening right now had once again distracted his soul.
“Little Chen, just what is this blood talisman actually?”
Big Yellow asked.
Jiang Chen turned around and looked at everyone in confusion, then he shook his head and said, “I don’t know.”
“How can you not know? Only you could get hold of this blood talisman, and if you don’t know what it is, how are you going to use it to deal with the Earth Devil?”
Big Yellow said in a hopeless manner.
“I really have no idea what it is. But, what I do know is, with this blood talisman, we’ll be able to deal with the Earth Devil. Or, put it this way, it can help us restrain the Earth Devil.”

“So this is the treasure hidden in Inferno City. This place has existed for such a long time, and this is the first time someone has discovered the blood talisman.”
Xuan Ye said as he stared at the blood talisman in Jiang Chen’s palm.
“But we don’t know what the use this blood talisman is, and we also don’t know how much power it can release.”
Wang Heng said while curling his lips.
“Even a Combat Soul warrior was injured by the blood red lights unleashed by it, what do you think?”
Yang Meng slapped Wang Heng’s head and gave him a look of disdain.
“Brother Jiang, what did you say just now? Use this blood talisman to deal with the Earth Devil?”
Xuan Ye recalled Jiang Chen’s words just now, and immediately asked him with a surprised expression.

Jiang Chen said.
“Xuan Ye, you have to help brother Jiang kill the Earth Devil.”
Wu Jiu said.
“Of course. However, that Earth Devil is really strong, I actually fought it once.”
Xuan Ye said. He could still remember the scene where he fought the Earth Devil, and it still gave him a daunting feeling.
“What? You’ve fought the Earth Devil before? That means you know where to find it?”

Wu Jiu concluded.
“Haha, what are we waiting for? Let’s proceed to the devil cave now!”

Big Yellow was really excited. He could still remember being hunted by the Combat Soul Evil Devil back in the devil cave, and it gave him a really bad memory. Now, he wanted to return and get revenge.

“We don’t have to rush. Although we’ve obtained the blood talisman, we can’t allow any accidents to happen while dealing with the Earth Devil. With three days, and a huge amount of natural essences and pills, he was confident he could go back to the peak Divine Core realm. With his cultivation base at the peak Divine Core realm, his combat strength could be considered equal to an ordinary Combat Soul warrior’s combat strength. At that point of time, with Xuan Ye’s help, their chances of defeating the Earth Devil would be greater.

Jiang Chen had robbed nearly all the warriors in Inferno City, and his wealth was so enormous that it could actually pile up into a gigantic mountain. There were all sorts of pills and medicines in his storage rings, almost an endless supply.
Jiang Chen also needed some time to stabilize his cultivation. Also, with three days’ time, he could spend some time researching the blood talisman.

Three days flashed by. Outside the Burning Sky Pavilion, Duan Jianhong brought a couple of Divine Core Sect Elders from the Heavenly Sword Sect, and arrived at the Burning Sky Pavilion before Nanbei Chao’s deadline. They were ready to surrender.

chapters.title: Chapter 248 - Returning to the Devil Cave
paragraphs: Duan Jianhong met with Nanbei Chao and Zhao Chongyang and expressed the Heavenly Sword Sect’s willingness to surrender, then promised to obey all of the Burning Sky Pavilion’s orders without hesitation. After that, he returned to the Heavenly Sword Sect with all the Sect Elders.
“Did you see that? Even the Heavenly Sword Sect surrendered to use! From now on, the Qi Province will belong to the Burning Sky Pavilion.”
“That Duan Jianhong is a coward, he just surrendered without even fighting back. What an unexpected decision. I thought there would be a tough fight between us.”

“This tells us that Duan Jianhong is a man who knows which way the wind blows; he knew there wouldn’t be any good outcome if he were to fight senior disciple Nanbei. Therefore, surrendering to us is their best option.”

All the disciples from the Burning Sky Pavilion were discussing the recent events, and prideful expressions could be seen on their faces. Even a big sect like the Heavenly Sword Sect had come forth and surrendered. This made them all prideful for being disciples of the Burning Sky Pavilion.
Within the inner area of the Burning Sky Pavilion, Nanbei Chao and Zhao Chongyang were sitting opposite of each other.
“I really didn’t think that Duan Jianhong would actually surrender to us.”
Zhao Chongyang still couldn’t believe what had happened.

“Hmph! Duan Jianhong is man full of schemes, you think he was sincere in surrendering? He just wants to preserve the Heavenly Sword Sect’s strength; he wants to see how we’re going to deal with the Black Sect and the Valley of Happiness. When all of us are weakened form the fighting, he will swoop in and try to destroy us all.”
Nanbei Chao let out a cold snort. Although Duan Jianhong was a wise man, he couldn’t hide his brilliant plan from Nanbei Chao.
“If that’s the case, we should just kill them directly. Let’s destroy the Heavenly Sword Sect first.”
Zhao Chongyang said with an angry expression.

“We don’t have to. After all, they have surrendered to us, so I won’t attack them. I want to let this Duan Jianhong witness my real strength, let him know how stupid his strategy is. Besides, since the Heavenly Sword Sect has surrendered to us, I won’t let them just sit back and relax, I’ll give them some tasks. Send my order to the Black Sect and the Valley of Happiness, I want them to surrender to me in seven days.”
Nanbei Chao said.
“With Daoist Black and Granny Feng’s character, they won’t surrender.”
Zhao Chongyang shook his head.
“I know. If they don’t surrender, I’ll just destroy them.”
Nanbei Chao said with ultimate arrogance.
“Since we’re going to strike anyways, why are we giving those guys seven days to consider? Why not just attack now? Seven days would give them enough time to prepare to fight back.”
Zhao Chongyang looked at Nanbei Chao, puzzled.

“I gave the Heavenly Sword Sect three days. So for the Black Sect and Valley of Happiness, I’ll give those guys seven days. I just want them to have the time to prepare. Even if both of them group together and fight back, I’ll still destroy them no matter what. For me, slaughtering the Black Sect, Valley of Happiness, or any other sect alone is not challenging at all. Why not just let them group together?”

Nanbei Chao said with a grin on his face. He was a man with the mightiest pride, he thought nothing of them at all. In his mind, the other three big sects in the Qi Province were just some stepping stones for him to become the overlord of this land.
At the same time, within the palace located in the center of Inferno City.

After three days of resting, Xuan Ye had recovered to his peak form. Even more exciting, with the help from all sorts of natural essences, Wu Jiu recovered to the peak Divine Core realm. Although it was only the Divine Core realm, since he had a strong foundation of being a peak Combat Soul warrior, together with some extraordinary skills that he knew; he could actually fight a Combat Soul warrior such as Xuan Ye with only his peak Divine Core cultivation.

Jiang Chen was surprised by another good news as well; in the past three days, Big Yellow had broken through to the Mid Divine Core realm. Together with Jiang Chen, this group of men could sweep across the entire Inferno Hell without much resistance.

In addition, after Guan Yiyun and Tian Yishan had completely healed their injuries, both of them had broken through to the Mid Divine Core realm as well, and they were much stronger compared to before.
“Brother, with my current condition, I can finally help you with your mission.”
Wu Jiu’s eyes were glowing; portraying a brimming energy.
“Kaka, this master dog has broken through to another level, who dares challenge me now?!”
Big Yellow laughed out heartily, incredibly excited.
“Perfect, let’s proceed to the devil cave now!”

Jiang Chen strengthened his spirit. Right now, there were only seven more days until the doorway to the outside world opened up, and he had to kill the Earth Devil as soon as possible. Since his group had such an incredible force, and he possessed the blood talisman; as long as they could find the Earth Devil, Jiang Chen was confident they would be able to defeat it.
“Junior disciple Jiang, what about us?”
Guan Yiyun asked.

“Senior disciple Guan, brother Tian, I don’t think you can provide much help with this. You guys just stay here and focus on healing your injuries, we will return once we’ve killed the Earth Devil. Then, we’ll leave Inferno Hell seven days later.”
Jiang Chen said as he patted Guan Yiyun and Tian Yishan’s shoulders.
“Alright, if this is the case, be careful, junior disciple Jiang.”

Guan Yiyun said with some concern. He and Tian Yishan didn’t have any dissatisfaction with Jiang Chen’s decision; they understood that if they didn’t do as he said, with their cultivation, the outcome would be the same as previously. Not only would they not be able to provide any help, they would become burden for Jiang Chen.
After that, Jiang Chen, Wu Jiu, Xuan Ye and Big Yellow left Inferno City and started flying toward the depths of Inferno Hell.
“Brother Jiang, where is the devil cave located?”
Xuan Ye asked.
“We’ll follow the route I took last time and find two tall trees.”
Jiang Chen followed the route he took last time, and soon, they found two tall trees.
“There is an invisible natural formation between these two trees. Walk through them, then we’ll arrive at the devil cave.”
Jiang Chen explained. Without hesitation, the group walked straight through.
Swoosh!

Chilly wind kept blowing by, and devilish energies filled the place. Jiang Chen and the group arrived at the same spot as last time. Jiang Chen and Big Yellow could remember this well, as this was where they had been ambushed by Evil Devils, and in the end, had attracted the Combat Soul Evil Devil that had chased them into the Poisonous Miasma Space.

“We will slaughter our way to the center of this devil cave where there is a devil palace, and a Combat Soul Evil Devil living there. We’ll have to make this place chaotic and kill it. At that point of time, I believe the Earth Devil will make its appearance.”
Jiang Chen said.
“The Combat Soul Evil Devil isn’t easy to deal with. Once we see it later one, brother Jiang, you can use the blood talisman straight away. We can use this opportunity to assess its power.”
Xuan Ye suggested.

“No, the blood talisman is for the Earth Devil. If I use it before that, the Earth Devil will be able to sense its aura, then it will be scared and go hide itself. If that happens, all our plans and strategies will go to waste. Therefore, we have to depend on ourselves in order to defeat the Combat Soul Evil Devil.”

Jiang Chen had given it thorough thought, he knew the importance of the blood talisman. It was hidden in Inferno City, and it was the reason why no monsters dared come close. If he used it now, the Earth Devil would surely sense it and be alerted, then it would be almost impossible for them to kill it.
“What brother Jiang said is correct. Before the Earth Devil appears, we can’t use the blood talisman; we have to depend on ourselves to defeat the Combat Soul Evil Devil.”
Wu Jiu nodded his head, he couldn’t agree more on what Jiang Chen said.

Xuan Ye asked.
“We’ll follow the route I took last time and find two tall trees.”
Jiang Chen followed the route he took last time, and soon, they found two tall trees.
“There is an invisible natural formation between these two trees.
Walk through them, then we’ll arrive at the devil cave.”
Jiang Chen explained.
Without hesitation, the group walked straight through.
Swoosh!
Chilly wind kept blowing by, and devilish energies filled the place.
Jiang Chen and the group arrived at the same spot as last time.

Jiang Chen and Big Yellow could remember this well, as this was where they had been ambushed by Evil Devils, and in the end, had attracted the Combat Soul Evil Devil that had chased them into the Poisonous Miasma Space.
“We will slaughter our way to the center of this devil cave where there is a devil palace, and a Combat Soul Evil Devil living there.
We’ll have to make this place chaotic and kill it.
At that point of time, I believe the Earth Devil will make its appearance.”
Jiang Chen said.
“The Combat Soul Evil Devil isn’t easy to deal with.
Once we see it later one, brother Jiang, you can use the blood talisman straight away.
We can use this opportunity to assess its power.”
Xuan Ye suggested.
“No, the blood talisman is for the Earth Devil.
If I use it before that, the Earth Devil will be able to sense its aura, then it will be scared and go hide itself.
If that happens, all our plans and strategies will go to waste.
Therefore, we have to depend on ourselves in order to defeat the Combat Soul Evil Devil.”
Jiang Chen had given it thorough thought, he knew the importance of the blood talisman.
It was hidden in Inferno City, and it was the reason why no monsters dared come close.
If he used it now, the Earth Devil would surely sense it and be alerted, then it would be almost impossible for them to kill it.
“What brother Jiang said is correct.
Before the Earth Devil appears, we can’t use the blood talisman; we have to depend on ourselves to defeat the Combat Soul Evil Devil.”
Wu Jiu nodded his head, he couldn’t agree more on what Jiang Chen said.

chapters.title: Chapter 249 - The Dao of War
paragraphs: The Blood Talisman’s aura was too strong, it would attract the attention of all Evil Devils once it was revealed, and when the Earth Devil sensed the Blood Talisman’s aura, it would certainly hide and put their effort to waste.
“Everyone, be extra careful, that Combat Soul Evil Devil is really powerful.”
Jiang Chen reminded everyone. Then, he took the lead and started flying toward the depths of the place.

Xuan Ye had a serious look on his face. Although he was an Early Combat Soul warrior, no human warrior could gain an advantage when fighting an Evil Devil at the same level. Not everyone was an abnormal monster like Jiang Chen, and not everyone possessed the True Dragon Flame.
Roar!

Soon, the Evil Devils in the devil cave sensed the human auras. Wild roars sounded out from all direction. Then, ferocious devilish energy erupted all over the place. Countless wicked and strong Evil Devil dashed out from everywhere, towards Jiang Chen and his group.”
“Hmph!”

Jiang Chen let out a cold snort. He had broken through to the Divine Core realm, and he had over 1,000 Dragon Marks in his body. A simple wave of his hand could produce a force carrying ten million jin. His mighty strength was not something these Evil Devils could withstand.

The Axe of Thunder appeared in Jiang Chen’s hand, and it was immediately covered in True Dragon Flames. Jiang Chen raised the axe high up into the air, and with an ear-splitting sound, he chopped it toward the incoming Evil Devils with a tremendous amount of force.
Rumble...

The earth quaked, the mountains shook, and blood splashed all over the place. A deep trenched was created by the massive amount of force, and black smoke kept emitting from it. The Evil Devils were howling and screaming as they were being slaughtered. Bits and pieces of flesh could be found all over the place. Jiang Chen’s attack had killed countless Evil Devils.

Jiang Chen threw his hand forward in a grabbing motion. In an instant, all devil souls flew up and entered into his storage ring. With a fearless gaze, he kept sprinting forward while swinging the battle axe in his hand. Each strike would cause catastrophic damage, and no Evil Devils could stop him from marching forward.
“What a vigorous man, I have never seen such an incredible young genius before!”

Xuan Ye told Wu Jiu through his Divine Sense. He couldn’t stop the shock from reaching his mind. Sweeping across the Inferno City, and now this; Jiang Chen was like a mighty warrior killing his way through. No one could stop him.

“Brother Jiang is indeed the genius with the most potential I’ve ever seen. Even those abnormal geniuses who never leave the Martial Palace and Martial Saint Dynasty can’t compare with his potential.”
Wu Jiu replied. This made Xuan Ye feel even more shocked. He knew Wu Jiu really well, and Wu Jiu never praised anyone. This was the first time he had heard Wu Jiu do so.
Aowuu!

The turmoil was getting more and more intense, and soon, it had alerted the stronger Evil Devils. Over 5 Late Divine Core Evil Devils dashed to the scene. Each of them were at least 10 meters tall, and they all carried ferocious and bloodthirsty looks in their eyes. Each of these Evil Devils were carrying a creepy devil weapon. When they saw Jiang Chen and Big Yellow, a surprised look could be seen in their eyes.

Because, they recognized this man and dog. They came to the devil cave around two months ago, and they thought that these two had been killed by their chief. They never thought they would see them here again.
Roar!!

Without saying anything else, five valiant Late Divine Core Evil Devils raised their devil weapons high up into the air, then they unleashed their frightening devilish energies and attacked Jiang Chen and his group.
Swoosh!

No fear could be sensed from Jiang Chen. His combat strength was way more powerful than that of these Late Divine Core Evil Devils. Also, his True Dragon Flame could greatly restrain these Evil Devils. Because of this, none of these Late Divine Core Evil Devils were a match for Jiang Chen. With a swing of his battle axe, an Evil Devil was instantly killed.
“Kaka, it’s time for this master dog to show his mightiness!”

Big Yellow’s tail was wagging while a mystical symbol was blinking on his forehead. In the next second, he dashed forward with extremely great speed, slamming into one of the Evil Devils. Big Yellow had just broken through to the Mid Divine Core realm, so he was incredibly confident right now.
“Big Yellow, be careful!”
Wu Jiu exclaimed. Right as he was about to attack and give Big Yellow a hand, he saw Big Yellow using his head to crush the Evil Devil’s head, killing it on the spot.
“Kakaka...”

Big Yellow just killed a Late Divine Core Evil Devil with a single strike. He was incredibly excited, and he kept laughing out arrogantly toward the sky. As a Divine Beast, his strength and incredible talent was not something those ordinary beasts could compare with. Even though he was only a Mid Divine Core beast, it was a piece of cake for him to kill a Late Divine Core Evil Devil.
“What a strong head.”

Xuan Ye and Wu Jiu exchanged glances. Both could find shock in each other’s eyes. They thought Big Yellow’s only ability was the treasure hunting ability, but it looked like they were completely wrong. The man and dog in front of them were the most abnormal beings they had ever met.
Bang!

It was a violent battle, and massive blasts of energies kept rocking the place. When Xuan Ye and Wu Jiu were both startled by what they had witnessed, Jiang Chen and Big Yellow had already killed all 5 Late Divine Core Evil Devils. It was a complete defeat, and no one could even withstand a single strike from either one of this duo.
Xuan Ye and Wu Jiu shook their heads. Both of these powerful warriors suddenly had a feeling that they weren’t needed here. Just Jiang Chen and Big Yellow were enough to kill all these Evil Devils.
A man and a dog were killing their way through a path in front of them. None of these Divine Core Evil Devils could slow them down. Soon, they arrived at the vicinity of the Devil Palace
Aowuu!

A loud roar sounded out from the Devil Palace. After that, the Combat Soul Evil Devil with a gigantic body darted out. It stared at the group with its wicked eye while carrying tremendous killing intent.
“Yaga!”

The Evil Devil bellowed out in an unknown devil language. All of a sudden, it waved its gigantic devil claw which was covered with black devil flames, with a tremendous force and incredible force toward Jiang Chen and the group, causing the surrounding air to tremble.
“Hmph!”
Xuan Ye let out a cold snort. He had prepared for this. He held his palms together, then he unleashed a bright seal and forcefully threw it at the devil claw.
Bang!

This was a collision from two Combat Soul realm beings. The massive impact had nearly torn the dimension apart. Ripples of energies swept across the place and disturbed the airflow in the entire devil cave. The seal unleashed by Xuan Ye was shattered by the Evil Devil, but the attack had successfully blocked the Evil Devil’s attack.
Tap tap tap!
But, the Evil Devil was obviously stronger than Xuan Ye. Xuan Ye was forced back three steps before stabilizing his body.
“Incredible!”
Xuan Ye was shocked.
“Brother Jiu, I’ll use my True Dragon Flames to restrain it. You and brother Xuan just strike together with full strength.”
Jiang Chen said.
“Haha, I’ll deliver it a sneak attack.”

Big Yellow’s body swayed, and he completely disappeared, as if he had escaped from the scene. Jiang Chen knew that Big Yellow wasn’t running away, he was just hiding somewhere, preparing to sneak attack. This dog had a really wicked mind.
Swoosh!
Jiang Chen leapt forward and flew up into the sky. With a loud banging sound, the scorching flame ignited and covered his entire body. The True Dragon Flame turned him completely into a flaming man.

Jiang Chen waved his hand and unleashed pouring flames onto the entire battlefield. In an instant, the battlefield was engulfed in a sea of flames. All the chilly devilish energies hovering around the area immediately swam away, as if they were sneaky mice seeing a fierce cat. The devilish energies that didn’t disappear were burned away by Jiang Chen’s True Dragon Flames.
Roar!
The Combat Soul Evil Devil let out an angry roar. It hated this flame so much, and now it was trapped by it, causing its devilish energies to be greatly suppressed.
Rumble!

The Evil Devil became furious. It immediately threw out its claw and grabbed toward Jiang Chen. Initially, it didn’t pay any attention to Jiang Chen, and its only target was Xuan Ye. But, it never thought that this young man could actually unleash flames that could restrain itself.

Therefore, the Evil Devil had to kill this young man first. If not, it would be trapped by this sea of flames, and its combat strength would be greatly affected, limiting its ability to fight the enemies.
“Hmph! You have to ask for Lord Jiu’s permission if you want to hurt brother Jiang!”

Wu Jiu let out a cold snort. With mighty imposing momentum, his body swayed slightly, and he flew high up into the sky and arrived in front of Jiang Chen. Under Jiang Chen’s control, the True Dragon Flames wouldn’t do anything to affect Wu Jiu or Xuan Ye. Although both of them were trapped by the sea of flames as well, the flames would immediately move out of their way, and all the pressure was for the Evil Devil alone to bear.
“Weapons of a Chaotic War!”

Wu Jiu shouted out loudly. A golden light could be seen on both his palms, and in an instant, he forcefully struck out his palm. The grandeur of a violent battlefield exploded out, horses were neighing; weapons collided; morale was high.

All sorts of weapons appeared the moment Wu Jiu’s palm struck out, including blades, swords, pikes, halberds and many more. Each of them were extremely sharp and point, and the momentum of slaughter and battle on a chaotic battlefield was showering down on the scene, causing everyone to feel as if they were in a real battlefield.

“This is the energy of weapons, I never thought brother Jiu was an expert in the Dao of War and was able to generate so many kinds of weapons and unleash the exact grandeur of a battlefield. These yuan energies are extremely sharp, it feels like an invincible general is unleashing the aura of a mighty king.”

This caused Jiang Chen’s opinion regarding Wu Jiu to grow once again. He had learned about the Dao of War before, and he knew this Dao was extremely tough to cultivate. Those who cultivated it must be extremely domineering, and they had to have personally experienced the grandeur of a chaotic battlefield; only then would one be able to unleash it perfectly. If Wu Jiu continued cultivating it, he would definitely break through to the Combat King realm in the future.
Bang, bang, bang...
Wu Jiu’s Weapons of a Chaotic War had transformed into countless razor sharp weapons, and they crashed toward the Evil Devil’s devil claw, tearing the gigantic devil claw into pieces.

This was the skill of a great warrior. Although he had only recovered to the peak Divine Core realm, but since the solid foundation of a peak Combat Soul warrior was still there, even Xuan Ye wouldn’t be his match if they really fought each other.
“Sonic Punch!”
At the same time, Xuan Ye too let out a violent shout and unleashed his ultimate attack. It was a shining gigantic fist that carried a tremendous force, almost enough to cause the air to explode.
More importantly, Xuan Ye punched out with incredible speed, and he arrived in front of the Evil Devil in just the blink of an eye.
Aowuu!

The Evil Devil was restrained by the True Dragon Flames and was being attacked by two great warriors at the same time, causing it to roar out furiously. Suddenly, it opened up its mouth and shot out an eerie black beam which collided with Xuan Ye’s Sonic Punch.
The black beam was formed by the Evil Devil’s source energy, it was extremely powerful.
Bang!

The Combat Soul Evil Devil was simply too strong. Although it was being suppressed by the True Dragon Flames, its mightiness was still irresistible. The black beam actually penetrated the Sonic Punch without even slowing down.
“Hmph!”

Xuan Ye let out a cold snort. A silvery white pike appeared in his hand. This pike was a perfect-ranked combat weapon, and its power was far beyond what a high-ranked combat weapon could compare with.

Chapter 250 - Big Yellow Takes Credit

The pike shook and produced a thunderous sound. Bright energy waves radiated across the scene and covered the Evil Devil. Xuan Ye perfectly unleashed the power of this perfect-ranked combat weapon and swung it like a living poisonous snake. It reached the Evil Devil’s head in an instant.
Roar!

The Evil Devil let out a furious roar. Although it had a gigantic body, its speed was extremely great. In just the blink of an eye, it formed a black energy orb with tremendous devilish energy, and managed to block Xuan Ye’s pike attack.
“Break away for me!”

Xuan Ye violently shouted out. His pike turned into a steel drill and started cracking the black energy orb. Xuan Ye was actually no match for the Evil Devil, but Jiang Chen’s True Dragon Flame had effectively restrained it, causing the gap between Xuan Ye and the Evil Devil’s combat strength to become smaller.

At the same time, Wu Jiu unleashed an attack as well. A golden halberd appeared in his hand, it was also a perfect-ranked combat weapon. Quality wise, this halberd was much more powerful than the pike Xuan Ye was using.
Bang!
Wu Jiu struck out his halberd with the grandeur of a very powerful army, unleashing energy waves so sharp that even the air was cut apart. A huge amount of sparks emerged along its way.
Aowuu...

The Evil Devil became even more ruthless. Xuan Ye and Wu Jiu had both locked down on its aura. There was no way it could dodge the attacks of these two great warriors, it could only fight back with all its strength.

Even under such a situation, the Evil Devil didn’t show any fear, there was only extreme brutality and great killing intent in its eyes. At this critical moment, a huge amount of devilish energy suddenly emerged from its sole eye. At the same time, its body was growing bigger and bigger, even unleashing an even stronger aura. This Evil Devil had some strong skills, allowing it to withstand Wu Jiu and Xuan Ye’s attacks underneath the True Dragon Flame’s pressure.
But, at the same time, a golden light suddenly appeared above the Evil Devil. The golden light was none other than Big Yellow, who had been hiding somewhere all this time.
Big Yellow had a serious expression right now. With his mouth wide open, he roared at the Evil Devil.
Soul Crunching Tune!

A deep, yet powerful roar sounded out from Big Yellow’s mouth, and it resembled a dragon’s roar. Layers of sound-waves weaved into a gigantic web, which instantly covered the Evil Devil. Big Yellow had been watching everything from the dark; this was the moment he had been waiting for.
Bang!

To this Evil Devil, Big Yellow’s Soul Crunching Tune was a catastrophic disaster. If it was a normal situation, this Combat Soul Evil Devil might not even be hurt by Big Yellow’s Soul Crunching Tune. After all, the gap between their cultivation levels was huge, so the Evil Devil could resist the attack with ease. However, the Evil Devil was currently unleashing a powerful attack, all its attention was on Wu Jiu and Xuan Ye. It never thought a dog would emerge at this critical moment.
Aowuu!

The Evil Devil was hit directly by Big Yellow’s Soul Crunching tune. The blinking devilish energy in its sole eye dispersed in an instant. The attack caused blood to burst out from its mouth and nose, and even its sole eye was bleeding. After that, the Evil Devil’s body started trembling. In a situation where it didn’t have any way to defend itself, Big Yellow’s Soul Crunching Tune penetrated into the depths of its soul.
Puchi! Puchi!

At the same time, Wu Jiu and Xuan Ye’s attack arrived. The halberd and pike impaled the Devil Devil’s head and body. Wu Jiu was the one who made the hole in its head appear, whereas Xuan Ye was the one who made the hole in the Evil Devil’s body appear.

After that, the two men let out loud shouts at the same time. They unleashed tremendous waves of energy from their combat weapons, which tore the Evil Devil’s body into pieces, and sent all its blood and flesh flying. It was killed in a miserable way.

Right after the Evil Devil was killed, Jiang Chen retracted the flames. Then, he took the Evil Devil’s devil soul. This was a Combat Soul devil soul, and after it was purified, the energy within would be extraordinary. It was very important for him, as he could use it to form new Dragon Marks and increase his strength.
“Haha, when this master dog unleashes the Soul Crunching Tune, no one in this world will be able to match my mightiness! All foul enemies will have to die!”
Big Yellow burst into laughter as he hovering in the sky.

Wu Jiu and Xuan Ye put away their combat weapons, and the way they looked at Big Yellow changed once again. Even Jiang Chen felt surprised. He knew Big Yellow would have a new innate ability after breaking through to the Divine Core realm, but he hadn’t seen Big Yellow us it. When Big Yellow used it for the first time, Jiang Chen was actually in secluded cultivation, that’s why he didn’t know.

Today was the first time Jiang Chen had witnessed it, and he was shocked by the ability’s power. It was a critical moment just now, and if Big Yellow didn’t strike at that moment, even with the combined attack of three men, they still could have killed the Evil Devil in the end, but it wouldn’t be this easy. A Combat Soul Evil Devil’s last attack before death was extremely terrifying.
“Big Yellow, you did great this time.”
Jiang Chen walked up to Big Yellow and praised him.

“The sound-wave attack just now was really powerful, it actually attacks one’s soul directly, which is incredibly difficult to defend again! I never thought Big Yellow had this ability, this is definitely an eye opener for me!”
Xuan Ye praised Big Yellow as well.
“That’s right. If not for Big Yellow’s Soul Crunching Tune sneak attack, even if we could still kill the Evil Devil, it wouldn’t be this easy, and we might have had to pay a heavy price for it.”

Wu Jiu nodded his head. In the battle just now, Big Yellow was indeed the key person, and his Soul Crunching Tune was really an incredible attack. Even they would suffer from it if they weren’t aware.
Bang!
Right at this moment, a sky-piercing black beam shot up from the deepest area in the devil cave, producing an explosive sound loud enough to shake the ground.

Jiang Chen and the group were shocked, the immediately threw their sights toward the direction. Far away from where they were, they saw a black beam that shot right into the sky, and it was almost as if it had pierced a hole in the sky. It unleashed an aura that sent chills down their spines.

The devilish energies unleashed from the black beam swept across the entire devil cave in a very short amount of time, causing the place to be filled with rocking devilish energies. When all the Evil Devils in the devil cave sensed this supreme aura, all of them instantly kneeled down and kowtowed toward the source of the black beam.
“It’s the Earth Devil!”
Xuan Ye shouted.
“It finally appeared.”

A grin emerged on Jiang Chen’s face. The moment he had been waiting for had finally arrived. Even when he was about to face the mighty Earth Devil, no signs of panicking or nervousness could be found on his face; he only had an indifferent yet confident expression.

“Just like I had estimated, the Earth Devil is living in the deepest area of the devil cave, and all these Evil Devils are actually its people. Since we’ve just killed the Combat Soul Evil Devil, it alerted the Earth Devil. With its ferocious temper, it will certainly not let us off.”
Wu Jiu said.
Aowuu!

The shrill roar sounded like it came from the depths of hell, causing those who heard it to shiver and feel extremely awful. The black beam was a tremendous amount devilish energies unleashed from the Earth Devil’s body. It was quickly moving toward the group.
“Everyone be careful, the Earth Devil is coming to us!”
Jiang Chen reminded.

Both Wu Jiu and Xuan Ye had nervous expressions. The Earth Devil was a supreme existence amongst all devils, it was far more powerful than all these Evil Devils. Also, its ferociousness was not something any ordinary demons or devils could compare with. Just its aura alone was enough to frighten all its enemies. Now, they could clearly feel that the Earth Devil was at the peak Early Combat Soul realm.

They had placed all their hopes on the Blood Talisman. If the Blood Talisman didn’t work at this critical moment, they would be in extreme danger. Not only this, they would also have to depend on how much the Blood Talisman could restrain the Earth Devil.

“Brother Jiu, brother Xuan, don’t worry, the Blood Talisman contains the aura of the king of all creatures. It can make all demons and devils surrender, and I’m sure it can provide us a lot of help with restraining the Earth Devil.”

Jiang Chen casually said. He had tremendous confidence in this. The reason why Inferno City had existed for so long was all because of this Blood Talisman. No demons or devils dared come close to Inferno City, as they were all scared of the Blood Talisman.
Boom!

Soon, a gigantic creature that looked like a black mountain from afar. It shook the entire devil cave as it landed onto the ground. The gigantic creature was over 30 meters tall, it really was as huge as a mountain. Black scales glowing with darkness covered its entire body, causing it to emit an eerie feeling. Endless devilish energies hovered around its body; it truly was a horrifying monster.

This was the Earth Devil. Unlike those Evil Devils, the Earth Devil actually had complete facial figures. Not only this, it had two pairs of cruel and eerie eyes; each of them looked like they carried hell within. It also had two protruding white fangs that looked like the sharpest weapons in the entire world, causing it look incredibly ferocious.

Behind the Earth Devil, a nearly 3 meter long tail was swinging around. The tail was fully grown with sharp spikes, and it wasn’t hard to imagine that if anyone got hit by this tail, he would definitely explode into pieces.
“So strong!”
Xuan Ye was shocked. He tightened his grip on the pike, and was getting ready to strike.

When the Earth Devil arrived, it immediately threw its sight at this group. A bloodthirsty look could be seen in all four eyes. While looking at the group, it spat out its tongue and locked both its protruding fangs. It was only looking at this group as delicious preys.

Furthermore, intense anger could be seen in its eyes. The existence of these weak mortals in its territory killing its people was an insult to its dignity. This was something that it couldn’t forgive.
“Buddy, hurry up and use the Blood Talisman! This big guy is too powerful, we’re no match for it.”
Big Yellow immediately rushed Jiang Chen.
“Alright.”

Jiang Chen dared not hesitate. With a flip of his palm, the Blood Talisman instantly appeared. Then, he controlled it and made it slowly float up and hover in mid-air, then it unleashed countless blood red lights.

When the imposing Earth Devil saw the Blood Talisman, its expression changed dramatically. It stared at the Blood Talisman with its four eyes as if it had just seen the most frightening objects in the world. Also, when the blood red lights hit the Earth Devil’s body, it immediately jumped up from the ground with a painful expression.
Roar!
The Earth Devil let out a wild roar. It couldn’t bother with killing Jiang Chen and his group anymore. Without any hesitation, it turned around and started running with extreme speed.
“Oh no, the Earth Devil is trying to flee!”
Wu Jiu’s expression changed. Neither he nor Xuan Ye expected that the Blood Talisman would be this powerful, causing the Earth Devil to instantly flee in fear.
“Hmph! It can’t run away from this, the Blood Talisman’s pressure is much stronger than we thought it would be.”

Jiang Chen let out a cold snort. He immediately circulated the Dragon Transformation skill and unleashed numerous Dragon Marks into the Blood Talisman. In an instant, the Blood Talisman began violently vibrating, then it started chasing after the Earth Devil.

Bright energy waves radiated across the scene and covered the Evil Devil.
Xuan Ye perfectly unleashed the power of this perfect-ranked combat weapon and swung it like a living poisonous snake.
It reached the Evil Devil’s head in an instant.
Roar!
The Evil Devil let out a furious roar.
Although it had a gigantic body, its speed was extremely great.
In just the blink of an eye, it formed a black energy orb with tremendous devilish energy, and managed to block Xuan Ye’s pike attack.
“Break away for me!”
Xuan Ye violently shouted out.
His pike turned into a steel drill and started cracking the black energy orb.

Xuan Ye was actually no match for the Evil Devil, but Jiang Chen’s True Dragon Flame had effectively restrained it, causing the gap between Xuan Ye and the Evil Devil’s combat strength to become smaller.
At the same time, Wu Jiu unleashed an attack as well.
A golden halberd appeared in his hand, it was also a perfect-ranked combat weapon.
Quality wise, this halberd was much more powerful than the pike Xuan Ye was using.
Bang!
Wu Jiu struck out his halberd with the grandeur of a very powerful army, unleashing energy waves so sharp that even the air was cut apart.
A huge amount of sparks emerged along its way.
Aowuu...
The Evil Devil became even more ruthless.
Xuan Ye and Wu Jiu had both locked down on its aura.

With his mouth wide open, he roared at the Evil Devil.
Soul Crunching Tune!
A deep, yet powerful roar sounded out from Big Yellow’s mouth, and it resembled a dragon’s roar.
Layers of sound-waves weaved into a gigantic web, which instantly covered the Evil Devil.
Big Yellow had been watching everything from the dark; this was the moment he had been waiting for.
Bang!

Aowuu!
The Evil Devil was hit directly by Big Yellow’s Soul Crunching tune.
The blinking devilish energy in its sole eye dispersed in an instant.

Puchi!

The halberd and pike impaled the Devil Devil’s head and body.

They unleashed tremendous waves of energy from their combat weapons, which tore the Evil Devil’s body into pieces, and sent all its blood and flesh flying.
It was killed in a miserable way.
